title: Customer Incident Manager
description: The role & its impact  When incidents happen, every second counts. You'll be the key orchestrator managing major and minor incidents from the customer's perspective—working across teams to find solutions fast and keep everyone informed. You'll balance immediate crisis response with strategic problem-solving, ensuring customers experience minimal disruption and have clarity on what's happening and why.  You'll own incident management end-to-end: from investigation and impact assessment through to post-incident reviews and recommendations that prevent problems from happening again. You'll build the systems and processes that help teams respond confidently and reduce incidents before they occur, making you instrumental in building customer trust.  The team & how they connect  The incident management team works at the heart of Xero's customer operations, coordinating across engineering, product, support, and leadership to respond to issues that affect our customers. They're problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, bringing rigour and human empathy to every incident response. The team collaborates across geographic regions and departments, treating every issue as an opportunity to strengthen Xero's resilience.  The team is currently working on / Initially, the role may focus on    Building and refining incident management processes and incident registers to prevent issues before they occur  Managing customer-facing communications during incidents to keep stakeholders informed and reassured  Coordinating cross-functional teams to implement both short-term fixes and long-term solutions  Post-incident reviews and recommendations that help reduce recurrence    Where and how you can work  This role has a hybrid working arrangement of 3 days working from our offices and 2 days working from home.  Here are some of the things we are looking for    You'll bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make informed decisions and lead teams through high-pressure situations toward resolution.  You'll thrive on building relationships and collaborating effectively—your ability to influence across all levels and challenge assumptions respectfully makes you a natural leader in complex situations.  You'll demonstrate a genuine customer service mentality, ensuring every decision prioritises minimising customer impact and keeping them informed with clarity.  You'll bring proven experience managing major incidents or complex issues, alongside a track record of leading projects to successful delivery outcomes.  You'll Go Together by coordinating specialist teams across regions and bringing the right people to the table to solve problems—comfortable working autonomously but knowing when to collaborate.  You'll Go Fast by ship ideas, test solutions, and improve them—taking initiative and pushing forward in fast-paced, high-profile environments without waiting for perfect clarity. title: Senior Change Manager
description: Help make Auckland and Aucklanders more resilient to natural hazards    Flexible working and option to purchase an extra week's leave    Salary will be $115,000 to $130,000 plus 3.5% KiwiSaver contribution        He angitūtanga: The opportunity    Auckland Council is establishing a Natural Hazards and Loss Modelling programme team to better manage the natural hazards risks to its $77 billion asset base, driven by climate change and population growth/intensification.  Because of our scale we have a unique opportunity to build our in-house capability to model these hazards and their consequences, to develop mitigation strategies to make Auckland more resilient and to reduce costs for our residents.  We are recruiting specialists and subject matter experts to be part of this team, from science, asset management, programme management and digital engineering backgrounds. Their work will integrate hazard science, exposure, vulnerability modelling, financial risk analysis and spatial data expertise into a single in-house function, streamlining Auckland Council’s approach to natural hazard risk management. Vi leder efter dig, som trives i krydsfeltet mellem teknik, kunder og koordinering. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem gode relationer, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab. Hoffmann Groups løsning er som en ”intelligent værktøjsautomat til industrien” – bare langt mere avanceret. Den sikrer, at medarbejderne altid har adgang til de rigtige værktøjer og forbrugsvarer, samtidig med at virksomheden får styr på forbrug, lager og genbestilling.  Hos Hoffmann Group Danmark søger vi dig, der har en teknisk og gerne håndværksmæssig baggrund og forstår, hvordan tingene fungerer i produktionen. Du har måske selv stået ved maskinerne, arbejdet med værktøj eller løst tekniske udfordringer. Den erfaring kan du nu bruge til at rådgive virksomheder om smartere lager- og værktøjsløsninger og være med til at omsætte deres behov til konkrete, digitale løsninger. Hvis du så også får energi af at tale med kunder, og måske har et netværk du kan bringe i spil, så bliver det endnu bedre.  Din titel bliver Industrial Vending Specialist, men du behøver ikke kende til industriel vending, når du starter. Det vigtigste er, at du kommer med en solid teknisk forståelse og erfaring fra industrien – og har lyst til at lære, hvordan teknologi og digitale løsninger kan skabe værdi i produktionen. Sammen med vores Area Sales Managers, Product Management og eBusiness-specialister bliver du en central del af Hoffmann Groups vækststrategi i Danmark.   Specialisten, kunderne ringer til   Hos Hoffmann Group bliver du grundigt introduceret til TOOL24, Smart Solutions og vores øvrige løsninger. Sammen bygger vi din viden op, så du gradvist bliver specialist på området og kan rådgive kunder i hele landet om de løsninger, der giver bedst mening for deres hverdag.  Du skal altså ikke være den færdige specialist fra dag ét. Vi ser rollen som en udviklingsrejse, hvor din tekniske erfaring er fundamentet, og hvor vi sammen med dig bygger specialistkompetencerne inden for industriel vending op.   Helt konkret kommer du blandt andet til at arbejde med:     udvikling af eksisterende kunder og netværk samt etablering af nye relationer  teknisk rådgivning og præsentation af TOOL24- og Smart Solutions  kundebesøg sammen med vores Area Sales Managers  udarbejdelse af tilbud og projektløsninger  planlægning og gennemførelse af implementeringsprojekter  installation, konfiguration og idriftsættelse af løsninger hos kunderne  integration med ERP- og IT-systemer  træning af brugere og rådgivning om effektive arbejdsgange  teknisk support og fejlfinding – både onsite og remote  løbende opfølgning på kunder, pipeline og projekter    Du får stor frihed til selv at planlægge din hverdag og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for både kunder, kolleger og internationale specialister. title: Software Implementation Consultant
description: The role    You'll run discovery sessions with new clients to capture their requirements, then do the hands-on work of configuring Simplifi to match. You'll train clients on how to manage and build out the system themselves, support deployment and testing, and resolve issues before the system goes live across the whole organisation. Payroll or rostering experience is an advantage but not essential.       You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to enjoy understanding how SaaS works and be willing to dig into problems properly. title: Senior Account Manager
description: About AI Acquisition      AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms. We move fast, we build constantly, and we hold a high bar for the people who work directly with our clients.     We currently manage thousands of active clients across multiple products, with 250+ new clients onboarding every month. The Account Management function is the front line of that relationship.      The Role      You are the person between the client and the outcome. Not a relationship manager. Not a check-in scheduler. Not someone who forwards tickets and hopes for the best.     You own a portfolio of clients who are building real businesses with our support. Some are launching for the first time. Some are scaling. Some are stuck and frustrated. Your job is to diagnose where they actually are, figure out what's blocking their progress, manage their expectations when needed, and drive them toward commercial results, not just activity.     This means you need to understand marketing, sales, offer development, and fulfillment well enough to have real conversations about all of them. If a client's campaign is generating calls but nobody's closing, you need to be able to tell them why and what to do about it, not pass it to someone else.     Our clients purchase a fully built AI lead-generation business: brand, website, funnel, lead engine, and the systems that help turn leads into customers. You own the relationship around that delivery. You need to know what they bought, what was promised, where they are in the journey, and what needs to happen next, with specifics, not generalities.     You'll work directly with clients on Zoom, Slack, and through our internal systems. You'll run growth workshops, intro calls, and quick syncs. You'll manage escalations without panicking and celebrate wins without coasting. And when a client is about to walk, you'll be the person who finds the path to keep them or makes the honest call that they should go. title: Client Consultant
description: Är du vår nya Client Consultant?       Vill du bli vår nya kollega och hjälpa oss ge våra kunder en kundupplevelse i världsklass? Är du en sann lagspelare som ser teamets framgång som din egen? Har du erfarenhet av inkassobranschen och gillar att arbeta med varierade uppgifter och många kontaktytor? Då är det dig vi söker!    Vi söker nu förstärkning till vårt team inom SME B2B/B2C. Hos oss blir du en del av ett företag och team som befinner sig i en spännande fas där ständig utveckling är centralt.        Som ett marknadsledande kredithanteringsföretag har Intrum en bred kompetens inom inkassotjänster och vi gör affärer i 20 länder i Europa. Vi har mer än 10 000 erfarna medarbetare i vår grupp.    Vår verksamhet handlar om att hjälpa andra. Hjälpa skuldsatta individer att ta sig ur svåra situationer. Hjälpa företag att få betalt så att de kan växa, anställa och blomstra. Vilket i sin tur är positivt för hela ekonomin. Du blir en väsentlig del av denna krets hos oss, vilket ger ditt jobb på Intrum en djupare mening. Oavsett din roll eller titel.      Att ligga i framkant är allas jobb    Som marknadsledare är det upp till oss att ligga i framkant. Att forma branschen. Att sätta nya standarder. Och vart än i världen din Intrum-karriärväg tar dig, vilken roll du än spelar, kommer du att bidra till tillväxt, innovation och inverkan som gör verklig skillnad.      Rollen   Som Client Consultant arbetar du proaktivt och självständigt som ansvarig för din leverans till ett antal egna små- och medelstora kunder samtidigt som du är en del utav ett team. Du är kundens kontaktperson i operativa frågor och har en central roll i kundsamarbetet. Du fångar upp frågor och problem från dina kunder som du löser självständigt eller i samråd med interna avdelningar.   Plats för denna position: Göteborg   Hybridarbete. Vi ser att hybridarbete, där vi som medarbetare kan arbeta antingen hemifrån eller från kontoret, skapar möjligheter att prestera och arbeta effektivt i virtuella och reella miljöer.   Du kommer att rapportera till  Team Manager Mandana Jafari      Dina arbetsuppgifter    Ansvara för kundkontakten i leveransen av våra inkassotjänster.  Besvara frågor, vara rådgivande och analysera för att förbättra kundens och Intrums rutiner och processer.  Säkerställa hög kvalitet och effektivitet i våra leveranser till kund  Kommunicera med kunder via telefon, mejl och personliga möten.  Hålla kundutbildningar i inkassoprocessen och vår kundportal.  Koordinera rutiner kring kundens filkommunikation och kvalitetssäkra leveransen.  Bidra med analys- och åtgärdsförslag kopplat till nyckeltal per kund i nära dialog med ansvarig Account Manager.  Vid behov stötta med handläggning av inkassoärenden.  Bidra till trygg och smidig Onboarding av nya kunder.      Du arbetar nära dina kollegor för att skapa en positiv upplevelse för våra kunder och deras kunder. Du utmanar befintliga rutiner och arbetssätt för att skapa effektivare processer och ökad lönsamhet.      Dina kv

title: Implementation Consultant
description: At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.   About The Role   As an Implementation Consultant at Aceve, you are far more than a system configurator — you are the key partner who guides our customers through digital transformation and helps them build processes that genuinely work. You sit at the intersection of technology, people, and business, working closely with customer project managers, finance teams, and field staff to ensure our platform is configured in a way that supports their real operational needs. We measure your success by our customers’ success: when they go live, become productive, and see real value created.   What Will You Do   You will own the full implementation journey for your customers, from first conversation to go-live and beyond. Your days will involve a mix of structured project delivery, trusted advisory work, and close collaboration with colleagues across Aceve.     Lead end-to-end implementation projects, including needs analysis, workshops, system configuration, and user training.   Own your delivery plans and keep all stakeholders (internal and external) aligned on scope, timelines, and budget.   Act as a trusted advisor to customers, supporting them through change and helping simplify complex workflows to fit how their business actually operates.   Collaborate with colleagues across product, sales, and support to develop standardized but flexible implementation frameworks that can be scaled across customers.   Track billable hours, ensure accurate invoicing, and manage commercial follow-up across your project portfolio.   Share knowledge and actively support colleagues — a strong implementation culture is built on learning from each other and growing together.     We believe you have      A proven track record of delivering business systems (ERP, CRM, or SaaS solutions) to external customers, with a clear understanding of how end-to-end system integrations work in practice.   A consulting mindset with genuine hands-on ability, you are comfortable getting into configuration details while also steering larger processes and stakeholder conversations.   Solid financial competency, you can hold meaningful conversations with customer finance teams about bookkeeping, budgets, invoicing flows, and operational efficiency, and you understand why this matters in an implementation context.   Strong project management skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage scope, stakeholders, and timelines without losing focus or momentum.

title: Data Implementation Engineer
description: Position Overview   We're accesso Intelligence (powered by Dexibit). 🦖 🎢 🐅 🗼 🖼️ 🎡 🏟️  accesso Intelligence is the intelligence layer for the business of fun — serving iconic visitor attractions around the world. Not just data, but AI that understands how attractions actually work, helping teams make insightful decisions then act on them: getting more visitors through the door, spending, engaging, leaving happily and returning loyally, with efficiency.  With 25 years of deep industry experience behind us and Dexibit's AI pedigree inside us, you get the best of both worlds: startup culture close to the ground up, with the scale of a listed company behind you.   What We Build   accesso Intelligence sits on top of the world's richest cross-vendor dataset for visitor attractions — integrating with 100+ industry source systems across ticketing, F&B, retail, queuing, CRM, operations and more. That data foundation is what makes everything else possible: the conversational insight, the forecasting, the benchmarking, the AI.   Where You Fit   We're looking for a Data Implementation Engineer to own the technical delivery of accesso Intelligence integrations, then executing that pattern reliably and at volume across our customer base. You’ll be building upon, and maintaining, our class-leading data platform.  What makes this role distinct is the combination of technical execution with genuine understanding of how attractions actually operate commercially. A revenue share arrangement between a venue and an operating partner, a multi-operator ticketing setup, a seasonal membership model with complex redemption logic — these aren't edge cases, they're the norm. Getting the data right means understanding the business behind it.   Location:  Auckland based, hybrid (~3 days in our Parnell office / optionally ~2 at home)   Reports to:  VP, accesso Intelligence   Travel  ✈️  Requirement:  None   What You'll Be Working On     Establish the integration patterns. Work with the data engineering team to define how accesso Intelligence connects to each accesso product. Data model, transformation logic, semantic mapping, quality thresholds. This is foundational work you'll do once per product (and refine over time) rather than reinvent per customer.   Scale and maintain across customers. Onboard new customers onto each integration — configuring per venue, validating data integrity against our acceptance criteria. Then own the ongoing health: change requests, configuration updates, and diagnosis when something breaks or drifts.   Build derived datasets and transformations. Beyond raw integration, you'll help build the derived datasets, transformations and semantic mapping that turn source data into meaningful, analytics-ready inputs — the layer between what a system outputs and what accesso Intelligence needs to deliver insight.   Close the feedback loop into accesso. You'll be the eyes and ears of integration reality. We all want to find the global optima. Sometimes

On behalf of KD Pharma, GT is looking for an experienced Azure DevOps Engineer to support the infrastructure, security and operational design of a modern Microsoft-based data platform and the wider Azure environment.

**Expected Involvement: The engagement is expected to begin with a 6-week Discovery phase, with approximately 45–60 hours of involvement in total. Following successful completion of Discovery and client approval, there is potential to transition into a larger and potentially full-time implementation engagement, with further opportunities around Azure platform improvement and ongoing infrastructure support.

About the Client

Founded in 1988, KD Pharma is a technology-driven CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) specializing in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical production, including ultra-pure Omega-3 concentrates.

The company operates internationally, with locations across Germany, Norway, the UK, the USA, Canada and Peru, and provides end-to-end solutions from development and custom synthesis through to finished dosage forms.

About the Project

KD Pharma is modernising its data and reporting environment and defining a more scalable, maintainable Microsoft-based platform.

The wider technology landscape spans Azure and on-premises infrastructure across multiple international locations, with a mix of modern and legacy business systems including Business Central, NAV, SQL-based applications and reporting solutions. Parts of the environment remain highly manual, with limited documentation, monitoring and infrastructure automation.

The initial 6-week Discovery Phase will focus on understanding the current environment and defining the target architecture and implementation approach.

From an Azure and infrastructure perspective, the team will:

  • Review the existing Azure and hybrid infrastructure, networking and security setup

  • Identify infrastructure, monitoring, resilience and operational gaps

  • Define the target Azure infrastructure, identity and security approach

  • Define appropriate IaC, automation and deployment practices

  • Contribute to PoC design, implementation estimates and the wider technical roadmap

If Discovery is successful and the client approves the next stage, the project is expected to move into a longer-term implementation phase, starting with the agreed PoC and expanding into broader platform and infrastructure improvements.

title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team.

You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server.

Concretely, you will:

Build safety into the platform

  • Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early.
  • Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use.
  • Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it.

Think security first

  • Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment.
  • Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through.
  • Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan.

Work as one with Community Management

  • Our moderation team handles cases day to day.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Muris is building the AI operating system for agricultural logistics, optimizing the process from field to factory. Our food supply chains are increasingly exposed to fluctuations, caused by factors such as weather, prices, and labor shortages. We are working to make our food supply chains more sustainable, resilient, and future-ready.

You are the first technical hire. Your job is to turn messy operations into a decidable problem and ship the result so that dispatchers actually use it. Everything in between is yours: data, model, system, interface.

What you do

  • Formalize dispatching problems: what is being decided, at what granularity, under which assumptions, against which objectives.
  • Choose the simplest model that carries the decision. Heuristic before solver, solver before learning.
  • Define the evaluation before you build. What would a better decision have been, and how would we know.
  • Ship end-to-end: from the data pipeline through the model to the interface the dispatcher looks at. A recommendation nobody understands doesn't count.
  • Sit at the plant and with the dispatchers to get rules that aren't in the data.

This is not for you if

  • you're looking for a narrowly scoped specialist role
  • you want to solve open research questions
  • you want to fit a given dataset instead of formulating the problem yourself
  • you're not willing to regularly visit factories

This is for you if

  • you've turned messy reality into a decision problem before (OR, dispatch, planning, pricing, allocation)
  • operators have used something you built
  • you're quantitatively strong and still prefer owning the whole over owning the method
  • you can explain models without hiding behind the method
  • you can work with incomplete data and hard constraints

We work in English.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. 

In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. 

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Almost slipping into a deep coma from the "We're looking for a highly experienced Customer Success Manager... blah blah blah" job adverts...  And you're looking for an exciting opportunity to join the fastest growing digital agency in the country...  Then this will be the most important job listing you ever read. Every single day.  Someone who's been in the trenches. Who's had the hard client conversation and come out the other side with the account intact. Who can look at a struggling campaign and know whether it's a strategy problem, a delivery problem, or a client-expectation problem - and knows exactly who to call for each one.  That's the role.  You'll sit between the Head of Digital Growth Strategy and the DGS team as their first point of contact, coach, and cover. Process questions, contract queries, billing curveballs, cranky clients at 4:55pm on a Friday - they come to you, and you have the authority to actually solve them. Do it well and three things happen: the team is genuinely well led, our clients get the follow-through they were promised, and our Head of DGS gets to work ON the business instead of IN it. title: Customer Success Manager @ VeviGo
description: Bedrijfsomschrijving   VeviGo is sinds 2016 een innovatieve specialist in persoonlijke veiligheid. Vanuit onze compacte organisatie in Eindhoven adviseren wij klanten over oplossingen op het gebied van tracking, alarmering en veiligheid. Daarbij zorgen we dat hardware en software slim samenwerken. Onze lijnen zijn kort en wij schakelen snel. Wij zijn actief in onder andere de logistiek, industrie, overheid, retail en zorg. Toonaangevende organisaties als Picnic, GGD en TÜV maken gebruik van onze oplossingen.     Meer weten over VeviGo? Bekijk onze websites  sosvolaris  &  mobielenoodknop.nl .      Functieomschrijving   Als Customer Success Manager is het beheren van onze bestaande relaties jouw hoofdverantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt een eigen portefeuille, bent het vaste aanspreekpunt en zorgt voor een hoge klanttevredenheid en verdere ontwikkeling van de relatie. Ook behandel je nieuwe aanvragen die via onze websites binnenkomen, waarbij je het volledige commerciële proces beheert. Daarbij onderzoek je de situatie van de klant en adviseer je over een oplossing die past bij de veiligheidsrisico’s binnen de organisatie. De trajecten duren enkele maanden tot een jaar, kennen doorgaans meerdere stakeholders en richten zich op uiteenlopende veiligheidsvraagstukken in verschillende branches.     Je krijgt de tijd en ruimte om onze oplossingen, klanten en markt goed te leren kennen. Wanneer je bent gesetteld in je rol, denk je samen met de eigenaar na over hoe we de markt proactiever kunnen gaan benaderen. Je draagt bij aan een strategisch plan en denkt daarbij in mogelijkheden en kansen. Je onderneemt actie om nieuwe business binnen te halen en geeft aan wat je nodig hebt om onze propositie verder te versterken.      Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden     Relatiebeheer en klantadvies:  Je beheert actief je eigen klantenportefeuille, voert accountgesprekken en signaleert mogelijkheden voor uitbreiding of aanvullende dienstverlening. Je kwalificeert inkomende aanvragen en vertaalt veiligheidsvraagstukken naar passende hardware- en softwareoplossingen. Als eerste aanspreekpunt pak je eenvoudige functionele vragen en serviceverzoeken op en schakel je waar nodig technische expertise in.   Begeleiding van het commerciële proces:  Je stelt offertes op, begeleidt trajecten van het eerste contact tot en met de implementatie en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige opvolging.   Klantbezoek en productkennis:  Je bezoekt regelmatig klanten in Nederland en soms België. Zo zie je hoe de oplossingen worden gebruikt, versterk je de relatie en kun je klanten beter adviseren. Easor on taloushallinnon alustayhtiö, joka yhdistää yrittäjät ja tilitoimistot saman teknologian ympärille. Kehitämme helppokäyttöisiä ja pitkälle automatisoituja ratkaisuja, jotka tekevät taloushallinnon arjesta sujuvampaa ja vapauttavat yrittäjän aikaa tärkeimpään. Olemme kasvava kansainvälinen yhtiö, ja kehitämme alustaa jatkuvasti vastaamaan asiakkaidemme tarpeita.   Easor etsii nyt  Key Account Manageria  vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toimipisteesi on ensisijaisesti Oulussa tai Helsingissä.    Mitä teet käytännössä?    Sinulla on oma partnersalkku, jonka kasvusta ja tyytyväisyydestä olet vastuussa. Päivittäinen työsi on olla tiiviissä vuorovaikutuksessa tilitoimistojen avainhenkilöiden kanssa: sparraat heidän liiketoimintaansa, autat heitä ottamaan Easorin täyteen käyttöön ja löydät yhdessä uusia tapoja kasvaa. Tukenasi on Easorin myynti-, käyttöönotto- ja tukitiimit. Tehtävässä sinulla on aito mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten suomalaiset tilitoimistot kehittyvät ja kasvavat    Ketä etsimme?    Olet henkilö, jolla on syvä ymmärrys taloushallinnosta ja tilitoimistojen arjesta - ei teoreettinen, vaan käytännön kautta hankittu. Ymmärrät, mistä tilitoimiston liiketoiminta oikeasti muodostuu.  Lisäksi sinulle on luontevaa:    Rakentaa luottamuksellisia, pitkäkestoisia asiakassuhteita  Tunnistaa kasvumahdollisuuksia  Toimia muuttuvassa ympäristössä systemaattisesti     Miksi juuri tämä tehtävä?   Olet mukana kasvavan yhtiön ytimessä uuden konseptin rakentamisessa, et rivissä isojen rattaiden rattaana. Tiimi on pieni, päätökset tehdään nopeasti ja tekemäsi työ näkyy suoraan tuloksissa. Tarjoamme sinulle vahvan taustatuen, nykyaikaiset työkalut ja ympäristön, jossa saat keskittyä olennaiseen.  Tarjoamme myös kattavat henkilöstöedut, muun muassa laajan työterveyshuollon sekä lounas-, puhelin- ja virike-edut.  Tehtävän palkkahaitari on  4000 - 6000 € / kk , ja palkkaus määräytyy osaamisen ja aiemman kokemuksen mukaan.   Meillä arvostetaan   Easorilla työtä tehdään luottamuksen varassa. Saat vastuuta ja vapautta, mutta myös odotuksen siitä, että viet asioita eteenpäin oma-aloitteisesti. Tiimissä autetaan toisia ja jaetaan osaamista arjessa. Kehitämme tekemistä jatkuvasti yhdessä: kokeilemme, opimme ja parannamme suuntaa matkan varrella. Päätöksiä tehdään lähellä arkea, eikä asioita jätetä odottamaan.  Työtämme ohjaavat kolme arvoa:  Rohkeus – uskallamme kokeilla uutta, kyseenalaistaa ja tehdä asioita eri tavalla.   Draivi – viemme asioita eteenpäin määrätietoisesti ja otamme vastuuta tuloksista.   Välittäminen – pidämme huolta toisistamme, asiakkaistamme ja partnereistamme.  Toivomme, että nämä näkyvät myös tavassasi tehdä töitä.    Kiinnostuitko?    Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään  15.9.2026 . Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.  Lisätiedot:  Maajohtaja Arne Hurm

title: Customer Care Manager (FR/EN)
description: Le contexte   Une marketplace B2B en forte croissance. D'un côté des grands comptes du retail et du e-commerce, de l'autre un réseau de 2000 acheteurs professionnels aux profils très variés.      Le service client a été construit de zéro ces derniers mois. Avant : pas d'outil, pas de process, un délai de réponse moyen de 70 heures. Aujourd'hui : tous les canaux sont centralisés, un chat développé en interne, moins de 2 heures de délai moyen. Le prochain palier, c'est de passer sous l'heure. C'est là que vous arrivez.      Le poste   Vous rejoignez une équipe Ops de 6 personnes, dont 2 dédiées au care acheteurs, épaulées par des alternants.  Le job est concret : environ 300 messages entrants par semaine (jusqu'à 500 en haute saison), à traiter, qualifier et transformer en tickets. Chat, réclamations, SAV, relances de paiement.  Environ 80% d'exécution opérationnelle, 20% de construction : ce que vous voyez passer en tickets alimente les chantiers d'amélioration (arborescence IA du chat, automatisations, documentation, process).      Vos missions    Traitement des demandes acheteurs    Répondre sur le chat et les autres canaux, en français et en anglais  Gérer les réclamations, le SAV, les relances de paiement  Suivre chaque dossier jusqu'à résolution  Tenir les délais de réponse, c'est l'indicateur numéro un    Gestion du ticketing    Transformer chaque demande en ticket qualifié et catégorisé  Surveiller les volumes, les délais, les tickets en attente  Repérer les récurrences    Suivi d'un portefeuille d'acheteurs    Comprendre leurs usages et leurs contraintes  Points réguliers, anticipation des difficultés  Prévenir le churn    Amélioration continue    Faire remonter les signaux faibles du ticketing en chantiers concrets  Coordonner avec la logistique, les opérations, la finance et les sales sur les cas complexes  Contribuer à la documentation (guides, FAQ, templates) et aux automatisations       La réalité du poste   Les stocks ne sont pas ceux de l'entreprise. Quand il y a un problème, il vient soit du vendeur (préparation, qualité), soit du transport, deux maillons partiellement externes. Le levier principal se joue donc sur la logistique et sur la qualité de la relation.  Autrement dit : c'est un poste où on résout des problèmes qu'on n'a pas créés. Il faut du sang-froid et un vrai goût pour le problem solving.      Le profil    2 à 3 ans en customer care ou customer success, en B2B  Anglais professionnel : indispensable, une partie des acheteurs est à l'international  À l'aise avec un outil de ticketing et avec la donnée basique  Bonne communication écrite et orale  Empathie naturelle, gestion des émotions solide  Esprit analytique, appétence pour proposer des solutions et monter des projets  Le diplôme compte moins que ce que vous avez déjà géré       Le process    Échange de qualification avec Sparkway  Entretien avec le Head of Operations  Business case  Rencontre avec le Codir

Du säkerställer att teamet når uppsatta mål inom både service och försäljning, samtidigt som du driver teamets utveckling framåt.  Du ingår även i ledningsgruppen för JYSK Kundservicecenter Sverige, där du tillsammans med övriga ledare förväntas bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling och vår ambition att bli Sveriges bästa kundservicecenter. Du vågar fatta beslut, tar initiativ och motiveras av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.  Du har ett tydligt affärs- och kundfokus och förstår hur engagerade och välutvecklade medarbetare skapar goda resultat. title: Kundeservicechef - AL Sydbank Direkte
location: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: I AL Sydbank Direkte søger vi en Kundeservicechef som brænder for mennesker, ledelse og sublim kundeservice. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige ledelse og får ansvaret for et team af medarbejdere som hver dag hjælper vores kunder på telefonen.    Vi leder efter dig der kan kombinere nærværende ledelse med fokus på drift, kvalitet og resultater – og som trives i en hverdag, hvor tempoet er højt, og hvor vi lykkes sammen.   Om stillingen  Som Kundeservicechef får du det direkte personale- og ledelsesansvar for dit eget team på Sluseholmen. Din vigtigste opgave er at skabe de bedste rammer for, at medarbejderne lykkes – både med den enkelte kunde og som team.  Du er tæt på den daglige drift og skal blandt andet lede, motivere og udvikle medarbejderne i dit team. Du skal sikre høj tilgængelighed og gode kundeoplevelser følge op på performance, kvalitet og relevante nøgletal coache medarbejderne og omsætte data og observationer til konkret udvikling.  Du skal skabe tydelige rammer, retning og forventninger i hverdagen og sikre en god balance mellem kundernes behov, medarbejdernes trivsel og en effektiv drift i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige Kundeservicechefer. Du skal bidrage aktivt til at udvikle vores kundeservice og den måde som vi arbejder på.  Du bliver en del af en organisation i udvikling, hvor vi har store ambitioner for vores kundeservice. Derfor får du også mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både teamet og den fortsatte udvikling af AL Sydbank Direkte. Du indgår ligeledes i en ledergruppe, hvor dine lederkollegaer befinder sig i Aabenraa, Vejle, Herning, Slagelse og Sluseholmen.  Om dig  Vi forestiller os, at du er en synlig og engageret leder, som naturligt er tæt på både medarbejderne og driften. Du skaber følgeskab gennem tydelighed, tillid og nærvær, og du tør samtidig stille krav og følge op, når det er nødvendigt.  Det er vigtigt, at du:    har erfaring med personaleledelse – gerne fra kundeservice, bank eller en anden driftsorienteret organisation  motiveres af at udvikle mennesker og skabe resultater gennem andre  arbejder struktureret og har blik for både mennesker, kunder og performance  kan bruge data og nøgletal aktivt i din ledelse  kommunikerer tydeligt og skaber retning – også når hverdagen ændrer sig  tager ansvar og handler, når noget kræver opmærksomhed  ser samarbejde på tværs som en forudsætning for at lykkes.    Det vigtigste er, at du har energien og lysten til at gøre en forskel for både medarbejdere og kunder.  Om virksomheden  AL Sydbank er blandt Danmarks største banker med hovedsæde i Aabenraa. Vores mål er at skabe økonomisk tryghed og udvikling – for kunder, lokalsamfund og hinanden.  Hos os bliver du en del af et fællesskab med mere end 4.000 kolleger i Danmark og Nordtyskland. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor bygger vi vores kultur på samarbejde, korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og et fælles fokus på at gøre tingene effektivt og ordentligt. title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Vaasan myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

description: Targa Telematics S.p.A. , realtà consolidata e in costante crescita nel mondo dei  veicoli connessi e della smart mobility , è alla ricerca per la propria sede di  Torino  di una figura di  Customer Care Process Manager. La figura avrà il compito di guidare il team di servizio clienti garantendo l'eccellenza operativa nel rispetto degli SLA e dei KPI, fungendo al contempo da catalizzatore per la  trasformazione digitale . Sarai un partner di fiducia per i clienti, collaborando trasversalmente con le altre funzioni aziendali per garantire un servizio eccellente e risultati commerciali solidi e duraturi. Monitorare le performance degli account e la crescita del business a seguito dell'implementazione degli accordi.  Rivedere, rinnovare e ottimizzare i Service Level Agreement in linea con gli obiettivi di business.  Preparare e mantenere aggiornati report di performance e analisi degli account.  Presentare aggiornamenti di business e presentazioni di performance al management, evidenziando l'impatto sul business e il valore generato. title: Sales Service Manager
description: Overview   Lutron is seeking a  Sales Service Manager  to drive service excellence and operational effectiveness across Japan. This role is responsible for leading all service-related functions and ensuring that service is a key differentiator in winning and growing business.  Supporting Lutron’s three core segments in Japan: Commercial, Hospitality, and Luxury Residential. This role partners closely with the sales organization to enhance customer experience, strengthen Lutron’s reputation, and ensure seamless execution across the project lifecycle.  The Sales Services Leader owns the performance, alignment, and continuous improvement of all service functions, while enabling the sales team to stay focused on growth.      Responsibilities    Lead all service functions to deliver consistent operational excellence  Drive high-quality service execution across all project segments  Partner with sales to enable focus on core business growth  Own cross-functional issue resolution and process improvement  Build and nurture strong customer and partner relationships  Lead, develop, and mentor the Japan service team  Oversee end-to-end service performance and continuous improvement  Deliver exceptional customer experience and satisfaction  Manage service operations and project lifecycle support  Champion service as a key market differentiator  Align service delivery with global quality standards       Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree required  10+ years of professional experience in service, operations, or a related function  Experience leading and developing teams  Fluency in both Japanese and English  Experience in construction, infrastructure, or project‑based environments is preferred      Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent. Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at www.lutron.com.      Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics

title: Service Delivery Manager Arbetsplats till Unionen
description: Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik? Här erbjuds du en nyckelroll i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där du stödjer verksamheten och driver digitaliseringsinitiativ framåt!   Du ansvarar för och utvecklar Unionens digitala arbetsplats, och säkerställer att våra medarbetare har tillgång till moderna, säkra och användarvänliga IT-tjänster.      Om Unionen   Unionen är Sveriges största fackförbund och vi finns för tjänstemän på den privata arbetsmarknaden. Vår vision är att skapa trygghet, framgång och glädje i arbetslivet.  På vårt kontor i Stockholm arbetar cirka 600 medarbetare i moderna lokaler mitt i city. Hos oss möts du av en prestigelös och välkomnande kultur där samarbete, utveckling och omtanke står i fokus.     Du kommer att tillhöra sektionen IT-tjänster och teamet för arbetsplats och intern servicedesk. Sektionen ansvarar för arbetsplats, servicedesk, drift, nätverk och verksamhetsapplikationer och har ett viktigt uppdrag i att leverera stabila, säkra och effektiva IT-tjänster till hela organisationen. title: Operations Lead
description: Hurtiglading er en av de raskest voksende bransjene i Europa, og Norge ligger fremst i verden med sin elbilpark. Det betyr at standarden for hvordan hurtiglading skal fungere settes her og nå.     Kople er en av Norges største ladeoperatører med over 7500 ladepunkter fordelt på hurtiglading, AC-lading og lading-as-a-service. Du får personalansvar for driftsteamet, og du får være med å forme det.     Vi jobber datadrevet og automatiserer det som kan automatiseres. Vi tar sikte på å oppdage utbedringer lenge før kundene gjør det, og streber etter å forutse fremfor å være reaktive. Teknologi, AI og automatisering er sentrale aspekter ved rollen, og du vil jobbe tett med produkt og teknologi for å innføre det som behøves for å gi teamet og Kople best mulig utgangspunkt for å levere.     Rollen eier resultatet i økte suksessrater, ikke kun et sett med arbeidsoppgaver. Du vil ha et sterkt team for å drive forbedringer og støtte fra ledergruppen til å prioritere det viktigste. Kople er stolte av et godt arbeidsmiljø, korte beslutningsveier, og godt samarbeid på tvers av alle teams.       Hva du kommer til å gjøre    Eie ladesuksessraten for hele porteføljen  Grave i data og innsikt til du finner rotårsaker, du løser også prioriterte saker selv med en praktisk tilnærming  Holde leverandører ansvarlig for hva som har blitt lovet. Du aksepterer ikke at en sak lukkes uten teknisk begrunnelse, og du eskalerer med logger, mønstre og avtaler i hånden  Aktivt lete etter måter å forbedre nettverket på, uten å vente på at feil meldes inn  Sette kravene for hva som skal være verifisert på software- og hardwaresiden før noe nytt innføres  Jobbe veldig tett med produktteamet på verktøy og automatisering som løfter suksessraten  Bygge et driftsteam med tydelig eierskap og høy fart       Hva vi måler    Reell suksessrate på porteføljen  Tid fra feilmelding til utbedret lader  Andel saker med korrekt identifisert rotårsak  Leverandørenes etterlevelse av avtale  Kostnad og ressursbruk mot budsjett       Du er sannsynligvis en god match hvis   Du har erfaring fra drift, teknologi eller industri, og har jobbet i grensesnittet mot produkt og kommersielt. Erfaring fra ladebransjen er ingen forutsetning, men god forståelse av tekniske systemer og viljen til å sette deg inn i detaljer er viktig. God kommersiell forståelse og vilje til å prioritere det som er best for kundene våre, ikke hva det ropes høyest om, teller mye. description: About Analog Devices   Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.   Company Introduction:  https://www.analog.com/en/index.html   Analog Devices (ADI) has just over $12 billion in revenue with offices around the world. As a global leader in the design and manufacturing of analog, mixed signal, power management and DSP integrated circuits, ADI is known for helping to solve its customers’ toughest engineering challenges. With a commitment to engineering for good, ADI strives to create a more sustainable future, while also focusing on its employees through mentoring programs, employee networks and continuous learning opportunities.    At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. You will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.    Position Summary:   The Specialist, Customer Operations is a challenging and dynamic role, and filled with opportunities for growth. The Specialist, Customer Operations is responsible for working with field sales to maintain and improve the business relationship between the customer and ADI Corporate. This position has high visibility within all departments at ADI and requires working closely with the various Business Units, Sales and Supply Chain to increase revenue at the customer. The Specialist, Customer Operations is required to add value at every level of transaction and communications, and act as an advocate for the customer within the company and at the same time represents ADI in all business transactions. The Specialist, Customer Operations gathers and disseminates information from the customer to all parties within ADI and works closely with the field sales team to satisfy customer requests.   Responsibilities:      Learn and follow with ADI Procedures, Policies and Compliance  Manage the day-to-day operations for the team and are responsible for overall productivity, quality, and delivery of business services  Drive business representative case quality and metrics, monitor trends, and ensure corrective actions  Customer relationship management : Lead the regular face-to-face forecast meetings/quarterly business review meeting  Customer backlog management : Purchase orders, change orders and logis

title: Food & Beverage Manager
description: Company Description    Join   us at Accor,   where   life pulses   with   passion!   As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.  By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.  You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!  You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.  Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.   Hospitality   is   a   work   of   heart  ,    Join   us and   become   a   Heartist  ®.    Job Description   Passionate about creating exceptional dining experiences through outstanding service, operational excellence, and strong leadership? As a Food & Beverage Manager, you will lead and oversee the hotel’s Food & Beverage operations, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, high service standards, and strong financial performance while inspiring and developing our Heartists.   What Is In It For You     Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor properties worldwide.  Learning programs through our Academies and the opportunity to earn qualifications while you work.  Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world.  Ability to make a difference in the local community through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities, including Planet 21.     What You Will Be Doing     Lead, manage, coach, and develop the Food & Beverage team to deliver exceptional service and operational excellence.  Oversee the day to day operations of multiple Food & Beverage outlets, ensuring smooth and efficient service across all areas.  Personally lead and oversee F&B catering and high volume operations, maintaining a strong presence on the floor and ensuring operational excellence.  Ensure all Food & Beverage outlets consistently deliver exceptional guest experiences in line with luxury hospitality and brand standards.  Monitor service quality, guest satisfaction, productivity, and operational performance while ensuring compliance with hotel policies and brand standards.  Develop and implement strategies to maximize revenue, profitability, guest satisfaction, and overall F&B performance.  Take ownership of F&B financial

title: Care Lead - Saudi Arabia
description: Health can’t wait .  Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.  Alan exists to end the wait.  Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.  So we are building the  new standard in prevention insurance.  Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.  We are on an incredible journey to build a  global leading company, with a   unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.  Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.  ⭐ Your mission  We are building Alan's Care function in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes sure every member trusts Alan when they need us most. You'll build the function from zero: process, tooling, quality bar, then scale it, while handling the conversations that matter most yourself.   Founding the function     Handle directly the member contacts that stay in-house: admin requests, escalations, complex cases.  Write the scripts, guidelines, and documentation that make Care work in Saudi from day one.  Shape the operating model on the ground together with the GM Saudi and the global Care community: opening hours, shift coverage, tooling setup (Intercom and others), and how traffic splits between in-house and externalized support.      What success looks like:  a documented, working Care operation that can pass regulatory scrutiny and handle real member conversations from launch.    Owning quality on externalized support     Own the quality bar for everything we externalize: review calls and tickets in Arabic, coach our outsourcing partner's agents, and close the loop between what members experience and what we improve.      What success looks like:  externalized conversations meet Alan's quality bar, and gaps get caught and fixed before they become member complaints.    Owning regulatory accountability     Own the complaint-handling policy and the regulatory SLAs on complaints.  Prepare the documentation and readiness for the Insurance Authority inspection.      What success looks like:  Alan passes Insurance Authority inspection with a clear, accountable answer on every complaint-handling question asked.   You won't be building this alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's global Care Ops team on process design, tooling, forecasting, and planning, the same team behind our Care launches in France, Belgiu

title: Customer Success Specialist (H/F/X)
description: Qui sommes-nous ?     Kolecto est une fintech de gestion affiliée au Groupe Crédit Agricole  qui simplifie, sécurise et améliore les finances des TPE-PME françaises, en conformité avec les dernières réglementations en vigueur.  Projet hybride par essence, notre solution digitale et humaine s'évertue à prendre  le meilleur de deux mondes complémentaires  : la culture agile et la vélocité d'une startup combinées à la puissance d'une banque universelle de proximité de 140 ans, leader européen historique de son industrie.  Aujourd’hui, Kolecto, c’est une équipe de 215 personnes en hypercroissance, classée n°1 au TECH500 (classement relayé par Les Echos), qui évolue dans un environnement de travail très dynamique, avec des bureaux idéalement situés à Miromesnil (Paris 8e), à 5 min des Champs-Elysées et 10 min de la gare Saint-Lazare.    📌 Notre mission    Travailler chez Kolecto, c'est prendre activement part à un mouvement qui nous dépasse, celui de  soutenir le maximum de TPE-PME de notre tissu économique , et notamment les plus vulnérables, dans  la réussite de leurs transitions : technologique, économique et réglementaire .  Nous nous engageons au quotidien pour amplifier le pouvoir de projection et d’action des entrepreneurs, dirigeants et employés de TPE-PME qui contribuent à la compétitivité et la modernisation de notre pays.    🚀 Notre ambition    Avec le soutien du Groupe Crédit Agricole et de son réseau national historique (39 Caisses Régionales, 7000 conseillers) ainsi que du réseau LCL (1500+ conseillers),  Kolecto est en forte croissance et vise à accompagner la digitalisation de plus de 500 000 entreprises sur les prochaines années , en assumant sa fonction de pont durable entre la banque de proximité, les experts-comptables et l’écosystème de partenaires de confiance des TPE-PME.   🤩  Pourquoi rejoindre Kolecto ?       La puissance de notre mission : nous trouvons beaucoup de sens à servir le maximum de TPE-PME françaises, et notamment celles qui sont traditionnellement le plus à la marge des dernières vagues de digitalisation et modernisation du pays ;   Nos collègues doué·e·s, passionné·e·s, expérimenté·e·s et altruistes, qui évoluent dans une dynamique de croissance très positive.   Notre environnement de travail hybride unique, combinant le meilleur de l’environnement stimulant de la startup et la force de frappe d’un grand groupe bancaire leader.   Notre politique de télétravail flexible, qui permet jusqu'à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine en France.   Notre engagement pour l’égalité professionnelle, illustré par un Index égalité femmes-hommes de 99/100 en 2025, témoignant de notre vigilance constante sur l’équité des parcours et des rémunérations.   Nos événements internes fédérateurs : deux séminaires par an, talks inspirants, afterworks, etc.      🎯 Votre mission    La mission du CSS est d'accompagner nos clients dans la digitalisation de leur gestion administrative. title: Customer Operations Paris
description: About Pelico   Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.  We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.  Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.  This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.   About The Role   The mission of our Customer Operations team is simple: maximize Pelico's impact at the factory in the shortest time possible. CustOps owns the full deployment lifecycle — from onboarding to adoption to expansion — and shares the same incentives as our customers. You'll be measured on validated impact, not activity.  We hire from two buckets: young, hungry operators who figure things out fast; and ultra-resilient generalists who've navigated real operational chaos and come out the other side. Both paths work. What doesn't work: people who wait for a brief before moving.  The career ceiling here is genuinely unlimited. Any pilot can become an enterprise deployment, which can become the defining case study for an entire vertical — in 3-month cycles. CustOps is also a talent bench for the rest of Pelico: people have moved into Product, AI Ops, Pre-sales, and Leadership. The skills you build here travel everywhere.   What You'll Do     Own the successful deployment and adoption of Pelico at your customer sites — from kick-off to validated case study, in the shortest time possible.  Build genuine relationships with factory operators, plant managers, and supply chain directors — the kind where they'd take a reference call for you.  Quantify and communicate the impact Pelico delivers: shortage reduction, lead time improvement, team coordination. You make the value visible.  Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and raise customer ambition — from pilot to enterprise deployment to vertical case study.  Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to relay structured field feedback that shapes the roadmap.  Contribu

title: Account-Manager
description: Du weißt, dass „Bio“ mehr bedeutet als ein grünes Etikett, behältst bei 120 Sorten Obst und Gemüse den Überblick und weißt, dass Timing, Qualität und Teamwork im Frischebereich entscheidend sind? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.       DEINE AUFGABEN   Du bist Teil eines 4-köpfigen Teams und zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:   Betreuung unserer Großhandels-Kundinnen und -Kunden: aktiver Verkauf, Beratung, Bestellannahme, Bearbeitung von Reklamationen • Unterstützung bei der Kundenakquise  Korrespondenz telefonisch, per Mail und persönlich  Verwaltung der Kundendaten und -aufträgen in unserem ERP-System       WAS DU MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST    Begeisterung für biologische Lebensmittel  Erfahrung im Verkauf / Kundendienst / Inside Sales  Freude am Umgang mit Kunden & Bereitschaft zu Kundenbesuchen  Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Microsoft BC) von Vorteil  Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (v.a. Deutsch, Englisch von Vorteil)  Teamfähigkeit, Eigenmotivation, Prozessdenken und proaktive Arbeitsweise       WAS DIE ARBEIT „MIT SINN“ IN UNSERER BIOHOF-FAMILIE BESONDERS MACHT    Genieße kostenloses, frisches Bio-Obst & -Gemüse aus unserem Sortiment  Gönn dir ein Bio-Mittagessen (20% Rabatt) und eine kostenlose Suppe im hauseigenen Bio-Kulinarium  Erhalte 20% Rabatt auf all unsere Produkte im Biomarkt und auf die Biokiste  Profitiere vom Bio.g‘sund Gesundheitsförderungsprogramm (Physiotherapie, Leih-E-Bikes, Bio.g‘sund-Raum, etc.)  Nimm an kostenlosen oder ermäßigten Events (Kombucha-Workshop, Basenfasten, etc.) teil       ARBEITSZEIT    grundsätzlich 5-Tage-Woche, Montag bis Freitag  fallweise Samstagsdienst (ca. alle 6-8 Wochen) - in diesen Wochen hast du freitags frei      DU BIST EIN ECHTES VERKAUFSTALENT? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Du darfst dich auf ein buntes Team mit gemeinsamer Vision und auf einen zukunftssicheren Arbeitsplatz im grünen Ambiente freuen. Gemeinsam tun wir tagtäglich etwas Sinnvolles und Enkeltaugliches.      WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE AUSSAGEKRÄFTIGE BEWERBUNG AN  Martina Orthofer • personal@biohof.at • 07272 / 4859 63     Lass uns reden. Wir arbeiten in einem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Für diese Position liegt das Gehalt lt. Kollektivvertrag bei € 37.464 brutto pro Jahr. Was du tatsächlich bei uns verdienst, vereinbaren wir in einem persönlichen Gespräch, abhängig von deinen Qualifikationen und deiner Berufserfahrung.

title: Merchant Success
description: KPayについて  KPayグループは、シンプル・スマート・シームレス・セキュアなテクノロジーソリューションを通じて、あらゆる規模のビジネスの成長を支援する急成長中のフィンテック企業です。  現在、日本・香港・シンガポール・オーストラリアを中心に90,000以上の加盟店へサービスを提供し、決済、財務管理、業務オペレーションの効率化、そしてデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進するワンストッププラットフォームを展開しています。  私たちは、テクノロジーの力で中小企業の成長を支援し、より良いビジネス環境の実現を目指しています。     募集ポジション   Merchant Success Specialist   勤務地：福岡  採用予定人数：4名     ポジションについて  加盟店の成功がKPayの成長につながる――。  Merchant Success Specialistは、加盟店がKPayのサービスを最大限活用できるよう支援し、長期的な関係構築を担うポジションです。  オンボーディングから活用促進、課題解決、リテンションまで一貫して担当し、顧客のビジネス成長をサポートしていただきます。  顧客と最も近い距離で接しながら、プロダクト改善やサービス向上にも貢献できる重要な役割です。     主な業務内容  ・加盟店へのオンボーディングおよび導入支援  ・顧客との継続的なコミュニケーションによる関係構築  ・サービス利用状況の分析および活用促進  ・顧客課題の特定および改善提案  ・顧客満足度向上および解約防止施策の実施  ・顧客フィードバックの収集およびプロダクトチームへの共有  ・営業、プロダクト、サポートチームと連携した課題解決  ・アップセルおよびクロスセル機会の発掘  ※主に電話・オンラインミーティングを通じて顧客とのコミュニケーションを行います。     応募資格  必須条件  ・カスタマーサクセス、マーチャントサクセス、法人営業のいずれかの経験  ・高いコミュニケーション能力  ・主体的に課題を発見し、解決に向けて行動できる方  歓迎条件  ・SaaSまたはITサービス業界での業務経験  ・アップセル、クロスセルの実務経験  ・顧客データ分析および改善提案の経験  ・スタートアップまたは成長企業での勤務経験     求める人物像  ・顧客の成功を第一に考えられる方  ・受け身ではなく、自ら顧客に価値提供できる方  ・変化の速い環境を楽しめる方  ・チームワークを重視しながら成果創出できる方  ・顧客との長期的な信頼関係を構築できる方     Why Join KPay?  ・急成長中のグローバルFinTech企業でキャリアを築ける  ・顧客の成功に直接貢献できるやりがいのあるポジション  ・営業、プロダクト、オペレーションなど幅広い部門と連携できる  ・顧客の声をサービス改善につなげることができる  ・スピード感のある環境で成長機会が豊富     勤務条件  雇用形態  正社員  ※試用期間3ヶ月（条件変更なし）     勤務時間  フルフレックス制度  標準労働時間：1日8時間（休憩60分）     想定年収  ~450万円     休日・休暇  ・完全週休2日制（土日祝休み）  ・年間休日125日  ・有給休暇  ・夏季休暇  ・年末年始休暇  ・特別休暇     福利厚生  社会保険  ・健康保険  ・厚生年金保険  ・雇用保険  ・労災保険  各種手当  ・交通費支給（実費支給）     Equal Opportunity Employer  KPay では、採用・評価・昇進を含むすべての雇用機会において公平性を重視しています。  人種、国籍、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、年齢、障がいの有無等による差別を行わず、多様なバ  ックグラウンドを持つ人材を歓迎しています。

title: 【恵比寿】カスタマーサクセス（MM,EP,新規）◆経営管理SaaS「Diggle」◆リモート可
description: 【企業名】 ディグル株式会社  【職種名】 【恵比寿】カスタマーサクセス（MM,EP,新規）◆経営管理SaaS「Diggle」◆リモート可  【仕事内容(概要)】 【恵比寿】カスタマーサクセス（MM,EP,新規）◆経営管理SaaS「Diggle」◆リモート可  【具体的な仕事内容】 【業務概要】 当社において、企業の予実管理の課題を解決し続けることで、組織の距離を縮め、企業の未来の質を上げることへの貢献を期待します。 担当する顧客の属性（エンタープライズ・ミッドマーケット）やプロダクトのフェーズ（既存事業・新規事業）に応じ、顧客の経営課題解決と自社の事業成長にコミットしていただきます。 単なる操作説明ではなく、顧客のKPI達成を支援する「サクセスパートナー」として、以下の業務を推進していただきます。  【業務内容】 ◇オンボーディングと定着支援 顧客のゴールを定義し、最短距離でプロダクトを使いこなすための導入プロジェクトを推進する ◇管理会計のコンサルティング システム導入に留まらず、会計知見を活かして顧客の予実管理体制構築や業務プロセス改善に伴走し、管理会計における課題解決をする ◇LTVの最大化 定期的なヘルスチェックやデータ分析に基づき、追加機能や活用範囲の拡大を提案し、アップセル・クロスセルを実現する ◇CSプロセスの標準化・仕組み化 属人的な支援を脱し、成功事例の型化（マニュアル整備）や業務フローの自動化を通じて、組織全体の生産性を向上させる仕組みづくり ◇プロダクトフィードバック 顧客の声を収集・分析し、開発チームと連携してプロダクトの価値向上に繋げる ◇新規事業のPMF推進とサクセス仮説の検証 description: 【企業名】 ディグル株式会社  【職種名】 【恵比寿】カスタマーサクセス（新規事業）◆経営管理SaaS領域で急成長◆リモート可◆キャリアパス◎  【仕事内容(概要)】 【恵比寿】カスタマーサクセス（新規事業）◆経営管理SaaS領域で急成長◆リモート可◆キャリアパス◎  【具体的な仕事内容】 【業務概要】 新規プロダクトの初期導入顧客に対するカスタマーサクセス業務全般と、事業・プロダクト開発への最速のフィードバックループの構築を担っていただきます。 単なる操作説明にとどまらず、以下の業務を通じてPMF達成とサクセスの型化を推進していただきます。  【業務内容】 ◇新規事業のPMF推進とサクセス仮説の検証 新規プロダクトの初期導入顧客に対するオンボーディングを通じて、顧客の「本当の課題」を深く理解し、サクセスの仮説検証と初期の勝ちパターンを探索します。  ◇顧客フィードバックループの構築 顧客の声を収集・分析し、事業責任者やエンジニアと密に連携。「顧客の課題を解決する最短の機能は何か」の議論から参画し、市場からのフィードバックを即座にプロダクト開発へ反映させます。  ◇新規事業のCSプロセスの0→1構築 属人的な支援から再現性のあるオンボーディングの型化、CS業務の基盤構築をリードします。  ◇コンパウンド戦略におけるLTV最大化 将来的なマルチプロダクト展開を見据え、既存の「Diggle」基盤とのデータ連携や複数プロダクトを横断したクロスセルの機会創出、アップセル提案を行い、LTVを最大化します。  【ポジション魅力】 ◎CS起点でプロダクトを創り上げる「0.5→10」の事業開発体験 ・開発チーム（CTO/VPoP含む）と一体となり、CSが現場で得た一次情報をダイレクトにプロダクトへ還元。 ・「CSのフィードバックでプロダクトを完成に導く」本質的なPMF体験が得られます。  ◎「インテグリティを重んじる」環境で、顧客価値を定義 ・顧客伴走を通じて「誰が真の顧客であり、どこに勝ち筋があるのか」を定義する、事業の羅針盤となる役割を担います。  ◎経営管理のスペシャリティを身に着け、将来の「事業家（BizDev）」へと越境できるキャリア ・顧客のCFOや経営企画の方と対等に対話し、ロジカルに課題解決する高度なビジネススキルが身につきます。 title: Regional Servicechef
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla vår eftermarknadsaffär och leda en organisation med fokus på säkerhet, kundnöjdhet, medarbetarutveckling och lönsamhet? Nu söker vi en Regional Servicechef som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för regionens serviceverksamhet och bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling.   Det Här Erbjuder Vi    Om rollen   Som Regional Servicechef ansvarar du för att leda och utveckla regionens eftermarknadsaffär. Du har det övergripande ansvaret för att verksamheten når uppsatta mål inom säkerhet, kvalitet, kundnöjdhet, medarbetarengagemang och lönsamhet.  Du leder den regionala serviceorganisationen och arbetar aktivt för att utveckla både människor, arbetssätt och affärer.  Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med övriga regionala servicechefer för att driva utveckling och ständiga förbättringar inom affärsområdet. Rollen rapporterar till Country Manager Aftersales.  Du har i uppdraget ansvar för hela serviceorganisationen för Region Öst, vilket inkluderar åtta serviceledare och deras respektive team av servicetekniker.   Uppgifter Och Kvalifikationer     Leda, utveckla och följa upp den regionala serviceorganisationen.  Säkerställa att arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsarbetet bedrivs i enlighet med lagar, riktlinjer och interna krav.  Ansvara för regionens resultat inom servicemarknad samt rapportera och följa upp verksamhetens mål.  Budgetera, planera, genomföra och följa upp aktiviteter inom serviceområdet tillsammans med Country Manager Aftersales.  Aktivt utveckla servicemarknaden genom kundbesök, offertarbete, avtalsförhandlingar och kundvårdande aktiviteter.  Säkerställa hög servicegrad och ett starkt kundfokus i verksamheten.  Driva utveckling och effektivisering av rutiner, processer och arbetssätt.  Leda, coacha och utveckla underställda chefer och medarbetare.  Delta i och driva utvecklingsarbete tillsammans med övriga regionala servicechefer.  Ansvara för fordon inom servicemarknaden samt, i förekommande fall, fastigheter och verkstäder inom regionen.     Vem är du?   Vi söker dig som är en trygg, affärsdriven och inspirerande ledare med förmåga att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med ett operativt fokus. Du har ett genuint intresse för teknik, service och affärsutveckling och trivs i en roll där du skapar resultat genom andra.  Du är kommunikativ och relationsskapande, samtidigt som du är tydlig i ditt ledarskap och har modet att fatta beslut och hantera utmanande situationer.  För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:    Teknisk utbildning på minst gymnasial nivå.  Erfarenhet av personalansvar, kundarbete och affärsutveckling.  Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.  God system- och datorvana.  B-körkort. title: Head of Delivery
description: Cosa ti proponiamo?   All'interno del gruppo  Engineering , nell'area dedicata al prodotto MarketSuite, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di  Head of Delivery .  La risorsa assumerà la piena responsabilità operativa ed economica della macchina di erogazione verso il mercato:  36 FTE distribuiti su quattro funzioni  — Application Management Services, Delivery Management, Sviluppo/Delivery Tecnica e PreSales .Riporterà direttamente al BU Director e guiderà i quattro responsabili di funzione, garantendo la delivery delle soluzioni MarketSuite (e-commerce, order management, logistica, soluzioni in-store) ai clienti enterprise del settore. title: Customer Success Manager
description: I-care est le leader mondial de la maintenance prédictive et prescriptive. Nos solutions de surveillance d'état basées sur l'IA et guidées par les données prédisent les pannes industrielles avant tout le monde. Grâce à nos méthodes, produits et services innovants, nous gérons plus de 500 000 équipements et processus clients à travers le monde, en les aidant à réduire les risques pour une production plus sûre, plus efficace et plus durable. Fondée en 2004 et basée en Belgique, I-care emploie plus de 1 000 personnes et possède des bureaux dans plus de 20 pays (Europe, États-Unis et Asie). Elle a été nommée Entreprise de l'année 2020.  I-care recherche un(e) Customer Success Manager (CSM) expérimenté(e) pour incarner notre ambassadeur de « confiance technique » (Technical Trust). Vous veillerez à ce que les clients tirent la valeur maximale de nos solutions de maintenance prédictive, en stimulant la croissance organique et en faisant le pont entre les spécialistes en IA d'I-care et les opérations sur site.   Votre mission  Accompagner les clients depuis les projets pilotes initiaux jusqu'au déploiement à grande échelle à l'échelle de l'entreprise, tout en maintenant un taux de rétention de 100 % (Zero T-churn). Vous agirez en tant que consultant stratégique, aidant les clients à faire évoluer la maturité de leur maintenance industrielle.   Responsabilités principales        Partenariat stratégique :  Développer un réseau allant des techniciens d'usine aux cadres dirigeants (C-suite).    Traducteur technique :  Interpréter les données complexes relatives à l'IA et aux vibrations en informations exploitables pour le client.    Croissance et conversion :  Identifier les opportunités d'extension et piloter la conversion des projets pilotes en déploiements à grande échelle.    Excellence opérationnelle :  Gérer le suivi mensuel et les visites sur site (minimum 12 par trimestre).    Gestion de comptes :  Maintenir un cycle de réponse sous 24 heures et utiliser Monday.com/Teamleader pour suivre le ROI et les plans d'action pour 20 à 25 comptes clients.    Votre profil        Le consultant technique :  Vous comprenez les équipements industriels et maîtrisez le langage des ingénieurs en fiabilité.    Le créateur de valeur :  Vous vous concentrez sur le retour sur investissement (ROI), en veillant à ce que le client perçoive l'impact financier du partenariat.    Le facilitateur :  Proactif, organisé et capable de maintenir des exigences élevées à travers un portefeuille varié.    Qualifications requises        Expérience :  Une expérience avérée en tant que Customer Success Manager (CSM) est indispensable.    Langues :  Un niveau d'anglais C1 est requis pour les communications à fort enjeu.    Expertise :  Une formation ou expérience en maintenance industrielle, ingénierie de la fiabilité ou génie mécanique est essentielle.
