title: Customer Success Manager en santé
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.  Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.  Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.   ⚡  Notre équipe Customer Success    L’équipe Customer Success, composée de 6 CSM, accompagne les établissements de santé après le déploiement de nos solutions.  Son rôle : faire en sorte que les équipes hospitalières utilisent Lifen au bon niveau, dans la durée, et qu’elles en tirent un bénéfice concret au quotidien.  Tu rejoindras l’équipe en charge des établissements publics les plus stratégiques. Le portefeuille regroupe des organisations aux configurations, aux usages et aux contraintes très différents. Il faut comprendre rapidement ce qui se passe chez chaque client, repérer les signaux faibles et mobiliser les bonnes personnes, côté client comme chez Lifen.  Le poste couvre les trois produits Lifen Care déjà déployés chez nos clients. Tu ne prends pas en charge le déploiement technique, le support ou les renouvellements contractuels. Ton terrain de jeu commence une fois les solutions en place : adoption, qualité des usages, satisfaction et prévention des risques.    🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous      Prendre en main un portefeuille d’établissements de santé (~35 hôpitaux et cliniques) et construire, pour chacun, une lecture précise des usages, des interlocuteurs, des points de blocage et des opportunités.   Faire décoller l’adoption après le déploiement : former les équipes, vérifier les premiers usages, corriger ce qui freine la prise en main et rapprocher l’usage réel des objectifs définis avec le client.   À partir des données disponibles, identifier les comptes qui nécessitent une action. Baisse d’usage, configuration inadaptée, insatisfaction, évolution de l’organisation : tu transformes ces signaux en plans d’action concrets.   Animer la relation avec les référents et chefs de projet côté client. Cela passe par des échanges réguliers à distance et environ un à deux déplacements par mois dans les établissements. 「プロジェクト推進統括マネージャー候補」は、開発を専門部署に委ねつつ、クライアント、システム開発PM 、協力会社、そして社内の複数部門を横断しながら、大規模事務局案件や業務改革プロジェクト全体を文字通り「統括・牽引」する司令塔です。   ■業務詳細： ・顧客、システム開発PM、協力会社との折衝・調整 ・大規模事務局案件における、全体の進捗・品質・リスクの管理 ・業務フローや運営ルールの設計・改善の推進 ・プロジェクトにおける課題・リスクの早期把握、対応方針の策定および関係者との調整 ・複数部門や関係者を横断したリソース調整・体制構築（ほか、付随する業務全般）  ■プロジェクト具体例 ・官公庁案件の業務効率化支援 ・コールセンターシステムの構築・運用支援 ・上場企業システム保守業務委託案件  ■社内の雰囲気／魅力： 少数精鋭のため、役割を細かく分けるよりも、必要なことに自ら手を伸ばしてプロジェクトを前に進める文化があります。 代表・事業責任者と近い距離で意思決定に関われるため、案件推進だけでなく、提案や事業づくりの視点も身につけられます。 現時点のフェーズでは、整い切った環境で分業された仕事をするというより、顧客課題に向き合いながら、自ら論点を整理し、周囲を巻き込み、形にしていくことを歓迎する組織です。 title: Payroll Implementation Consultant
description: Join TimeFiler, leading provider of online timesheeting, rostering, and leave solutions!   Competitive salary, great team, permanent role  Office-based in Riccarton, with occasional Australian travel      TimeFiler is looking for an experienced Implementation Consultant to join a small, specialist team delivering complex workforce management solutions to clients across Australia and New Zealand.       What our client can offer:    TimeFiler has an established presence in Australasia, supporting over 800 clients and 150,000 employees. The company offers a stable and growing work environment with a strong focus on innovation and customer service. Employees benefit from a supportive and collaborative workplace with opportunities to influence company marketing strategies and client engagement approaches. Professional growth is encouraged, with exposure to a variety of industries and business operations.     As a result of internal growth, TimeFiler is looking for an experienced Implementation Consultant to join their team. This is a customer-facing role responsible for onboarding and implementing TimeFiler's timesheet, rostering, leave, and payroll integration solutions with a particular focus on complex, compliance-heavy clients in Australia and New Zealand.       What you will do:    Working closely with the Australian Implementation Lead, this role is ideal for someone who thrives in a structured, methodical environment, enjoys solving complex problems with clients, and is comfortable working across time zones and travelling periodically (days not weeks) to Australia.     You can expect to be working across:   Leading end-to-end system implementation projects for new and existing clients, from initial scoping through to go-live and post-launch support  Working directly with clients to understand their operational and payroll requirements, including complex rostering arrangements, shift patterns, and Enterprise Bargaining Agreements (EBAs)  Configuring and test TimeFiler against client-specific requirements, ensuring accuracy before handover  Translating complex client needs — including requirements that clients may struggle to clearly articulate — into well-structured implementation plans  Delivering training and support to ensure confident adoption of the system      You will serve as a calm, reliable point of contact through the implementation lifecycle, managing expectations and keeping projects on track, as well as Identifying opportunities where clients could benefit from additional TimeFiler functionality or service (without a hard sales focus)       Skills and experience we are looking for:    We are looking for proven experience in system implementation, ideally within workforce management, payroll, or HR software. Experience working with Australian payroll — including EBA interpretation, award compliance, and complex rostering — is highly desirable, even if from some time ago. title: Project Manager - IT
description: General Information   Ref #  235268   Location:  Qatar-Doha   Job family:  Corporate & Commercial   Closing Date:   2026-09-14   Description    Job Purpose:   This role will be responsible for managing and successfully deliver assigned IT projects and solutions in compliance with the project standards and processes of the QR IT, to meet defined business requirements within agreed timescales and cost. Lead the Projects throughout the project phases from initiation to closure, technical delivery, support and enhancement of the complete solution. title: Implementation Engineer / Senior Implementation Engineer
description: Description   Collaborate with project managers and clients to understand project scope, objectives, and timelines.     Develop detailed implementation plans, including timelines, resource requirements, and risk assessments.   Prepare and configure the necessary software and hardware environments for implementation.   Install and configure software solutions according to client specifications and project requirements.   Customize software settings and parameters to align with the client’s business processes and needs.   Integrate software with existing systems and databases, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.   Conduct thorough testing of the implemented solution to ensure it meets functional, performance, and security requirements.   Identify and resolve any technical issues or bugs that arise during the testing phase.   Work closely with quality assurance teams to ensure that the solution is fully functional and ready for deployment.   Provide training to clients and end-users on how to use the implemented software effectively.   Create user guides, documentation, and training materials to support client onboarding and usage.   Offer ongoing technical support to clients during and after the implementation process, addressing any questions or issues.   Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, QA, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.   Communicate regularly with clients to provide updates on implementation progress and address any concerns.     Requirements     Strong understanding of software development and integration, includingproficiency in programming languages, APIs, and databases to effectivelyimplement and troubleshoot solutions.  Ability to analyze complex issues, identify root causes, and develop effectivesolutions, ensuring seamless implementation and minimal disruption to clientoperations.  Excellent interpersonal skills to work with cross-functional teams and clients,clearly conveying technical information and gathering requirements to ensuresuccessful project delivery.     Experience   5-7 years Relevant experience in software implementation, project management, ortechnical support, in a similar role.   Education   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.   Language   Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.  Licenses / Certifications: SCE

title: Product Manager Enterprise Systems
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.   About The Role   Are you a tech-savvy Oracle platform strategist?  This role presents an opportunity to own the technical mastery of Oracle ERP, EPM, OCI, and PaaS/IaaS - driving seamless integration, performance, and security while ensuring scalability and efficiency!  You'll be responsible of managing Oracle ERP/EPM Technical/Enterprise products and delivery which include but are not limited to Oracle Fusion reports, integrations, customisation, extensions, workflow, Oracle OCI, and Oracle PaaS/IaaS.  From Fusion reports to custom workflows, you'll optimise enterprise systems, enhance compliance, and transform complex technical requirements into simple solutions without compromising scalability, security, or performance.  Success in this role includes strong relationship management skills as you are expected to act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment.  Are you ready to drive innovation and elevate Oracle solutions in our dynamic world of aviation ?   About You   Degree qualified, you must demonstrate a minimum of 7 years of experience in Oracle technical solutions, particularly in OCI, PaaS, and IaaS.  Naturally, you will possess a strong background in system integrations and reporting. Further, a solid understanding of Oracle ERP/EPM, including Fusion RICEW is critical.  We’d love to hear from you even more if you can demonstrate knowledge of emerging technologies such as Oracle FDI, AI, and Digital Assistance.  This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down

title: Working Student Brand Ambassador (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

As our Working Student Brand Ambassador, you bring Mushroots directly to the people. Our products sit in the premium segment, and first-time buyers need to taste them before they commit. You make that happen — at supermarkets, festivals, trade fairs, and on our sampling bike across Hamburg.

  • Plan and coordinate tastings with supermarkets, festivals, and trade fairs independently
  • Run tastings end-to-end: set up the stand, engage with customers, break down, and clean all equipment

  • Track and share feedback from tastings to help the team understand what resonates with customers


Your profile

  • Currently enrolled at a university (any field of study)
  • German C1, English B2 or above
  • You enjoy approaching people you've never met and starting a conversation
  • Self-starter who plans, coordinates, and executes without needing step-by-step guidance
  • Valid driver's license (Class B)
  • Comfortable with a physical role: carrying equipment, standing for extended periods, cycling the sampling bike
  • Previous experience as a promoter or in event sampling is a plus, not a requirement
  • Genuine interest in Mushroots products and what Infinite Roots stands for


Our Benefits:

  • Dynamic and diverse mission-driven team from more than 20 different countries
  • A fast growing company with opportunities for personal development
  • Flexible working hours with entitled Home Office days in an innovative and agile working environment 
  • Gym Membership, language classes or an attractive alternative from our benefit program
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths
  • Great team events such as “lunch & learn”, “Demo Day”, cultural celebrations and food tastings

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

description: Graneet   est une plateforme SaaS qui facilite le quotidien des dirigeants de la construction en leur donnant accès à un pilotage précis de leur activité pour optimiser leur marge et éviter aussi les faillites. Nos clients sont les meilleurs ambassadeurs de notre solution, regarde 👀   ici   les avis qu’ils laissent sur nous !  Avec plus d'un millier de clients et une quarantaine de collaborateurs, nous avons besoin de renfort pour nous aider à accompagner la croissance de Graneet en France 🇫🇷 !      🤝 L'équipe 🤝   L’accompagnement client qui est proposé par l’équipe Customer Success est un argument de taille mis en avant par notre équipe commerciale auprès des prospects ! Elle est structurée ainsi :   Un pôle Onboarding : l’équipe gère la prise en main des clients avec notre plateforme jusqu’à l’activation de nos clients  Un pôle Customer Success : l'équipe pilote la relation client dans la durée, travaille à l'adoption du produit et favorise l'engagement, anticipe les risques de churn, et identifie les opportunités de croissance  Un pôle Care : l'équipe est le premier point de contact de nos utilisateurs, elle traite chaque demande avec réactivité et s'assure qu'aucun sujet ne reste sans réponse   Nous recherchons une nouvelle recrue dans l'équipe Onboarding de  Nicolas , Team Lead Onboarding et tu travailleras étroitement avec  Elisa  et  Margot .      🎯 Tes missions 🎯       Customer Activation    Après un brief de l’Account Executive qui a vendu l’abonnement à Graneet, tu deviens l’interlocuteur de confiance du nouveau client et de ses équipes.  Dès le premier jour, tu mets en place une stratégie de déploiement mid-touch qui permettra au client d’atteindre ses objectifs.  Paramétrage, formations, import de données : tu mobilises toutes les ressources nécessaires pour assurer le bon déroulement de l’onboarding.    Suivi de l'Activation    Tu mesures les indicateurs d’activation de ton portefeuille clients et tu mets en place les actions nécessaires pour accélérer le  Time To Value.   Lorsque le client est pleinement opérationnel, assurer un transfert de dossier clair et structuré vers les équipes Customer Success en charge du suivi long terme.    Enrichissement du Produit    Maintenir une communication régulière avec le client pour s’assurer de sa satisfaction.  Recueillir les retours d’expérience pour identifier les axes d’amélioration du produit.  Transmettre les feedbacks pertinents aux équipes Produit et Développement.    Documentation et support    Tu contribues à structurer et améliorer les étapes de l’onboarding pour nos clients sur les différents plans avec le reste de l’équipe.  Tu participes ponctuellement au support client (1 demie-journée par mois).       💎Profil recherché 💎       Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que Customer Success Manager avec une dominante sur l’onboarding.  Tu as travaillé dans un environnement SaaS, idéalement B2B.  Tu sais convaincre et embarquer tes interlocuteurs : le  change

title: Solutions Transitie en Implementatiemanager
description: Securitas ontwikkelt zich als solutions-gedreven organisatie met als doel wereldwijd marktleider te zijn in Security Solutions. Vanuit Solutions Delivery realiseert de organisatie complexe integrale beveiligingsoplossingen waarin technologie, mobiele surveillance, monitoring en beveiliging samenkomen. De afdeling vormt de schakel tussen sales, operatie en klant en is verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van deze oplossingen. Door de groei van de dienstverlening, de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en de toenemende impact op de organisatie is deze functie ontstaan. De internationale Solutions-organisatie biedt daarnaast interessante doorgroeimogelijkheden.  Als Solutions Transitie- en Implementatiemanager maak je deel uit van de afdeling Solutions Delivery. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van integrale beveiligingsoplossingen bij strategische klanten. Deze oplossingen bestaan uit een combinatie van technologie, monitoring, mobiele surveillance, manbeveiliging en aanvullende security services, afgestemd op de specifieke risico's, dreigingen en bedrijfsprocessen van de klant.  Je bent al betrokken tijdens de salesfase en neemt na opdrachtverstrekking de regie over het implementatietraject. Je fungeert als centraal aanspreekpunt voor zowel klanten als interne stakeholders, valideert de ontwikkelde oplossing, stelt projectplannen op en zorgt voor een succesvolle overdracht naar de operationele organisatie. In deze rol ligt de nadruk op regievoering: je brengt commerciële, operationele en technische disciplines samen, stemt belangen af en zorgt ervoor dat alle betrokken partijen effectief samenwerken aan een succesvolle implementatie van de overeengekomen oplossing.  Bij wijzigingen in klantwensen of projectscope analyseer je de impact op zowel de klantorganisatie als Securitas. Je signaleert risico's, stuurt tijdig bij en zorgt ervoor dat projecten gecontroleerd, beheerst en succesvol verlopen.   Daarnaast Ben Je Verantwoordelijk Voor     Planning, kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en risicobeheersing  Bewaking van financiële kaders  Realisatie van contractuele afspraken, KPI’s en SLA’s  Transparante rapportages richting klanten en interne stakeholders  Je signaleert verbeterkansen in processen, dienstverlening en samenwerking en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van Solutions Delivery  Kennis van en ervaring me project methoden  Minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding en relevante werkervaring  Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe implementatie-, transitie- of deliveryprojecten  Ervaring met multi-service deliveryprocessen en multidisciplinaire implementatietrajecten  Ervaring met KPI’s, SLA’s en contractafspraken  Affiniteit met de securitywereld en techniek  Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen  Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en verandertrajecten  Deze rol past

title: Deployment Strategist
description: What You'll Do    As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.  Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.  This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.    Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.   Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.   Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.   Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.   Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.   Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.   Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.   Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage.   Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.     You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.    Why Should You      You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest-growing startup in Europe.   Work on a cutting-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now.   You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.   Never boring - you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.       Who You Are      Experience in deployment-focused, technical, or execution-oriented roles.   Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.   Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, and system integrations.   Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.   High ownership mindset and bias toward action.   Interest in building and deploying AI-powered systems in real environments.       Nice To Have      Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward-deployed roles.   Prior hands-on engineering experience.   Experience supporting production software launches.   Experience working in high-growth or early-stage environments.       Why This Role Exists    Enterprises are ready to use AI, but execution is the hard part.  This role exists to bridge that gap. You will help customers deploy AI agents

description:
Headquarters:  Remote, Japan, APAC
 

  From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.      About Us    
  Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.  
  Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.  
  As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.  
   About The Role   
  We’re looking for a Commercial Business Development Representative to join our team! In this role you will work closely with your Account Executives, Marketing and Partner teams to ensure  Japan  builds strong opportunities in key target accounts. Your responsibilities will include outbound calling, video prospecting, crafting compelling messaging as well as qualifying leads to start high quality conversations for your AEs.

The New Business BDR at Fivetran is a key strategic position housed within the Marketing organization but operates in close collaboration with the GTM Sales Org.  
  The role focuses on strategically identifying key decision makers, mapping large enterprise or commercial accounts and generating meetings across all levels within Fortune 100 companies. With a focus on breaking into new business accounts, the BDR team contributes to hitting new logo acquisition targets, generating crucial pipeline momentum for Fivetran’s success.  
  This base + uncapped commission New Business BDR position offers a clear growth path and competitive total compensation.  
   This is a full-time position based remotely out of Japan.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
Senior Software Engineer, Agents
description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur.   • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) – Teilprojektleitung
description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und technische Verantwortung für mehrere Teilprojekte, damit diese pünktlich und den Qualitätsvorgaben entsprechend geliefert werden.
  • Du stimmst dich über diese Teilprojekte mit dem Team Lead, Projektmanager, den anderen Teilprojekten und verschiedenen Ansprechpartnern beim Kunden ab.
  • Du nimmst aktiv Einfluss auf die Planung und Steuerung aller Teilprojekte, um den erfolgreichen Abschluss des Gesamtprojektes sicherzustellen.
  • Du arbeitest übergreifend an der Architektur und Ausrichtung des Gesamtprojektes mit und bringst neue Impulse ins Team.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Systeme und entwickelst Lösungen zur Modernisierung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst neue Software-Komponenten auf Basis von Java (z. B. mit Quarkus).
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst synchrone (z. B. REST/JSON) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (z. B. Kafka) in bestehende Systemlandschaften.
  • Du wirkst aktiv bei Systemintegration sowie Integrations- und Systemtests mit.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Fachbereichen in technischen und fachlichen Abstimmungen zusammen.
  • Du planst und begleitest Sprints (Planning, Reviews) im agilen Umfeld.
  • Du erstellst und priorisierst User Stories gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du an fachlichen Anforderungen mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ca. 5+ Jahre) in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java
  • Erfahrung im IT-Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Steuerung von Teilprojekten im agilen Umfeld
  • Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL, DB2)
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Testframeworks (z. B. JUnit, Mockito, WireMock)
  • Vertrautheit mit modernen Entwicklungsprozessen

Du gestaltest E-Commerce-Erlebnisse, die Kunden begeistern und die Conversion messbar verbessern? Du denkst in durchgängigen User Journeys, hast einen scharfen Blick für UX/UI-Details und suchst eine Rolle mit voller Ownership für den Shop?

title: Automation Engineer (gn) - 40 Std, (hybrid) (München)
description:

title: System Engineer / Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - 3rd Level
description:

Für einen Managed Service Provider aus Lübeck – Teil eines bundesweit wachsenden IT-Netzwerks – suche ich Verstärkung fürs Technik-Team. title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
  • Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
  • Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. About ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

title: Software Engineer Linux OS (m/w/d)
description:
Dein Ziel

Als Software Engineer Linux OS bist Du verantwortlich für das Betriebssystem unseres Gateways. Du gestaltest die Grundlage für ein sicheres, stabiles und skalierbares Ökosystem, das den Betrieb, die Überwachung und Aktualisierung unserer Geräteflotte ermöglicht. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unsere Anwendungen und trägst aktiv zur Digitalisierung der Energienetze bei!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und wartest ein sicheres und modulares Linux-Betriebssystem für unsere Gateways.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Frameworks und Schnittstellen zur Überwachung und Aktualisierung der Geräteflotte.
  • Du integrierst Lösungen zur Geräteidentifikation, -authentifizierung und -autorisierung, um höchste Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungsworkflows mit, z. B. Versionskontrolle mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisiertes Testing und Code Reviews.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Linux-Betriebssystemen und Softwarearchitekturen bringst Du mit.
  • Der Umgang mit Tools wie Yocto zur Erstellung und Anpassung von Linux-Distributionen ist dir vertraut.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in aktuellen Programmiersprachen wie C++ und Python
  • Im Bereich Docker und Containerisierung verfügst du über sehr gute Kenntnisse.
  • Mit der Konzeption sicherer Systeme, z. B. durch Threat Modelling

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
⭐️ Your Impact:

The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't
last.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool
to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard
to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real
leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working.

These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging.

That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker.

That's what this role is for.

What you'll do

You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team -
and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the
thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day.

- Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know
  our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've
  stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed.
- Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter
  screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs.
- Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer
  real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability,
  evaluation, structured output, graceful failure.
- Decide what to build.

title: Teammanager Klantenservice
description: Hoe maak jij onze klanten blij?   Als Teammanager Klantenservice binnen De Service Hub zorg je ervoor dat klanten vandaag goed geholpen worden én dat de klantenservice van morgen steeds slimmer, beter en mensgerichter wordt. Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 20 Service Experts en speelt daarnaast een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van processen, samenwerking en kwaliteit. Met jouw coachende stijl, scherpe blik en gevoel voor operatie help je niet alleen je team vooruit, maar versterk je ook de dienstverlening als geheel.   De grootste uitdaging   De Service Hub is binnen bol dé plek waar vernieuwing in klantcontact tastbaar wordt. Nieuwe processen, systemen en werkwijzen worden hier vaak als eerste getest, aangescherpt en gevalideerd. Dat maakt deze rol breder dan alleen operationeel leidinggeven.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse performance van je team, maar kijkt ook continu vooruit: wat kan slimmer, beter of menselijker? Daarom zoeken we geen manager die alleen op output stuurt, maar iemand die ontwikkeling stimuleert, eigenaarschap vergroot en samen met anderen bouwt aan blijvend betere service.   Wat je doet   Je combineert people management met procesverbetering en kwaliteitssturing. Je helpt medewerkers groeien, creëert een omgeving waarin feedback en ontwikkeling centraal staan en zorgt dat jouw team stevig staat in een dynamische serviceomgeving.  Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met andere teammanagers, specialisten en projectteams om inzichten uit de praktijk te vertalen naar verbeteringen die verder reiken dan je eigen team.   Waarom jij het verschil kunt maken      Je coacht en ontwikkelt Service Experts, zowel individueel als op teamniveau, zodat zij met vertrouwen en eigenaarschap hun werk kunnen doen.   Je creëert een veilige en open werkomgeving waarin samenwerken, leren en feedback centraal staan.   Je monitort prestaties, kwaliteit en klantfeedback en vertaalt signalen naar concrete verbeteracties.   Je draagt samen met je team bij aan pilots en verbeterinitiatieven rondom processen, systemen en klantcontact.   Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de operatie binnen grotere, bol-brede projecten en helpt mee aan toekomstbestendige service.   Je werkt intensief samen met andere teammanagers en specialisten om de afdeling als geheel sterker te maken.     Hier kom je terecht   Je komt terecht in De Service Hub in Utrecht: een omgeving waar klantcontact, innovatie en ontwikkeling samenkomen. Hier wordt continu getest, geleerd en verbeterd. Dat vraagt om mensen die nieuwsgierig zijn, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en graag samenwerken.  Je werkt hybride, met minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Woensdag is de vaste kantoordag binnen De Service Hub. Omdat de klantenservice 7 dagen per week bereikbaar is van 08.00 tot 23.00 uur, draai je ook avond- en weekenddiensten en maak je samen met de andere teammanagers het rooster.   Something for you?     Als je...: energie krijgt van het coachen en ontwikkelen van mensen en tea

description:

We buy and build companies that help people find and buy the products they love. Our portfolio includes leading fashion marketplaces like Italist, HEWI and Verishop, affiliate marketing platforms like Stylight and MyBestBrands, B2B technology solutions like Bonsai, and niche Marketplaces in the Creator and Construction spaces like Everpress and DOZR.

About the Role

We’re looking for someone to join us as a Summer Intern (Ecommerce Operations) on our Italist luxury fashion marketplace.

Throughout the summer you will pilot a number of projects we have in our backlog, testing and experimenting to see what works (that we'll then invest in long-term) vs. what doesn't. You'll have the opportunity to leverage AI in your work, and to develop your skillset across Account Management, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Pricing Strategy and Data Analysis/Business Intelligence.

This is a hands-on role - you will not be building decks and plans, you'll be taking project briefs and doing the actual work. This is full-time over the summer, and has the opportunity to convert to full-time or part-time after the internship. We are open to both current students, new grads, and folks making a career pivot or returning from a leave.

This is a full-time, remote-first role in Canada, the UK or the EU.

  • Piloting Projects: we have a backlog of projects we're looking to pilot across the business — you'll take project briefs, launch new initiatives quickly, iterate based on data, and then present your results so we can decide what to double-down on vs. what to pass on for now.

title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

Additionally, you will collaborate across departments to identify and resolve subscription-related product bugs/issues. People who are detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about providing exceptional customer service will feel right at home on this team.

  • Resolve delicate customer billing situations, including compensation requests.
  • Gather details for credit and refund requests and handle finance-related inquiries.
  • Analyze billing ticket trends and propose improvements to enhance the customer experience.
  • Contribute to billing support articles and tutorials to expand internal and external knowledge base.
  • Participate in task-force projects and assist with the end-of-the-month processes as needed.

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • Previous experience in billing support, subscription management, or customer service.

  • Darüber hinaus planen und betreuen Sie Prototypen und Versuchsreihen, werten Ergebnisse aus und begleiten die Weiterentwicklung bis zur Serienreife
  • Zusätzlich wählen und qualifizieren Sie geeignete Komponenten und Teilsysteme, führen technische Risikoanalysen durch und erstellen die erforderliche Dokumentation

  • Erforderlich sind praktische Kenntnisse in der Konzeption, Auslegung und Realisierung komplexer verfahrenstechnischer Systeme sowie in der Planung und Auswertung von Versuchen

title: Business Ops Intern - People & Culture (f/m/x)
description:
Become a part of the 4screen team!

As a Business Ops Intern – People & Culture at 4screen, you will support our team across the full employee lifecycle – from recruiting and onboarding to offboarding and beyond. You'll help optimize P&C processes, support P&C administration and contract creation, and strengthen our company culture through initiatives like team events and employer branding. In addition, you'll support taking care of our office environment, ensuring it remains a welcoming space for collaboration and wellbeing. As part of our broader Business Operations team, you'll also gain exposure to various cross-functional projects along the way, gaining valuable insights into a dynamic and innovative workplace.

Tasks

You will contribute to our success by:

  • Supporting recruiting and hiring: You help manage job boards, monitor and respond to our recruiting inbox, and support candidates through the hiring process, including efforts to streamline our recruitment process.
  • Shaping onboarding and offboarding: You own key parts of the onboarding and offboarding admin process, keep our onboarding materials up to date, support exit interviews, and help create employment references.
  • Driving P&C administration and contracts: You support contract creation, help optimize internal and company-wide processes using AI and automation, and help collect and maintain personnel data in our P&C system (Personio).
  • Strengthening employee experience and culture: You contribute to internal communication formats and employer branding and help organize regular team and company initiatives that strengthen cohesion and team spirit.
  • Managing our office: You support day-to-day office management and help shape an office environment where the team feels comfortable

title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
description:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d).


Was Sie bei uns bewegen:

  • Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen

  • Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen

title: Senior Product Designer - Platform and Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join the Partner and Platform Experience (PPX) team. You'll tackle problems where social dynamics, device ecosystems, and technical constraints intersect. It's work that demands systems thinking, deep comfort with technical complexity, and a drive to make complex interactions feel simple and engaging.


What You'll Do

  • Design experiences that help listeners share moments together and move effortlessly between the devices and platforms around them.

  • Own complex design problems from early exploration through execution, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and product opportunities.

  • Create thoughtful, polished user experiences with a strong focus on interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make an experience feel intuitive.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to understand the technology behind the experience and turn complex systems into simple experiences for listeners.

  • Explore how experiences scale across mobile, desktop, TVs, speakers, cars, and other surfaces in the Spotify ecosystem.

  • Use prototyping to explore, communicate, and test ideas, including AI-assisted and code-based approaches where they help us learn faster.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions.

While legacy insurance environments are often hindered by rigidity, we aim to deliver a programmable, version-controlled architecture that empowers engineers and autonomous systems to operate with high efficiency and safety.

In your capacity as an Engineering Manager (f/m/d/x), you will lead the development of our core platform and engineering culture. Your focus will be on building high-performing, autonomous teams, fostering technical excellence, and aligning engineering execution with strategic business goals to drive the delivery of our next-generation financial infrastructure.

This position represents a unique nexus of platform engineering, sophisticated domain modeling, and the next generation of AI-driven software development.

WHAT YOU WILL BE CHALLENGED WITH

  • Leading and developing a team of software engineers working on distributed microservices in a fast-paced SaaS environment

title: Senior Manager, Social Media Management
description:
Short title

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.


Your tasks

  • You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results

  • You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand

  • You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH

  • You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality

Cross-Sell, Replenishment, Winback) und hebst so systematisch Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value. description: Over Shiftbase   Shiftbase bouwt de self-driving assistent voor bedrijven die in shifts werken. Daarom bouwen we software die steeds meer werk uit handen neemt, zodat onze klanten minder tijd kwijt zijn aan administratie en meer tijd overhouden voor hun mensen en hun bedrijf.  Een klant binnenhalen is pas het begin. Succes betekent dat klanten snel live zijn, het platform actief gebruiken en hun inzet van Shiftbase stap voor stap uitbreiden.  Je beheert een portefeuille klanten van begin tot eind. Je helpt klanten snel en succesvol live, zorgt dat ze het maximale uit Shiftbase halen en ziet op tijd waar extra aandacht nodig is. Je werkt op basis van klantsignalen, zodat je tijd investeert waar die de meeste impact heeft.   Wat je gaat doen    Klanten succesvol live brengen.  Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten van de eerste implementatie tot een succesvolle livegang. Je adviseert over de inrichting, configureert de omgeving, verzorgt de technische onboarding en zorgt dat teams met vertrouwen aan de slag kunnen.   Je eigen klantenportefeuille beheren.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een vaste groep klanten en weet wat er bij hen speelt. Je houdt zicht op gebruik, klanttevredenheid en verlengingen en zorgt ervoor dat je portfolio gezond blijft.   Werken op basis van klantsignalen.  Je werkt niet simpelweg een bellijst af. Je gebruikt data en signalen uit het product om te bepalen welke klanten op dat moment jouw aandacht nodig hebben en waar je de meeste impact kunt maken.   Churn voorkomen voordat het een probleem wordt.  Je herkent risico's vroeg, gaat het gesprek aan om de oorzaak te begrijpen en onderneemt actie voordat een klant afhaakt.   Accounts laten groeien.  Je ziet waar extra functionaliteiten of add-ons waarde kunnen toevoegen, bespreekt die mogelijkheden met de klant en zorgt dat commerciële kansen niet blijven liggen.   De stem van de klant vertegenwoordigen.  Je deelt terugkerende feedback en productbehoeften met Product, zorgt samen met Sales voor een soepele overdracht en helpt Marketing met inzichten die relevant zijn voor bestaande klanten. If you are currently one of several commercial leaders inside a large business, this is the job where you build the entire thing instead.    What Appetise does We help FMCG brands sell more.  Around 80% of new product launches die within 12-18 months, mostly because brands are guessing. They have no real visibility into how people actually shop, and no system for turning that into better decisions.  We have spent four years collecting genuine behavioural shopping data, and we turn it into two things brands pay for. A performance advertising channel that only charges them when we drive an actual sale in a supermarket, which is a first in this category. And an insights product that tells them what to build next.  The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. This is a company in active build-mode: fast-scaling, still shaping its own structures, and defined by the ambition to make software the center of gravity in trucking.   Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform's value in the eyes of the customer.  This is where the Customer Success Manager comes in. You are the person who holds the customer relationship end-to-end, deeply representing your customer's interests, building the commercial and business rationale for their engagement with the platform, and making sure that rationale is heard by the people who shape the platform. The Customer Success Manager keeps their ears & eyes close to the customer organization, actively owning and driving the customer relationship to ensure a successful SDV platform in its rollout and operation.   The Value You Bring     You turn a structural relationship into a working partnership, so the customer feels heard, represented, and commercially engaged, not just serviced.  You manage expectations proactively around a product that's still being built, keeping the customer aligned and confident even as scope and timelines evolve.  You uncover customer needs early and turn them into concrete business opportunit
