title: Field Support Manager, Nordics
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: As a Field Support Manager, you will lead and support our Field Support Representatives (FSR) across the Nordics, helping them deliver an excellent experience for our Companion Animal Group (CAG) customers. This is a field-based role, ideally located in the Nordics (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark), with around 50% travel to visit teams and customers.  The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feedback into product and process improvements.     Why This Role Matters   Our Field Support Representatives are often the face of IDEXX for our customers — the people who install, train and troubleshoot the instruments that help vets diagnose and treat companion animals every day. As Field Support Manager, you'll be at the heart of ensuring that team performs at its best, directly shaping the experience our customers have with IDEXX and supporting the continued growth of our European operations.   What You Need To Succeed     5-7+ years of related work experience, with in-depth experience in a supervised field or business support environment.  3+ years of supervisory experience, or a combination of supervisory and relevant product knowledge.  Experience supervising remote, multi-site teams.  Strong project management and change management experience.  Big-picture thinking, with strong reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Driftsleder inden for Facility Management med fokus på rengøring og deskfunktion til Danmarks smukkeste arbejdsplads
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for en vigtig driftsfunktion på en af Danmarks mest unikke arbejdspladser? Vi søger en engageret driftsleder, der kan udvikle medarbejdere, sikre høj kvalitet og skabe en velfungerende hverdag inden for rengøring, deskfunktion og postservice på Kastellet.   Om Os   Etablissement –og Terrænkommandoen har hovedkontor i Hjørring, men har medarbejdere i hele landet.  Vi leverer og udvikler de fysiske rammer for de militære operative enheder og de øvrige myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vi sikrer varme og vand, udfører bygningsvedligeholdelse, mindre reparationer, driftsopgaver og meget, meget mere.  Mange af opgaverne løses fra 28 af de største arbejdssteder i hele landet.  Vi håndterer alt fra brugerhenvendelser og indkøb til arrangementsstøtte og bygningsvedligehold.  Etablissementspartnerelementet i Kastellet er tjenestestedets og brugernes primære indgangsvinkel til rekvirering af ydelser hos Etablissement –og Terrænkommandoen  Etablissementspartnerelementet består af i alt 35 medarbejdere med baggrund inden for administration, bygningsvedligehold, rengøring eller tekniske installationer. Alle arbejder tæt sammen, så der sikres en lokal støtte til brugerne, Vores bygningsmasse indeholder kontorfaciliteter, hotelindkvartering, beboelse og møde/undervisningsfaciliteter.  I vores partnerelement varetager vi drift af Kastellet og Nyboder, samt lejede faciliteter i København   Om Jobbet   Dine primære ansvarsområder  Som driftsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af vores medarbejdere inden for rengøring, deskfunktion og postservice. Du skaber retning, motiverer medarbejderne og sikrer, at vores serviceleverancer lever op til høje kvalitetsstandarder.   Du Vil Blandt Andet Få Ansvar For At   Udøve nærværende og motiverende personaleledelse med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og engagement.  Planlægge og afholde personalemøder, teammøder og løbende 1:1-samtaler med medarbejderne.  Sikre den daglige bemanding og effektiv planlægning af driften.  Følge op på kvaliteten af serviceleverancerne og sikre, at vores brugere oplever en professionel, imødekommende og ensartet service.  Arbejde systematisk med kvalitetskontrol, løbende forbedringer og optimering af arbejdsgange.  Sikre, at deadlines, aftaler og serviceniveauer overholdes, og tage ansvar for at følge op på opgaverne.  Samarbejde tæt med interne kunder, brugere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere for at sikre en velfungerende hverdag.  Håndtere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og træffe beslutninger, der sikrer en stabil og effektiv drift.  Vi søger en leder, der går forrest, kommunikerer tydeligt, skaber tillid og formår at kombinere fokus på mennesker med et skarpt blik for kvalitet, struktur og resultater.  Der vil forekomme aktivitet rundt i landet til alle etablissementerne og herved vil en del af arbejdet ligge uden for normal arbejdstid.   Om Dig   Faglige kvalifikationer   Vi forventer, at du har en stærk faglig profil og erfaring med etablissementsdri

title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description: Our Product, Engineering and Design teams are evolving how they work as we grow, bring our products closer together and make greater use of AI and automation.     As part of that, we’re moving closer to the “product operating model”, giving teams better customer and product insights, enabling decisions closer to the work and creating stronger connections between strategy, discovery and delivery, etc.  That’s why we’re hiring our first Product Operations Manager. You’ll build the function and shape how it develops over time.     You’ll work closely with Henrik, our VP of Product, and partner with leaders and teams across Product, Engineering, Design and the wider business. You won’t inherit a finished Product Operations setup. You’ll identify where dedicated support can create the greatest leverage, build on what already works, and establish an approach that fits Zensai. This is an enablement role: you’ll improve the information, systems and operating rhythm around product work without taking craft or product decisions away from the teams that own them.      What You’ll Be Doing    Create clarity and alignment across Product, Engineering and Design.  Bring customer feedback, product usage and business data together so teams can identify the right problems, test ideas earlier and make informed product decisions.  Improve how teams prioritise, plan roadmaps, run discovery and coordinate work across Product, Engineering and Design  Take ownership of the tools and shared practices that support product discovery, feedback, insights and delivery  Connect product initiatives to business and financial impact, including supporting CAPEX/OPEX reporting  Find practical ways to use AI, agents and automation across discovery and delivery, reducing recurring operational work and helping reshape how product work gets done.       What Success Looks Like    Teams can easily find and use the customer, product and business information they need  Product decisions have a clear rationale, and teams can see how customers respond to what we build  Prioritisation, roadmapping and cross-functional work become more consistent and easier to navigate  AI and automation deliver improvements that teams can see and measure        What You Bring    You have strong experience in Product Operations, Product Management or a related role, including building or improving how product teams work.  You’ve worked in a mature product organisation and can use that experience to build an approach that fits Zensai  You’re comfortable working with customer, product and business data, including how data is captured and moves between systems  You have practical experience using AI, agents or automation to improve product work  You can bring people with different priorities together and influence decisions without formal authority.  You work confidently and independently in an international organisation and communicate clearly in English.       If you enjoy improving how good teams work toget

title: Palvelupäällikkö palkkapalveluihin
description: Viimeinen hakupäivä: 20. syyskuuta 2026    Hybridi     Työn kuvaus   Yhdistä ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen.   Me Aspialla olemme talous- ja palkkahallinnon edelläkävijöitä. Uteliaisuus, kasvu ja jatkuva kehittyminen ohjaavat tekemistämme – haluamme olla askeleen edellä niin osaamisessa kuin asiakaskokemuksessa. Avoin ja joustava työympäristömme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiantuntijana.   Sytytkö ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvun rakentamisesta?    Me Aspialla olemme asiantuntijayhteisö, joka seisoo rohkeiden kasvajien rinnalla. Teemme palkkahallinnosta selkeää, jotta asiakkaamme voivat keskittyä kasvuun. Meille kasvu tarkoittaa ennen kaikkea ihmisten, osaamisen ja vastuun kehittymistä.  Haemme kahta dynaamista palvelupäällikköä liittymään palkkaliiketoiminnan asiantuntijatiimeihimme Espoon ja Vaasan toimistoille/ Pohjanmaan seudulle vahvistamaan asiantuntijavetoista ja asiakaslähtöistä toimintamalliamme. Roolissa yhdistyvät palkkahallinnon ymmärrys, asiakkuusvastuu, myynnillinen ajattelu ja oman asiantuntijatiimin johtaminen. Vaasan/ Pohjanmaan seudun työsuhde on määräaikainen, perhevapaan sijainen vuoden 2027 loppuun.  Huolehdit asiakaskokonaisuuksien sujuvasta toteutuksesta, palvelun laadusta sekä tiimisi toimituskyvystä ja kannattavuudesta. Johdat kokonaisuuttasi tavoitteellisesti, mutta et yksin: tukenasi ovat kollegat ja laaja asiantuntijaverkosto. Arjessasi yhdistyvät operatiivinen johtaminen ja pidemmän aikavälin kehittäminen. Olet lähellä tiimiä ja asiakkaita, tunnistat kehitys- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä viet asioita käytäntöön yhdessä muiden kanssa.   Myynti ja kasvu    Roolissa on myynnillinen vastuu osana asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja liiketoiminnan kasvua. Myynti muodostuu sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä että uusien mahdollisuuksien edistämisestä. Osallistut aktiivisesti asiakastilanteisiin ja liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen. Olet mukana ratkaisujen rakentamisessa ja tarjousten valmistelussa yhdessä myyjien ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa.   Tiimin johtaminen    Johdat palkka-asiantuntijoita valmentavasti ja tuet heidän ammatillista kasvuaan, priorisoit tekemistä ja rakennat arkea, jossa tavoitteet ovat ymmärrettäviä ja onnistuminen mahdollista. Osaat tehdä päätöksiä, tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin ja samalla vahvistaa luottamusta sekä yhdessä tekemistä.   Aspian arvot, yhteistyö, uteliaisuus ja välittävä neuvonantajuus, näkyvät tavassasi toimia niin tiimin kuin asiakkaiden kanssa.    Taidot ja vaatimukset   Taidot ja ominaisuudet, joita sinulta edellytämme     voit olla kokenut esihenkilö tai seuraavaa askelta ottava palkkahallinnon ammattilainen, jolla on valmius ja aito halu kasvaa asiantuntijajohtajaksi.  soveltuva koulutus tai työn kautta kertynyt vahva osaaminen   kokemusta palkanlaskentapalvelusta sekä palkkahallinnon prosessien tuntemusta   ymmärrystä työehtosopimusten perusperiaatteista  liiketoimintalähtöistä ajattelua sekä kykyä

title: SodaStream: Director International Key Account & Sales Excellence Lead
description: Overview   This role is responsible for building and institutionalizing  World-Class Customer Engagement (WCCE)  across all B&M key accounts within SodaStream, driving a step-change in how the organization engages with retailers globally. It leads the development and execution of the WCCE vision and roadmap, embedding a structured, insight-driven approach to Key Account Management (KAM) across markets.  The role drives global KAM capability uplift by defining and deploying standardized frameworks, including Joint Business Planning (JBP), negotiation playbooks, and customer segmentation tools, supported by robust training, certification, and coaching programs. It establishes enterprise-wide standards for customer planning across financials, promotion architecture, assortment, and on-shelf execution, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.  In parallel, the role owns strategic pan-European, shaping long-term commercial agendas with key customers. It curates and scales winning B&M practices, enabling markets to adopt proven playbooks and toolkits, while embedding critical enablers such as Digital Excellence (DX), Revenue Growth Management (RGM), and Go-to-Market (GTM) models into customer plans.  Ultimately, the role ensures that all retailer engagement is insight-led, commercially disciplined, and anchored in strong category storytelling and innovation, driving superior value for both customers and the business.   Responsibilities     Own WCCE vision and roadmap and build training, certification, and coaching programs  Define global KAM capability agenda, including JBPs, negotiation playbooks, and customer segmentation tools, and guide markets on adoption  Own pan-EU retailer relationships and strategic agenda. Own the P&L at EU level.  Set enterprise standards for JBP planning across financials, promo architecture, assortment, and on-shelf strategy (with DX)  Curate and govern winning B&M practices and support markets in adopting playbooks and toolkits  Embed DX (PoS, segmentation), RGM (promo guardrails), and GTM (RTM models) into customer plans  Integrate category stories and innovation sell-in materials into retailer engagement     Qualifications     12–18 years in B&M KAM or Commercial Excellence  Led major retail relationships or built customer-engagement  Expertise in JBP development strategy, planning cycles & governance, promo design, trade terms, and global playbooks  Experience building training and upskilling strategy and plan for commercial teams across regions  Strong cross-functional collaboration (DX, Marketing, SC)  Postgraduate degree in Business, Strategy, Gen. title: Head of Client Services
description: Company Description       K-BEAUTY CONCIERGE is a high-end concierge service connecting international clients to top quality Korean medical aesthetic clinics. title: Interim Chief Customer & Commercial Officer
description: Interim Chief Customer and Commercial   Wellington-based (3-5 days pw) | Executive Leadership Team | Fixed term, 18 months  MetService | Te Ratonga Tirorangi is seeking an exceptional executive leader to lead its Customer and Commercial division and with the Executive take us through a period of nationally significant transformation, growth and strengthened customer impact. title: Field Support Manager, Nordics
description: As a Field Support Manager, you will lead and support our Field Support Representatives (FSR) across the Nordics, helping them deliver an excellent experience for our Companion Animal Group (CAG) customers. This is a field-based role, ideally located in the Nordics (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark), with around 50% travel to visit teams and customers.  The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feedback into product and process improvements.     Why This Role Matters   Our Field Support Representatives are often the face of IDEXX for our customers — the people who install, train and troubleshoot the instruments that help vets diagnose and treat companion animals every day. As Field Support Manager, you'll be at the heart of ensuring that team performs at its best, directly shaping the experience our customers have with IDEXX and supporting the continued growth of our European operations.   What You Need To Succeed     5-7+ years of related work experience, with in-depth experience in a supervised field or business support environment.  3+ years of supervisory experience, or a combination of supervisory and relevant product knowledge.  Experience supervising remote, multi-site teams.  Strong project management and change management experience.  Big-picture thinking, with strong reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Business Development Manager - Montpellier - CDI
description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager basé(e) à Marseille, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Regional Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.

Vous serez responsable du développement commercial d'un portefeuille de villes situées principalement dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, le Var et le Vaucluse (notamment Marseille, La Ciotat, Toulon et Avignon), avec une présence régulière sur le terrain afin d'accompagner la croissance de Deliveroo sur votre secteur.

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Prospecter et signer de nouveaux restaurateurs partenaires (téléphone & terrain).

  • Développer un portefeuille de restaurateurs sur plusieurs villes de votre secteur, principalement dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, le Var et le Vaucluse.

  • Générer un volume d’appels quotidiens pour alimenter votre pipeline commercial.

  • Être présent(e) sur le terrain afin de rencontrer les restaurateurs de votre secteur.

  • Présenter et vendre l’offre Deliveroo en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne et en adaptant votre discours à chaque interlocuteur.

  • Piloter les négociations commerciales de bout en bout et conclure efficacement les ventes.

  • Atteindre vos objectifs mensuels et assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM.

  • Accompagner les partenaires après signature et reporter régulièrement votre activité à votre manager.

Profil recherché

  • Bac+3 minimum ou expérience équivalente en vente.

  • Expérience confirmée en commerce, idéalement en B2B.

  • À l’aise avec la prospection terrain et le contact commerçant.

  • Excellent relationnel, sens de la négociation et du closing.

  • Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats.

  • Appétence pour l’univers de la restauration et de la foodtech.

  • Permis B obligatoire.

Nieuwe wet- en regelgeving, veranderende verwachtingen van pensioenfondsen en de voortdurende ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening vragen daarbij om sterke partnerships. Bij Blue Sky Group geloven we dat duurzame relaties de basis vormen voor succesvolle samenwerking.     Daarom zoeken wij een ervaren Client Relations Partner die verder kijkt dan de afspraken van vandaag. Iemand die opdrachtgevers écht wil begrijpen, verbinding creëert en samen met collega's werkt aan oplossingen die waarde toevoegen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, denkt vooruit en weet verschillende belangen samen te brengen.      Wat houdt dit in?    Als Client Relations Partner vertegenwoordig je Blue Sky Group richting onze opdrachtgevers. Je bent de gesprekspartner voor pensioenfondsbesturen en andere stakeholders en bouwt aan duurzame relaties gebaseerd op vertrouwen, kwaliteit en gezamenlijke ambities. De ene keer gaat het om operationele zaken, zoals oplevering van stukken en doorontwikkelen dan wel zelf aanpassen van rapportages en het melden van incidenten. De andere keer ligt er een bestuurlijke uitdaging.     Je zit aan tafel waar strategische keuzes worden besproken. Niet als leverancier, maar als partner die meedenkt, verbindt en bijdraagt aan duurzame oplossingen voor pensioenfondsen. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van opdrachtgevers, vertaalt vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen en verbindt de juiste expertises binnen Blue Sky Group. Door betrokken samen te werken en proactief kansen te signaleren, versterk je onze dienstverlening én onze positie in de markt.      Jouw impact    Je bouwt aan duurzame strategische partnerships

title: Technisch Service Manager
description: Geen storing te ingewikkeld, geen uitdaging te groot. Als specialist bij Van der Velden weet je precies wat je te doen staat om het rioolstelsel van Nederland in topvorm te houden. Of je nou bij ons op kantoor zit of onderweg bent: jij lost het op.      Dit krijg je van ons   Onze vestiging in Arnhem biedt jou een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie binnen een betrokken team, met:   25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen;  Een startsalaris tussen €3.391,- en €5.171,- per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring);  Een auto van de zaak;  Een netto representatievergoeding van €45,12;  Veel zelfstandigheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid;  Een goed pensioen via PMT;  Ruimte voor opleiding en doorgroeimogelijkheden.       Dit ga je doen   Als Technisch Servicemanager Storingen op onze vestiging in Arnhem ben jij de uitvoerende spil tussen het team monteurs, je collega’s op kantoor en de klant. Je geeft leiding aan een groep monteurs, coördineert de werkzaamheden en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt. Je draagt zorg voor een optimale inzet van middelen en personeel, waarbij een hoge bezettingsgraad en productiviteit bij jou altijd op je netvlies staat. Zo’n 60% van je tijd breng je buiten door. Zo start je bijvoorbeeld de ochtend met een werkplekinspectie op locatie, bespreek je later op de dag met de klant de voortgang van de werkzaamheden en rond je de dag af met de bijbehorende administratieve taken in ons ERP-systeem.     Je hebt de leiding over het team, maar je houdt ook het overzicht op het hele project. Daarnaast ben je het aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en zorg je dat hun vragen snel en goed worden afgehandeld. Jouw analytische blik maakt het mogelijk om in te zien waar we ons kunnen verbeteren.   Leidinggeven aan een team collega’s in het veld en op kantoor;  Verantwoordelijk voor de correcte uitvoering van vernieuwingswerkzaamheden bij onze klanten;  Actief bijdragen aan de verbetering van werkprocessen en de optimalisatie van de inzet van middelen;  Op locatie beoordelen van werkzaamheden en opstellen van offertes;  Controleren en verwerken van de digitale monteursadministratie;  Verzorgen van de digitale financiële overdracht van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden;  Intensief samenwerken met o.a. de Operationeel Manager en het Bedrijfsbureau;  Periodiek fungeren als telefonische achterwacht buiten kantoortijden voor vragen van dienstdoende monteurs;  Opleiden, begeleiden en aansturen van vernieuwingsmonteurs, inclusief het voeren van functioneringsgesprekken;  Onderhouden en versterken van relaties met bestaande klanten en het leggen van contacten met potentiële nieuwe klanten;  Waarborgen van een veilige werkomgeving en toezien op de naleving van alle relevante wet- en regelgeving.       Wat verwachten we van jou?   Geen dag verloopt hetzelfde, dus jij hebt een flexibele instelling waardoor je snel kunt schakelen en altijd overzicht houdt, zelfs in uitdagende situaties.   Minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau:  Woonachtig in regio Arnhem;  Je hebt ervaring

title: Field Delivery Manager - Benelux
description: Job Description    Field Delivery Manager – Benelux    Location:  Netherlands (office based one to two days per week, remainder on site with occasional home working)   Schedule:  Full-time   Who are we?   At Vertiv, we're on a mission to power the people and technologies that keep the world connected. From data centres to telecom networks and industrial facilities, our solutions ensure that critical systems stay online, no matter what.  With over $6.9 billion in revenue and operations spanning nearly 70 countries, Vertiv offers the stability of a global leader and the excitement of a fast-evolving industry. This is a newly created role, born out of a restructure to better support our growing data centre business. You'll take ownership of a team covering both UPS and Thermal disciplines, ensuring they deliver outstanding service to our customers across the region.  This is a people leadership role first and foremost. While you'll need enough technical understanding to support your team and speak credibly with customers, the real focus is on managing, coaching, and developing your engineers to perform at their best. You'll be the bridge between your team on the ground and the wider business, making sure resources are deployed effectively, customers are looked after, and your engineers have everything they need to succeed.  The role is customer facing and site based. You'll spend most of your time out with your team and at customer sites, with one or two days per week in the office. The data centre environment is fast paced and demanding, so you'll need to be comfortable operating in that world and building strong relationships with clients who expect a high standard of service.   Key Responsibilities   You'll lead, coach, and develop your team of Field Service Engineers, driving performance through clear KPIs and continuous improvement. Day to day, you'll manage resource planning, scheduling, and workload balancing to make sure service coverage is optimised and nothing falls through the cracks.  You'll ensure timely and high quality execution of installation, maintenance, and repair services across customer sites. When issues arise, you'll act as the point of escalation, working closely with customers to resolve problems and maintain satisfaction.  Collaboration is key in this role. You'll work alongside Sales, Technical Support, and Logistics to ensure seamless service delivery. You'll also identify training needs within your team and support the development of both technical and soft skills, making sure your engineers continue to grow.  Safety and compliance sit at the heart of everything we do. You'll maintain adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations across all activities. title: Palvelupäällikkö palkkapalveluihin
description: Yhdistä ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen.   Me Aspialla olemme talous- ja palkkahallinnon edelläkävijöitä. Uteliaisuus, kasvu ja jatkuva kehittyminen ohjaavat tekemistämme – haluamme olla askeleen edellä niin osaamisessa kuin asiakaskokemuksessa. Avoin ja joustava työympäristömme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiantuntijana.      Sytytkö ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvun rakentamisesta?    Me Aspialla olemme asiantuntijayhteisö, joka seisoo rohkeiden kasvajien rinnalla. Teemme palkkahallinnosta selkeää, jotta asiakkaamme voivat keskittyä kasvuun. Meille kasvu tarkoittaa ennen kaikkea ihmisten, osaamisen ja vastuun kehittymistä.     Haemme kahta dynaamista palvelupäällikköä liittymään palkkaliiketoiminnan asiantuntijatiimeihimme Espoon ja Vaasan toimistoille/ Pohjanmaan seudulle vahvistamaan asiantuntijavetoista ja asiakaslähtöistä toimintamalliamme. Roolissa yhdistyvät palkkahallinnon ymmärrys, asiakkuusvastuu, myynnillinen ajattelu ja oman asiantuntijatiimin johtaminen. Vaasan/ Pohjanmaan seudun työsuhde on määräaikainen, perhevapaan sijainen vuoden 2027 loppuun.     Huolehdit asiakaskokonaisuuksien sujuvasta toteutuksesta, palvelun laadusta sekä tiimisi toimituskyvystä ja kannattavuudesta. Johdat kokonaisuuttasi tavoitteellisesti, mutta et yksin: tukenasi ovat kollegat ja laaja asiantuntijaverkosto. Arjessasi yhdistyvät operatiivinen johtaminen ja pidemmän aikavälin kehittäminen. Olet lähellä tiimiä ja asiakkaita, tunnistat kehitys- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä viet asioita käytäntöön yhdessä muiden kanssa.      Myynti ja kasvu    Roolissa on myynnillinen vastuu osana asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja liiketoiminnan kasvua. Totalt marknadsför Biltema mer än 19 000 artiklar. Våra värdeord Enkelhet, Sparsamhet, Handlingskraft, Ordning och Reda samt Flexibilitet genomsyrar hela vår verksamhet. Vi ser positivt på intern rörlighet och rekryterar därför gärna vår egen personal till lediga befattningar. Hos oss finns goda möjligheter för dig som vill utvecklas i din karriär.   Vad du kan förvänta dig av tjänsten   Du kommer att vara en viktig del av varuhusets ledningsgrupp med ett övergripande ansvar för att driva och utveckla våra avdelningar för kassa, kundservice och café. Du ansvarar för planering och uppföljning av verksamheten, inklusive schemaläggning, resultatansvar och kvalitetsarbete. Ditt fokus ligger på att skapa effektiva flöden, god arbetsmiljö och en serviceupplevelse i toppklass.  Du leder dina medarbetare genom din närvaro i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att de är väl utbildade i rutiner för kundbemötande, reklamationshantering och kontanthantering. I caféet ansvarar du för att livsmedelshygien och övriga regelverk efterlevs. Du arbetar nära varuhuschefen i den gemensamma uppgiften att driva varuhuset framåt.  Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med 6 månaders provanställning. Sysselsättningen är heltid, 40 timmar/veckan.   Vad vi förväntar oss av dig   Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad ledarerfarenhet inom detaljhandeln. Kanske har du har tidigare haft en roll som butikschef i en mindre butik, där du haft helhetsansvar för såväl personal som drift. Eller så har du arbetat i ledande befattning med ansvar för personal, försäljning eller drift, utan att vara ytterst ansvarig, men känner dig nu redo för att ta nästa steg i din utveckling. En förutsättning är att du är trygg i ditt ledarskap, van att fatta beslut och har ett starkt driv att utveckla både människor och rutiner.  Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med kundservice, kassa eller café tidigare, men det viktigaste är att du har en god förståelse för hur man skapar effektiva team och hög servicekvalitet.  Som person är du handlingskraftig, lösningsfokuserad och strukturerad. Du trivs i en varierad miljö, är inte rädd för att hugga i där det behövs och värdesätter ordning och reda omkring dig. Du leder genom att vara närvarande, engagerad och genom att föregå med gott exempel.  Vi ser fram

title: Enhetschef kund och kommunikation
description: Karlstadsregionens vatten startar verksamheten 1 januari 2027. Vi är ett kommunalt VA-bolag som ägs av Forshaga, Hammarö, Karlstad och Kil. Vårt uppdrag är att leverera dricksvatten, rena avloppsvatten och ta hand om dagvatten i våra fyra ägarkommuner. Vi arbetar för hållbar samhällsutveckling och en framtid med rena sjöar och vattendrag.       Beskrivning      Vi är Karlstadsregionens vatten – ett nytt bolag som samlar fyra organisationers kraft i en för att sköta ett av samhällets viktigaste uppdrag: Att leverera glasklart dricksvatten, rena avloppsvatten och ta hand om regnvatten.     Det gör vi varje dag året om åt drygt 120 000 människor i våra fyra ägarkommuner Forshaga, Hammarö, Karlstad och Kil. Vi får samhället att fungera och gör våra kunders vardag lite enklare, men uppdraget större än så. Vi lägger grunden till en hållbar framtid för både människor och miljö.     Följ med oss på en spännande resa där vi inte bara bygger något nytt tillsammans, utan också hållbara vatten- och avloppslösningar för kommande generationer. Här får du plats att växa, påverka och bidra med dina idéer samtidigt som du gör ett jobb som är samhällsviktigt på riktigt.    Vi söker nu en utvecklingsorienterad enhetschef för Kund och kommunikation som vill leda och utveckla en verksamhet med kunden i fokus.    Enheten ansvarar för kundservice, skadeståndsärenden samt intern och extern kommunikation. En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla kundprocesser, arbetssätt och rutiner för att skapa en effektiv verksamhet och en god kundupplevelse. Enheten består av sju medarbetare.    Som enhetschef har du en nyckelroll i att stärka kundrelationerna och säkerställa att verksamheten möter kundernas behov med hög kvalitet, tillgänglighet och service.      Arbetsuppgifter      Du ansvarar för verksamhet, ekonomi, personal och arbetsmiljö inom enheten. Du leder det dagliga arbetet samtidigt som du driver utveckling och förbättring av verksamhetens processer och arbetssätt. I rollen leder, utvecklar och följer du upp enhetens verksamhet och medarbetare samt driver utvecklingsarbete inom kundservice, kommunikation och kundprocesser. Du säkerställer effektiva rutiner och arbetssätt för hantering av kundärenden och ansvarar för verksamhetens interna och externa kommunikation.     Du bidrar med ett strategiskt perspektiv på kommunikation och varumärkesbyggande för att stärka förtroendet för verksamheten och skapa en tydlig och attraktiv bild av organisationen.    Uppdraget innebär även att samordna arbetet med anslutnings- och skadeståndsärenden samt att bygga och utveckla goda relationer med kunder och samarbetspartners. Genom ett tydligt fokus på kvalitet, service och kundnytta bidrar du aktivt till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling. title: Global Relations Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: CIFF's største styrke er de relationer, vi bygger og vedligeholder med internationale indkøbere, retailere og nøgleaktører i modebranchen. Global Relations-teamet har ansvaret for disse relationer og driver initiativer, der styrker forbindelsen mellem CIFF, vores brands og det globale marked.  Vi søger en engageret og relationsstærk  Global Relations Manager , som vil være med til at udvikle området og tage ejerskab for en portefølje af markeder og strategiske relationer.     Rollen  Som Global Relations Manager bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at tiltrække og engagere internationale indkøbere og retailere. Du får ansvar for at udvikle og vedligeholde relationer, skabe værdifulde forbindelser og sikre en stærk oplevelse før, under og efter vores messer.  Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver at:   Opbygge, udvikle og vedligeholde relationer til internationale indkøbere og retailere på udvalgte markeder.  Drive CIFFs buyer-program, herunder kuraterede invitationer, rejseplanlægning, værtskab og opfølgning i forbindelse med messerne.  Bidrage til planlægning og afvikling af retailer pop-ups og internationale tours i tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet.  Facilitere matchmaking mellem brands og indkøbere gennem målrettede introduktioner, møder og opfølgning, der skaber konkrete forretningsmuligheder.  Sikre, at buyer-database og CRM løbende er opdateret, så viden om markeder, relationer og aktiviteter forankres i organisationen.      Din profil  Vi forestiller os, at du:   Har erfaring med relationsarbejde inden for mode-, retail-, eller eventbranchen, fx. fra buying, showroom, agentur eller messeorganisation.  Er en stærk kommunikator og naturlig vært, der hurtigt skaber tillid og langsigtede relationer på tværs af kulturer og markeder.  Arbejder struktureret og datadrevet og forstår værdien af systematisk opfølgning og CRM-arbejde.  Trives med at skabe forbindelser mellem mennesker og omsætte netværk til konkrete forretningsmuligheder.  Er fleksibel og indstillet på rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med messer, internationale tours og pop-ups.  Behersker engelsk flydende i skrift og tale. Yderligere sprogkompetencer er en fordel.       Hos CIFF  bliver du en del af en international organisation i hjertet af modebranchen. Du får mulighed for at opbygge et globalt netværk og arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af verdens mest spændende brands, indkøbere og retailere.  Vi tilbyder en rolle med stor selvstændighed, høj synlighed og mulighed for at påvirke udviklingen af CIFFs internationale relationer. Samtidig bliver du en del af et ambitiøst og engageret team, hvor samarbejde, initiativ og stærke relationer er kernen i vores succes.     Har du brug for yderligere input, så kontakt gerne Director of CIFF, Sofie Dolva på ANDO@CIFF.dk       Copenhagen International Fashion Fair       (CIFF)    er ikke bare en modebegivenhed – det er et internationalt samlingspunkt, hvor branchen mødes for at forme fremtidens trends, netværk og samarbejder. Du bliver deres faste kontakt og får ansvaret for at forstå deres behov og få de rette kompetencer og specialister til at spille sammen. En synlig leder med blik for både mennesker og kunder   Du motiveres af ledelse og af at få mennesker til at lykkes. Du er tæt på dine medarbejdere, sætter en tydelig retning og følger op – samtidig med, at du er tilgængelig og ordentlig i din ledelsesstil.  Du trives også ude hos kunderne og kan se både deres behov og de muligheder, der opstår. Du behøver ikke selv have alle svarene, men du skal kunne samle de rigtige mennesker og sikre en god løsning.      Vi forestiller os, at du:    Har en baggrund som elektriker, el-installatør eller en anden teknisk uddannelse  Har erfaring som serviceleder, projektleder eller fra en lignende rolle  Har erfaring med ledelse  Forstår B2B-kunder og har gerne et netværk omkring Billund, Esbjerg eller Trekantområdet  Har økonomisk og kommerciel forståelse  Er struktureret og god til at prioritere i en omskiftelig hverdag  Kommunikerer tydeligt og skaber gode relationer til både kunder og medarbejdere       En stærk afdeling i nye rammer i Billund   Du bliver en del af en  veletableret afdeling i Billund  med stærke faglige kompetencer og et tæt samarbejde mellem serviceledere og projektleder. Afdelingen er netop flyttet ind i  splinternye lokaler i Billund , som danner rammen om en moderne arbejdsplads med fokus på faglighed, samarbejde og fællesskab.  Jansson

Deltage i kundedialog og tilbudsarbejde samt bidrage til en sund pipeline og langsigtede kunderelationer.  Styrke tværfagligt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen, så vi leverer integreret rådgivning med høj kundeværdi. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
description:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar c

Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

title: Kundenservice & Community Manager:in (m/w/d) - Teilzeit, Werkstudent:in oder Minijob · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Und auffällig oft geht es in diesen Bewertungen gar nicht ums Produkt, sondern um den Service. Dazu kommen die Nachrichten — seitenlang, mit Fragen zur Umstellung, mit Erfolgsgeschichten, manchmal mit Ärger über ein Paket, das zu spät kam.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Wir wollen, dass am Ende jedes Gesprächs ein erledigtes Anliegen steht und ein Mensch, der gern wiederkommt — nicht eine höfliche Antwort ohne Lösung. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme von NaschNatur gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und unserer Community. Du beantwortest Anfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media, betreust unsere Brand-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen erledigt wird — zugunsten der Kundin, nicht nur beantwortet. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Ausgangslage

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht.

Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch.

title: Account Executive - UK
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition

title: Buchhalter Mieten (m/w/d) Teilzeit
description:
Im Direktauftrag suchen wir für unseren Kunden eine/n Buchhalter für Immobilien (m/w/d) am Standort München in Direktvermittlung.

Unser Kunde ist eine feste Größe in der Immobilienwirtschaft und stellt Investoren aller Stufen der Wertschöpfungskette hinweg zur Verfügung.
Beginnend bei dem Ankauf und Verkauf von Wohnimmobilienbeständen, weiterführend über das Portfolio- und Asset-Management bis hin zum späteren gewinnbringendem Ausstieg, werden alle Bereiche umfasst.

Hervorzuheben ist das wahrhaft charismatische und mit vielen Jahren Branchen-und Berufserfahrung gespickte Führungsteam, welche unter etablierten als euch bei neuen Mitarbeitern einen hervorragenden Ruf genießen.
Das circa 40 köpfige Team arbeitet im Schulterschluss zusammen und fördert die eigene Weiterentwicklung.

Neben der klassischen Immobilienverwaltung, steht als zweite Säule der Bereich Vermietung und Verkauf eine tragende Rolle.

Aufgaben

  • Sie berbeiten die laufende Mietbuchhaltung

  • Die Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs gehört zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich
  • Sie erstellen die monatlichen Abrechnungen für die Eigentümer (SEV)

Qualifikation

Was wir suchen:

Menschen, die über den Tellerrand hinausdenken. Persönlichkeiten mit klarem Blick für Risiken und Chancen. Und den Anspruch, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das genauso ambitioniert ist wie sie selbst.

 Senior Tax Preparer/Reviewer – Full-Time, Fully Remote 
 Join Our Team

 Join Profitable Painter CPA PLLC, a fast-growing, tech-enabled, remote-first CPA firm that exclusively serves painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada. Our mission is simple: guide painting contractors to financial prosperity.

 Prepare and review complex federal and state individual and business tax returns, including: 
 
 
 
 Complex individual returns involving Schedules C, E, and D/Form 8949 
 
 
 Passive activity loss rules and Form 8582 
 
 
 At-risk limitations and rental real estate professional status 
 
 
 Section 199A/QBI calculations, including aggregation elections and SSTB limitations 
 
 
 K-1 reporting and basis tracking for partnerships, S corporations, and trusts 
 
 
 Alternative Minimum Tax and Net Investment Income Tax

 Multi-state business taxation, including nexus, apportionment, combined or consolidated filings, and state-specific adjustments 
 
 
 Book-to-tax reconciliations, including Schedule M-1 and M-2 
 
 
 Consolidated and multi-entity return structures 
 
 
 
 Perform technical reviews of tax returns prepared by other team members, identifying substantive issues related to tax treatment, entity structure, basis, multi-state taxation, and overall accuracy. 
 
 
 Research complex tax questions using primary authority, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, revenue rulings, case law, and professional tax research platforms. 
 
 
 Respond to IRS and state notices, including CP2000 and underreporter no

title: Customer Success Associate
description: Enerzyz  is an AI-powered asset orchestration platform that helps industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and data centers run more efficiently. Our work involves developing real-time intelligent systems for any facility's asset management through agentic automation. This role is designed for building a high-performance customer organization capable of bridging AI, engineering operations, and long-term client value. We are looking for engineers who can hold a technical conversation and a commercial one in the same meeting.      About the Role:   Deploying an AI system into a live facility is only the beginning. description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of KD Pharma, GT is looking for a Senior Azure Data Engineer with architecture exposure, interested in assessing, designing, and potentially building a modern data platform to support Finance, Operations/Supply Chain, and Quality/Manufacturing functions.

**Expected Involvement: The engagement is expected to begin with a 6-week discovery phase of approximately 30 hours per week (180 hours total). Following successful completion of the discovery phase and client approval, there is potential to transition into a long-term, full-time implementation role.

About the Client

Founded in 1988, KD Pharma is a technology-driven CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) specializing in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical production, including ultra-pure Omega-3 concentrates.

The company operates internationally, with locations across Germany, Norway, the UK, the USA, Canada and Peru, and provides end-to-end solutions from development and custom synthesis through to finished dosage forms.

About the Project

KD Pharma is looking to modernize its current data and reporting environment and establish a scalable, maintainable Microsoft-based data platform supporting multiple business systems and reporting needs. The current landscape spans roughly nine source systems across Business Central, legacy NAV, QuickBooks and other integrations, with reporting currently relying on a mix of direct ERP/SQL connections and Power BI.

The engagement will initially start with a 6-week Discovery Phase, focused on understanding the existing data estate and defining the target architecture, platform approach and implementation roadmap.

During Discovery, the team will:

  • Assess the existing data landscape, integrations and data flows

  • Identify key architectural, data-quality and integration gaps

  • Design the target lakehouse / medallion architecture

  • Evaluate Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory and Databricks and recommend the most suitable approach

  • Define the first implementation / PoC scope and the roadmap for the subsequent build phase

If Discovery is successful and the client approves the implementation, the project is expected to continue into a longer-term build phase, starting with the agreed PoC and expanding into implementation of the wider data platform.

This is a hands-on Senior Data Engineer

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Empathetic Engagement: Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.
  • True Ownership: Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.
  • Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance: Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.
  • Knowledge Advocacy: Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.
  • Operational Reliability: Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
About Hubstaff

At Hubstaff, our mission is to empower people to have their most productive workday. We do this by providing the industry-leading workforce analytics and time tracking platform for remote and distributed teams.

We've been fully remote for over a decade—long before it became a trend—and we continue to believe that remote work represents the most significant shift in the modern workplace since the advent of the PC. Our platform helps more than 200,000 global users track time, gain visibility into work, manage schedules, and automate payments with transparency and accountability at its core.

We're a product-led company with a winning culture, strong momentum, and a long-term vision: to become an essential part of every remote company's tech stack. And we're just getting started.

The Role

We're hiring a Staff DevOps Engineer to help shape the future of Hubstaff's cloud platform.

This is a high-impact, fully remote role for an experienced infrastructure engineer who enjoys building secure, scalable, and highly automated systems. You'll partner with our CTO, architects, and engineering teams to improve reliability, security, developer experience, and platform scalability across our global SaaS platform.

This isn't a traditional operations role. We're looking for someone who thrives on solving complex infrastructure challenges, automating everything possible, and building the internal platform that enables engineering teams to move faster.

If you enjoy building secure, scalable cloud platforms, automating infrastructure, and solving complex engineering challenges, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and operate scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP.

  • Build and improve Kubernetes, Linux, and cloud networking environments.

  • Standardize infrastructure using Terraform, Terragrunt, Helm, and GitOps practices.

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.

  • Build monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, and Better Stack.

  • Strengthen security, disaster recovery, and platform resilience.

  • Drive platform strategy while remaining hands-on with implementation.

  • Improve developer productivity through automation and self-service infrastructure.

What Makes You Successful

  • You've built and operated production cloud infrastructure at scale using AWS (GCP experience is a plus).

  • You're an expert in Terraform, Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Helm, and modern GitOps practices.

  • You've built reliable CI/CD pipelines

title: InnoMaster Softwareentwicklung (berufsbegleitendes Masterstudium) - WiSe27
description:
Du hast eine Leidenschaft für die Softwareentwicklung und möchtest Dein Masterstudium spannend und praxisnah gestalten? Du möchtest nach Deinem Bachelorabschluss weiter studieren und gleichzeitig ins Berufsleben einsteigen? Und das alles bei einem festen Monatsgehalt und voller Finanzierung Deiner Studiengebühren? Dann ist unser InnoMaster Programm genau das Richtige für Dich!
 
Im Rahmen des InnoMaster Softwareentwicklung studierst Du berufsbegleitend an der Uni Hamburg, der Fachhochschule Wedel oder der Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften einen akkreditierten Masterstudiengang im Bereich Informatik/ Softwareentwicklung und wir übernehmen die Kosten! Parallel dazu sammelst Du wertvolle praktische Berufserfahrung in verschiedenen Bereichen der Softwareentwicklung und kannst Dein theoretisches Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen. Neben verantwortungsvollen Aufgaben und einer festen angemessenen Vergütung bieten wir Dir die Teilnahme an Trainings (aus dem Fachbereich, Programmiersprachen oder Soft Skills) und Unterstützung bei Deiner weiteren Karriereplanung.
 
Der InnoMaster Softwareentwicklung ist auf ca. drei Jahre ausgelegt mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 25 Stunden während der laufenden Semester und 40 Wochenstunden während den vorlesungsfreien Zeiten. Für weitere Fragen bezüglich des berufsbegleitenden Studiums stehen wir Dir gerne zur Verfügung.
 

Dein Skillset
  • Bachelor. Du hast Dein IT-bezogenes Bachelor- oder Diplomstudium mit guten Noten abgeschlossen (Notendurchschnitt 2,5 oder besser).
  • Zulassungsvoraussetzungen. Du erfüllst die Zulassungsvoraussetzungen Deines Wunschstudiengangs an der Universität Hamburg (UHH), der Fachhochschule Wedel (FH Wedel) oder der Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften Hamburg (HAW).
  • Programmiersprachen.

description: Paired is an overseas staffing agency that connects top talent to remote opportunities with employers in the U.S. and beyond. We believe great jobs shouldn't be limited by location, and we're here to help you find remote roles that match your skills and career goals.   About Our Clients    Our client is a fast-growing DTC supplement brand known for its Cocktail, a daily powder drink featuring ashwagandha, magnesium, L-theanine, and vitamin D3, alongside its Cortisol Cocktail line.  With an 8-figure run rate, a team of approximately 30 people, and a fully remote setup, they are now building its subscription business as a dedicated P&L.  They are looking for a Subscription Manager to own subscription growth and profitability end to end. Your goal is simple: convert as many customers as possible into subscribers at maximum profit, and retain those subscribers for as long and as profitably as possible.  This is a hands-on ownership role reporting directly to the founder/CEO. The strongest candidates will have personally built or scaled a DTC subscription program and can demonstrate measurable results through metrics such as subscription take rate, churn, retention, and offer-test performance.   Responsibilities     Own and optimize the brand subscription offer, including pricing structure, discount logic, subscription take-rate tests, post-purchase subscription upsells, and retention incentives.  Design and continuously improve the subscription journey to increase conversion while protecting long-term profitability.  Own the customer-side subscription experience, including the subscription portal, cancellation flow, save offers, onboarding, billing reminders, dunning, and winback initiatives.  Own the subscription technology setup, including the subscription app, checkout, payment provider, app costs, and potential platform migrations.  Work with developers, vendors, agencies, and advisors to implement technical and operational improvements without needing to build everything yourself.  Own subscription economics, including discount guardrails, LTV break-even points, and actual cohort performance versus the financial model.  Analyze subscription performance and run structured tests to identify opportunities to improve take rate, retention, churn, and profitability.  Build and scale the subscription function as its own P&L, taking responsibility for outcomes across the entire subscriber lifecycle.  Make decisions based on measurable business impact, with success ultimately measured by 90-day subscription profit per new customer.     What Success Looks Like   Your primary success metric is 90-day subscription profit per new customer.  You will be expected to increase the number of customers who become subscribers, improve the profitability of the subscription offer, and keep subscribers active for longer.  This is a role for someone who can show evidence of having done this before—not someone looking to learn subscription growth on the job.

title: Implementation Manager BELUX– Remote-First
description: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays   In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.  The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations. Through regular engagement with individual members and the wider ecosystem, you will foster collaboration, share best practices, and build momentum. You will be the go-to person for aligning efforts, resolving challenges, and maintaining a 360-degree view of progress, serving as the internal champion for EPI members and making a vital contribution to bringing EPI's vision to life.  At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.   🐝 About The Team   You will report directly to our Chief Implementation Officer, who brings extensive project management experience in the payments sector. You will also be part of a team of experienced Implementation Managers. In your day-to-day work, you will interact regularly with members of EPI's Product, Scheme, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations teams.    💥  Your impact    Onboarding of new members      Support new members through onboarding, co-design their EPI implementation plan, and set up appropriate project governance  Oversee the end-to-end delivery of the plan   Act as the central liaison between the EPI member and the EPI organization, ensuring    timely deployment by guiding the member's project manager    Manage all dimensions of the implementation (tech, legal, branding, marketing,    product) and facilitate sessions to resolve product, rules, and technical challenges     Lead and prepare the steerco's together with the member's project manager     Monitor and Report on Implementation Progress      Track and report KPIs, identify risks and mitigation strategies, and provide clear, actionable reporting to stakeholders  Contribute to the further fine-tuning of the EPI implementation approach   Together with your fellow implementation managers, continuously refine the roll-out    and onboar

title: Onboarding Specialist
description: Creëer dè 100% onboarding ervaring voor onze nieuwe collega's.      Bij Schuberg Philis zeggen we vaak: it's the people, actually. Uiteindelijk maken mensen het verschil, in ons werk en in hoe we elkaar welkom heten. De eerste weken bij een nieuw bedrijf zijn spannend. Daarom zorgen we dat nieuwe collega's zich vanaf dag één thuis voelen. Daar zoeken we jou voor.      Wat je gaat doen   Je begeleidt nieuwe collega's vanaf het moment dat ze tekenen tot ver na hun eerste werkweek. Schuberg Philis groeit hard: we verwelkomen 15 tot 50 nieuwe collega's per maand. Jij zorgt dat dat voor ieder van hen persoonlijk en vlekkeloos verloopt.     Concreet betekent dat:   Je stelt arbeidsovereenkomsten op en zorgt dat ze rond komen.  Je activeert en bewaakt de pre-employment screening en volgt de rapportages op.  Je plant het onboardingprogramma en alles eromheen: rondetafelgesprekken, de Founders lunch, afspraken met de onafhankelijk financieel adviseur.  Je begeleidt nieuwe collega's die uit het buitenland komen en schakelt met onze externe partners voor relocation, visa, werkvergunningen en de 30%-regeling.  Je draait mee tijdens ons maandelijkse onboardingprogramma als begeleider van de nieuwe collega's op die dag.  Je stemt af met ons restaurant- en hospitalityteam en zorgt dat presentatoren van onboardingsessies op tijd klaarstaan.  Je werkt in AFAS, Greenhouse en Slack en houdt de administratie kloppend.      Dit is een baan met veel context switching. Je bent de hele dag in gesprek: met nieuwe collega's, met het team, met partners. Geen dag is hetzelfde en dat vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt en rustig blijft als er veel tegelijk speelt.      Het team   Je wordt onderdeel van ons Recruiting & Onboarding team van 18 collega's, en we groeien door. Binnen het team bouwen we aan een coördinatieteam van vier: twee collega's richten zich op het inplannen van interviews, twee op onboarding. Jullie zijn elkaars backup, dus je staat er nooit alleen voor.      Wat je meebrengt    Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol, bijvoorbeeld als onboarding coordinator, recruitment coordinator, HR operations medewerker of executive assistant.  Je werkt secuur en hebt oog voor detail, ook bij hoge volumes.  Je denkt in oplossingen en krijgt mensen mee, of het nu gaat om een volle agenda of een presentator die nog moet bevestigen  Je vindt het leuk om processen slimmer te maken.  Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.  Ervaring met AFAS of Greenhouse is mooi meegenomen, geen vereiste.      Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt, maar denk je dat deze rol bij je past? Solliciteer gerust. We kijken naar de hele persoon, niet naar een afvinklijst.

title: Account Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Job Description    Who we are and what we do   Biology is the most powerful technology on the planet. It cures disease, feeds civilizations, and decarbonizes entire industries. And yet the scientists and labs producing the breakthroughs that will define the next century still run on pen and paper, pipettes, and spreadsheets.  We're fixing that. Reshape is building the operating system for biological research – robotics and AI that automate data capture and turn raw experiments into decisions. Our customers are the largest R&D and FMCG organizations on Earth. The work they do with us shows up as faster cures, better food, and cleaner industry.  We're hiring a Strategic Account Manager in Copenhagen to own our most important customer relationships and turn them into our biggest ones.   The role   Landing a global biotech or FMCG giant is hard. Turning one lab into forty, and into an enterprise wide implementation is harder, and that's where the real revenue is for us.  You'll own a portfolio of our largest accounts, and you'll be measured on what happens after the first contract is signed. Net revenue retention, expansion ARR, renewals, multi-year commitments. This is not a farming role where you check in once a quarter and hope. These accounts have hundreds of sites, competing budget holders, and internal politics you have to navigate before you can grow anything.  One day you're on site watching a lab actually use the system, spotting the workflow next door that nobody has automated yet. The next you're building the business case that takes a single-team pilot to a global rollout, then defending it against a procurement manager who's decided renewal season is a good moment to grind you down on terms. You're equally at home in all of it.  You run the expansion cycle end to end. Map the account, find the decision makers, build the case for the org, negotiate it, close it. You own the renewal too, so you're protecting the base while you grow it. There is no inherited corporate playbook. You build the account strategy and you own the number.   What We're Looking For   A track record of growing complex enterprise accounts in SaaS, biotech, deeptech, hardware, or life sciences. You've taken a beachhead deal and multiplied it, and you can explain exactly how you did it. A scientific background isn't a must, but you need to soak up knowledge like a sponge and carry yourself with confidence. You can hold your own with a Principal Scientist, then translate operational value into strategic value a CFO will sign.  You generate expansion pipeline rather than wait for it. New sites, new teams, new use cases, exec relationships built. Whatever it takes. You spot churn risk a quarter before it shows up in a dashboard, and you deal with it then. You move fast, decide with incomplete information, and don't need a manager to tell you what matters this week.  What you getThe chance to put real points on the board at a company building something genuinely hard

description: Tapster is a Swedish fintech company building payment wearables such as rings, bracelets, watch straps and keyrings. We are now looking for a  Customer Operations Manager  who can take ownership of our day-to-day customer operations and help us build a more scalable setup as we grow. This is a hands-on role. You will lead and support our customer service team, but also work closely with logistics, fulfillment, returns, Shopify, B2B campaigns and internal operations. Who we are looking for      We think you have 2–3 years of experience from customer service, e-commerce, customer operations or a similar operational role. You do not need to have been a manager before, but you should be comfortable taking responsibility, making decisions and helping more junior colleagues develop.     We think you will be a good fit if you:      Have 2–3 years of relevant experience  Have worked in e-commerce, retail, fintech or another consumer-facing business  Are comfortable working in Shopify or similar platforms  Understand how customer service, logistics and fulfilment fit together  Are structured and good at keeping track of several things at once  Communicate clearly and professionally in both Swedish and English  Are comfortable solving problems without always having a finished playbook  Enjoy working in a small company where roles are broad and things move quickly

JD is available in Japanese only.   カスタマサポートスペシャリスト/ Customer Support Specialist - Mercari      雇用形態：正社員  勤務地：六本木  働き方：フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし）  カスタマーサービス部門勤務体制：   標準労働時間：10:00～19:00（※顧客管理業務のため10:00開始）  オンコール対応：土日祝 10:00～19:00  緊急時迅速対応のため当番制 / 手当は社内規定により支給   ※配属チームにより異なります。      詳細はキャリアサイトの募集要項よりご確認ください   メルカリグループについて    あらゆる価値を循環させ、あらゆる人の可能性を広げる   「地球資源が限られているなか、より豊かな社会をつくるために何ができるか」。2013年、創業者の山田進太郎が世界一周の旅で抱いた課題意識から、フリマアプリ「メルカリ」は生まれました。私たちは、物理的なモノやお金に限らずあらゆる価値を循環させることで、誰もがやりたいことを実現し、人や社会に貢献するための選択肢を増やすことができると信じています。  テクノロジーの力で世界中の人々をつなぎ、あらゆる人の可能性が発揮される世界を実現していきます。メルカリグループの目指すべき方針については Mercari Culture Doc をご覧ください。   組織・チームのミッション   メルカリグループのカスタマーサービス組織は、株式会社メルカリおよび株式会社メルペイにおいて、個人のお客さま向けのカスタマーサポートと、より良いカスタマーエクスペリエンス（CX）の設計・運営を担う組織です。  私たちのミッションは、「お問い合わせを減らす」ことだけではなく、お客さまが困ることなくサービスをご利用いただける体験を実現することです。オペレーションプロセスの最適化、オペレーターのパフォーマンス向上、プロダクト改善への提案、自動化の推進などを通じて、お客さまの課題を迅速に解決し、より良い顧客体験の実現に貢献します。  また、AIをはじめとするテクノロジーを活用したCS変革（CS-AX）の企画・実行と、ナレッジ・コンテンツ管理・育成を通じて、オペレーションの効率化と体験品質の向上を同時に実現することも実行していきます。2029年までにお問い合わせの大部分をAIにより解決させることを目指し、ユーザーにとってのエフォートレスな体験を追求していくこともミッションとしています。    メルカリのミッション・バリューについての詳細はこちらをご覧ください      各チームのご紹介     Customer Support Specialist - title: Palvelupäällikkö
description: Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Jyväskylä   Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.  Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.  Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.  Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.  Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.   Odotamme sinulta    Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto sekä kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja palveluliiketoiminnasta. Sinulla on valmiuksia johtaa muutosta ja viedä kehitystä käytäntöön. Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista.Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.  Työskentelemme hybridimallilla, ja päätoimipaikkasi sijaitsee Jyväskylän toimistollamme. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat Keski-Suomi ja Etelä-Savo, joten liikut työssäsi säännöllisesti eri paikkakunnilla alueen sisällä. Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.  Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää lisäksi sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelet kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja kommunikoit säännöllisesti englanniksi.   Tarjoamme sinulle    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.  Lisäksi tarjoamme:     kilpailukykyisen palkan (n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen)   kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen   mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa   kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön   turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön
