title: Senior Project Manager
description: Oletko kokenut projektijohtaja, joka on vienyt läpi laajoja käyttöönottoprojekteja, transformaatioita tai organisaatiotason muutoksia? Hae osaksi Solitan Cloud Platformsin asiantuntevaa ja rentoa projektipäällikköyhteisöä!       Projektijohtamista ihmiset keskiössä       Solitan projektipäällikköyhteisö on kasvava, yli sadasta asiantuntijasta muodostuva aktiivinen ja toisiaan tukeva yhteisö, jonka osaajat johtavat erilaisia digitalisaatiohankkeita asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan kehittämiseksi.      Vaikka projektimme ovat monipuolisia ja projektipäällikön rooli sekä työn sisältö voivat vaihdella asiakkuuksittain, olemme tunnistaneet keskeiset teemat, jotka ohjaavat jokaisen solitalaisen projektipäällikön työtä. Näiden pohjalta olemme luoneet yhteisen Project Lead Manifeston.       Johtamaan laajaa digitaalisen työympäristön muutoshanketta       Haemme kokenutta Senior Project Manageria johtamaan asiakkaamme laajaa digitaalisen työympäristön muutoshanketta. Projektin keskiössä on siirtyminen Microsoft 365 -ympäristöstä Google Workspaceen sekä siihen liittyvien käyttöönottojen, koulutusten, viestinnän ja muutoksenhallinnan koordinointi.      Kyseessä ei ole perinteinen IT-projekti, vaan koko organisaation toimintatapoihin vaikuttava muutos. Projektissa yhdistyvät teknologia, käyttöönotot, koulutukset, viestintä, muutosjohtaminen sekä erittäin suuren käyttäjäjoukon vaiheittainen siirtymä uuteen työympäristöön.      Roolissa toimit asiakkaan ensisijaisena projektijohdon kumppanina ja vastaat hankkeen etenemisestä yhdessä asiakkaan, Solitan asiantuntijoiden sekä muiden toimittajien kanssa. Onnistuminen edellyttää kykyä hallita useista työvirroista muodostuvaa kokonaisuutta, johtaa eri sidosryhmiä yhteisen tavoitteen suuntaan sekä pitää fokuksen siinä, mikä on käyttäjien ja asiakkaan näkökulmasta olennaista.       Mitä työ käytännössä sisältää?       Vastaat hankkeen kokonaisjohtamisesta sekä projektin onnistumisesta yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa.     Tyypillisiä vastuitasi ovat:       projektin suunnittelu, ohjaus ja seuranta   asiakkaan projektiorganisaation tukeminen päätöksenteossa   useiden rinnakkaisten työvirtojen koordinointi   toimittaja- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyö   riskien, riippuvuuksien ja muutosten hallinta   käyttöönottojen suunnittelu ja koordinointi   koulutus- ja viestintäkokonaisuuksien ohjaaminen   projektin etenemisen raportointi johdolle ja ohjausryhmille       Työssäsi teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Workspace-asiantuntijoiden, muutosjohtamisen osaajien, kouluttajien sekä asiakkaan edustajien kanssa.      Millaiseen ympäristöön tulet?       Solitalla projektipäälliköt eivät jää yksin. Projektijohtamisen yhteisömme koostuu kokeneista asiantuntijoista, jotka työskentelevät erilaisissa transformaatio-, data-, ohjelmistokehitys-, pilvi- ja liiketoiminnan kehitysprojekteissa.      Osaamista jaetaan aktiivisesti, sparrausapua löytyy matalalla kynnyksellä ja yhteisön kehittäminen tehdään yhdessä. Työssä yhdistyvät projektijohtamisen parhaat puolet:

年以上の経験   優れたコミュニケーションスキルとファシリテーションスキル   ビジネスレベルの日本語（簡潔かつ明確に表現する文書作成能力、会話）   中級レベルの英語力（CEFR B2レベル相当、ビジネスコミュニケーションや職場での業務に対応できる）   並行して複数のプロジェクトを管理した経験   変化の多い環境下でプロセス、優先事項に迅速に適応する能力   プロセススタンダードに関するトレーニングの経験   適切なメカニズムを活用して計画通りにプロジェクトを推進する管理能力     Preferred Qualifications      2 年以上のアマゾンでのオペレーション管理経験   上級レベルの英語力（CEFR C1レベル相当、複雑な英語要件に対応できる）   オペレーション、またはそれに関連する技術分野の学位 Wir wollen für den deutschen Mittelstand nicht nur Lieferant sein, sondern enger, ganzheitlicher Energiepartner.       Warum diese Rolle, warum jetzt   Wir wachsen und wir brauchen dich!     Du bist das operative Rückgrat unseres After Sales-Bereichs:  im Hintergrund, aber mit maximaler Wirkung. Du sorgst dafür, dass Abrechnungen, Marktprozesse und unsere externen Partner reibungslos laufen, damit unsere Kunden nie merken, wie viel Komplexität dahintersteckt. Du bringst unseren After Sales-Prozess auf ein Niveau, das deutlich mehr Kundenwachstum trägt. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.      Das wirst du tun     Du unterstützt aktiv beim Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen für unser Wachstum im Gewerbe- und Industriekundensegment.    Du baust unsere internen SLAs für den gesamten After Sales-Bereich von Grund auf mit auf, inklusive Steuerung unserer externen Partner.    Du überwachst die Prozess- und GPKE-Konformität (Marktkommunikation) unserer Partner und plausibilisierst Verbrauchs- und Abrechnungsdaten.    Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Vertrags- und Kundenstammdaten (Stammdatenmanagement).    Du gestaltest und dokumentierst unsere After Sales-Prozesse und treibst die Prozessoptimierung kontinuierlich voran (KVP).    Du erkennst Automatisierungspotenzial bei komplexen B2B-Abrechnungen und Vertragsprozessen und bringst konkrete Anforderungen zu RevOps/IT.    Neue Themen sind für dich keine Red Flag, sondern Ansporn. Du übernimmst gern den Lead bei neuen Projekten.        Das bringst du mit     Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Steuerung operativer Prozesse in einem komplexen, regulierten B2B-Umfeld.    Grundverständnis energiewirtschaftlicher Marktprozesse (GPKE) von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Du bist bereit, dich hier einzuarbeiten.    Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister/BPO-Partner.    Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenverantwortlich, auch wenn's mal knifflig wird.    Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei komplexen, parallelen Themen den Überblick.    Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- und Abrechnungssystemen, Excel ist Alltagswerkzeug für dich.        Das bekommst du von uns     Wirklicher Impact: Du übernimmst das selbstständige Handling einzelner Aufgaben in enger Abstimmung mit dem Team. Was du machst, hat direkte Wirkung auf unser Business, auf Unternehmen, die wir versorgen und auf die Energiewende.    Mobilität & Gesundheit: Deutschlandticket sowie    wahlweise

title: Customer Manager til Nordnet Danmark
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Bliv en del af Danmarks største investeringsplatform, og hjælp Nordnet’s kunder med at få meget mere ud af deres opsparing og pension.   Vi søger dig, som er god til at tale med mennesker og har lyst til at blive en del af et ungt team med skøn energi og højt humør. Gennem en grundig oplæring og introduktion bliver du klædt på til at hjælpe alle slags danskere med alle deres spørgsmål om investering, aktier, fonde og pension, herunder Livsvarig Pension som er vores seneste produktlancering. Jobbet som Customer Manager giver dig nemlig både menneskelige og faglige udfordringer, og er en ideel vej ind i finansbranchen.  Vi holder til centralt i København i lyse lokaler lige ved Havneholmen metrostation. Vi har en god frokostordning, personalefordele og et stærkt sammenhold.  Nordnet har over 655.000 kunder i Danmark og vores mission er at gøre investering og pension forståeligt og tilgængeligt for alle.  Det har vi brug for din hjælp til. Hvad siger medarbejderne?  Hvad vil du opleve hos Nordnet?  Når du træder ind hos Customer Center i Nordnet, mødes du af 18 engagerede kolleger, der alle deler en stor interesse for investering, men ellers ikke lever op til mange af fordommene om bankfolk. Vi har en flad organisation med en klar mission, og der er ingen forventninger, om at du går med jakkesæt eller slips. Vi er stolte over at have en inkluderende kultur med plads til den enkelte - og plads til udvikling.  I vores Customer Center har vi den direkte dialog med vores kunder, og det er vores ansvar at skabe gode kundeoplevelser. Det daglige arbejde går ud på at være i dialog med vores kunder på telefon og skrift og på den måde sikre, at kunderne får værktøjer og inspiration til at tage det næste skridt i deres investeringer. Vi ser samtale med kunderne som en vigtig måde at skabe den personlige kontakt. Derfor skal du trives med at tale med mange forskellige mennesker hver dag og sprede god energi gennem røret.  For at blive en succes i jobbet er det vigtigt, at du får energi af at hjælpe andre, og at du har lyst til at være en del af en kultur, hvor vi passer på hinanden, bruger meget tid sammen, og hvor der også er plads til sjov og løjer.  På sigt har du mulighed for at vokse i jobbet, da vi sidder med mange forskellige typer af opgaver som afspejler, at vi har mange forskellige typer af kunder med mange forskellige behov.  Vi er i alt ca. 75 ansatte i Nordnet’s danske afdeling, der nyder godt af frokostordningen, fredagsmorgenmad og andre sociale aktiviteter, ligesom vi samles om ugentlige kontormøder for at blive opdateret på udviklingen i og omkring Nordnet. Du får også mulighed for at samarbejde med vores kollegaer i hovedkontoret i Stockholm og resten af Norden samt vores nye kollegaer i Tyskland.   Jobbet er noget for dig, hvis du kan lide at:     Besvare spørgsmål som kunderne ringer eller skriver ind med. Her er det vigtigt, at du er god til at løse problemer og kan sætte dig i andres sted.  Skabe gode kundeoplevelser for både den helt

Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.  Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons un Strategic Account Manager, pour accompagner nos clients de bout en bout et jouer un rôle central dans l’exécution et la qualité de notre modèle. Ton rôle sera d’évaluer si Wavo est pertinent pour eux, et dans quelles conditions.     Lorsque le dossier avance, tu travailleras sur l’analyse des données mises à disposition par le prospect afin de définir un périmètre finançable cohérent. Cela implique de comprendre la typologie des produits, leur rotation, leur valorisation et leur liquidité, afin de proposer un financement adapté et maîtrisé. Ce volet analytique est central dans le poste : il conditionne la qualité des décisions et la performance du modèle dans la durée.     Tu piloteras ensuite toute la phase d’onboarding et de contractualisation, en lien avec les équipes internes, jusqu’à la mise en place effective du financement. Une fois le financement activé, tu assureras un suivi régulier des clients : monitoring des ventes, ajustements éventuels du périmètre financé, anticipation des prochaines étapes et identification d’opportunités de refinancement. Notre croissance s’accélère, et nous cherchons un(e) Account Manager pour accompagner nos nouveaux clients dans leur expérience Felicity.     Gérer la relation client de A à Z, en assurant un suivi personnalisé et la mise en relation avec des célibataires qui leur correspondent.    Assurer la croissance et la satisfaction de son portefeuille clients.    Améliorer nos outils et processus pour offrir un accompagnement toujours plus exceptionnel.    Contribuer au recrutement et à la formation de nos futurs Account Managers.       Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?     Un rôle clé : tu seras au cœur du réacteur, garantissant la qualité et le succès des mises en relation.    Un impact direct : tu aideras des centaines de célibataires à vivre des moments uniques, et à trouver l'amour.    Une croissance rapide : après un lancement plus que réussi, nous avons levé des fonds pour accélérer notre développement.    Une équipe bienveillante et ambitieuse : nous sommes animés par des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et d’excellence. Ici, on s’entraide, on apprend et on progresse ensemble.    Un équilibre pro/perso : nous offrons 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.    Tu as +4 ans en Account Management, Customer Success ou un rôle similaire, idéalement en start-up ou scale-up B2C.    Tu es empathique, à l’écoute et capable de t’adapter à différents types de personnalités.    Tu connais bien les tendances actuelles du marché du dating et comprends les attentes des célibataires.    Tu es structuré(e), rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et capable de gérer plusieurs missions en parallèle.    Tu excelles dans l’art de convaincre et de gérer les objections.    Tu maîtrises idéalement notre CRM (Pipedrive).            Première rencontre  : un échange de 30 minutes avec Cécile, notre co-fondatrice, pour découvrir ton parcours, comprendre ce qui t'anime, et répondre à toutes tes questions.     Etude de cas  : une étude de cas à préparer en amont et à présenter à Laurie, notre co-fondatrice. C'est l'occasion de nous montrer ta façon d'aborder les défis du métier, et de découvrir nos bureaux !     Mise en situation  : une simulation de 30 minutes avec un(e) Account Manager de l'équipe pour te projeter dans le quotidien du poste.     Prises de références  : pour mieux comprendre tes super-pouvoirs et les axes sur lesquels t'accompagner dès ton arrivée.

title: Responsable de service Gestion des Flux Entrants (H/F)
description: Description Du Poste   La principale mission de la CPAM est de garantir l'accès aux droits et aux soins des assurés.  En garantissant l’accès aux droits et le versement de prestations, nous permettons à chacun de bénéficier d’une prise en charge adaptée quelle que soit sa situation.  Conformément à la Convention d’Objectifs et de Gestion de l’Assurance maladie 2023-2027, la Cpam de Roubaix-Tourcoing a défini la qualité du service rendu aux usagers comme un axe majeur de son projet stratégique d’entreprise. Pour mener à bien cette stratégie, la Cpam de Roubaix-Tourcoing s’engage à poursuivre l’amélioration de la délivrance de ces prestations en répondant aux souhaits de ses 570 000 assurés de bénéficier d’un service administratif plus efficace, plus digitalisé et plus accessible, et qui plaident pour une plus grande dématérialisation des démarches et la réduction des délais de traitement.  C’est pour répondre à ces enjeux, que la CPAM recherche son futur  Responsable de service Gestion des Flux Entrants ( G.F.E).  Rattaché(e) à la Direction Relations Clients, le service GFE a pour mission de : réceptionner, trier, numériser, indexer et orienter l’ensemble des demandes adressées à notre organisme, qu’elles soient reçues sous format papier ou dématérialisée, afin d’en assurer une transmission rapide et fiable vers les services dédiés.   En Tant Que Responsable De Service      Vous animez une équipe de 12 personnes, composée de 3 Référents Techniques et 9 techniciens du traitement de l’information, tout en favorisant les échanges et en veillant à l’implication de chacun,   Vous pilotez le service en garantissant une prise en charge des documents dans les meilleurs délais avec un objectif constant de qualité, de fiabilité de traitement et de satisfaction des assurés.   Vous organisez la répartition des activités, la définition et le suivi des objectifs tout en accompagnant le développement des compétences de vos collaborateurs,   Vous supervisez et coordonnez les différents plans de charge et assurez le reporting des tableaux de bord de production auprès de la Direction,   Vous négociez les moyens, les organiser à travers le pilotage et la coordination de l'équipes,   Vous pilotez les projets inhérents au secteur relevant de votre périmètre   Vous développez une approche transversale avec les services métiers, la relation assurés et les fonctions supports afin de fluidifier les parcours de traitement et améliorer l’expérience client.   Vous impulsez et conduisez les changements permettant d’inscrire l’organisme dans une dynamique de développement de son offre de services et dans un objectif de performance globale,   Vous veillez à une qualité de vie au travail en préservant un bon climat social.     Vos compétences      Vous disposez de solides compétences managériales avérées (pilotage, organisation, animation et accompagnement des équipes) ; d’une capacité à fédérer vos équipes autour d’objectifs communs, et de véritables qualités relationnelles,

title: Senior CRO Specialist
description:
About Entyre

Caregiving is broken. We’re fixing it with technology. Entyre is the holding behind Pflegewegweiser (Switzerland), Entyre Care (United States), and the Pflegewegweiser Shop. We operate as one system across our offices in Berlin, Boston, and Zurich: 450+ people developing the technology, products, and growth strategies that power all three brands. Our platform connects family caregivers with compensation programs through selfonboarding funnels, automated eligibility engines, and digital care management. In the US, families discover Entyre Care through paid and organic channels, land on our landing pages, and move through a multi-step journey in the Hub, our self-service platform, until they are fully enrolled. Hub processes differ by state, and every screen along the journey is a potential drop-off point. Your job is to find those points and fix them.

The Role

You will join the Marketing team in our Berlin office and own testing and optimization across the entire funnel, from the first landing page impression to a won customer. Your initial focus is the US market and the Entyre Care funnels, with the technology and learnings you build serving the whole group. This is a senior, high-ownership role with direct impact on how many families we can help and how fast. The Hub is our proprietary self-onboarding app that guides a family caregiver from the first eligibility check through document collection and third-party sign-offs to a completed Medicaid enrollment. Requirements differ by state, so the Hub runs a different flow in every market and there is no single funnel to optimize. You will work across multiple state-specific flows, prioritize the biggest leaks, and choose the right method for each situation. Where traffic supports it, you run clean A/B tests. Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.

Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery.  Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi's global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company's Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you'll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit

title: UVC Partners: Junior Value Creation Analyst - Intern or Working Student (f/m/x)

About us

UVC Partners backs Europe’s most ambitious B2B tech founders building new category leaders with more than €800m in assets under management. From DeepTech to AI, the firm has invested in breakout startups including Isar Aerospace, Proxima Fusion, Q.ANT, Aleph Alpha, Tacto, Flix, and FINN. UVC Partners' Value Creation team is a team of experts whose core mission is to create measurable impact for our portfolio companies by giving them unique access to industry leaders through a structured, proactive approach. Deeply rooted in UnternehmerTUM, Europe's leading startup and business innovation ecosystem, the team builds actionable relationships between our portfolio companies and a network of 1,000+ corporates as potential customers and strategic partners - and turns those relationships into real business outcomes.


Your mission

Value Creation is not a side show at UVC Partners. We are looking for an outstanding individual to join us to work within our Value Creation team to open doors for our startups they couldn’t open alone. What you will contribute, starting in week two:

  • Sales Enablement – You will support our founders directly with business development topics. You research who holds the budget inside a target corporate, find the path there through our network, and write the intro email
  • Corporate Partnerships – You prepare sessions with our industrial partners, join the room, and document what comes out of them. You will be talking to people twenty years your senior
  • Knowledge Management – Our founders ask the same questions again and again (pricing, first sales hires, KPI reporting). You own your own topic streams and turn them into something a founder can apply in ten minutes

AI changes that. We work on projects ranging from launcher propulsion systems to orbital refuelling systems.

  • Direct interfacing with customers and suppliers

We are seeking engineers with demonstrated expertise in fluidic systems. Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. We are also interested in more experienced professionals with 10+ years of experience in fluidic system architecture and leadership. The position level, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

Ideally, your experience includes:

  • Knowledge of space systems and subsystems

  • Fluidic system simulations, with knowledge of ECOSIM / ESPSS, Simulink, Matlab
  • Familiarity with MBSE concepts and requirements engineering principles; ECSS
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Hands-on mindset for hardware related activities

Your mission

We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis).

  • Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

  • Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.


Your profile

  • Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

title: Teamleder Onboarding
description: Vi søker en fremoverlent og handlekraftig Teamleder for Onboarding som vil få en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle hvordan vi tar imot og får nye kunder godt i gang med Duetts løsninger.  Som Teamleder får du det overordnede ansvaret for onboarding av kunder på tvers av våre produkter – Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline. I løpet av høsten lanserer vi også Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk, og en viktig del av rollen blir å etablere gode, effektive og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for disse produktene.  Dette er en operativ teamlederrolle. Du skal lede og utvikle teamet, men samtidig være tett på kundene og selv delta aktivt i onboardinger og andre leveranser. Vi ser derfor etter deg som trives like godt med å få ting gjort som med å skape struktur, retning og utvikling for teamet.   Ditt ansvar     Ha det overordnede ansvaret for kundeonboarding på tvers av Duetts produktportefølje.  Videreutvikle og standardisere onboardingsløp for Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline.  Etablere gode og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for nye produkter, herunder Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk.  Delta aktivt og operativt i kundeonboardinger og konsulentleveranser.  Lede og utvikle teamet, inkludert personalansvar, oppfølging og kompetanseutvikling.  Ha ansvar for et team som bistår kunder med konvertering og import av data fra andre systemer, samt integrasjoner og offboardinger.  Jobbe systematisk med å forbedre, forenkle og effektivisere arbeidsprosesser sammen med teamet.  Følge opp teamets mål, nøkkeltall og leveranser, samt identifisere og gjennomføre forbedringstiltak.  Samarbeide tett med Produkt, Utvikling og øvrige team for å løfte innspill fra kunder og support inn i videre produktutvikling.  Bidra aktivt i ledergruppen i Customer Operations og støtte opp under selskapets mål, strategi og verdier.     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å skape forbedringer og som ikke nødvendigvis tenker at «slik har vi alltid gjort det» er den beste måten å løse en oppgave på.  Du er fremoverlent, strukturert og løsningsorientert, og du liker å gå fra idé til handling. Du evner å se både helheten og detaljene og trives med å skape struktur i områder hvor det finnes muligheter for forbedring.   Vi Tror Du     Har erfaring innen regnskap og god forståelse for regnskapsprosesser.  Har erfaring med ledelse, eller et sterkt ønske om å utvikle deg som leder.  Trives med å kombinere operativt arbeid og personalledelse.  Er strukturert, løsningsorientert og god til å prioritere.  Motiveres av å utvikle mennesker, bygge team og skape gode resultater sammen med andre.  Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.     Hvorfor denne rollen?   Onboarding er en viktig del av kundens første møte med Duett etter at de har valgt løsningene våre. Ambisjonen vår er å gjøre denne reisen stadig enklere, raskere og mer forutsigbar – både for kunden og for oss.  Som Teamleder for Onboarding får du muligheten til å påvirke

title: Business AI Operations Specialist
description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.

The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Business AI Operations Specialist to help Spreedly transform how business teams operate by identifying high-value opportunities and translating them into practical, scalable AI-enabled workflows.

This role leads AI workflow discovery across R&D and builds prioritized solutions across R&D and other business functions. It also owns key Marketing Operations activities outside of scoring, routing, and analytics, which are managed by Revenue Operations.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational judgment with hands-on implementation skills. They can understand how work happens today, identify opportunities for meaningful improvement, and deliver practical solutions that teams adopt and continue to use.

Success in this role will be measured by the on-time delivery of prioritized workflows, improved operational efficiency, strong adoption, measurable business outcomes, and reliable processes and solutions.

Responsibilities:

R&D Workflow Discovery

  • Lead AI workflow discovery across Product, Engineering, and other R&D functions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, operational challenges, and existing processes.
  • Identify opportunities where AI and automation can reduce manual work, improve execution, or increase productivity.
  • Document and maintain identified R&D opportunities in the shared company AI workflow inventory for prioritization.
  • Translate selected opportunities into clear requirements, success measures, and implementation plans.

Business AI Execution

  • Design and build prioritized AI workflows across R&D and other business functions.
  • Translate business requirements into practical solutions using approved AI platforms and shared capabilities.
  • Deliver assigned solutions on time and communicate risks or delays early.
  • Focus primarily on operational AI workflow

title: Senior Business Engineer - Ads
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is entering a period of unprecedented innovation and growth—and there’s never been a more exciting time to join. The Ads Business Engineering team operates at the intersection of engineering, product, sales, and business development, delivering technical expertise and solutions that empower technology partners, agencies, and advertisers to seamlessly integrate with Reddit’s advertising platform. As a key member of this rapidly expanding team, you’ll have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership—driving cutting-edge AdTech integrations, launching and managing strategic partnership programs, and helping scale Reddit’s developer ecosystem.

At Reddit, a Business Engineer plays a critical role in driving the success of our advertising API products and platform integrations. This experienced engineer role combines deep technical consulting with hands-on engineering, where you'll guide strategic integrations, often contributing directly to implementation across Reddit’s stack or in the codebases of partners (or direct advertisers). You will be a key technical advisor—trusted to own the end-to-end relationship with Reddit’s most important advertising partners, and execute on the long-term strategy for how we develop an ecosystem of developers.

You’ll work across engineering, product, sales, and business development teams to connect Reddit’s capabilities to the evolving needs of the market. You won’t just recommend solutions—you’ll implement them across systems, including platform changes, and also help define frameworks for scaling and repeatability. If you're passionate about creating high-impact technical partnerships, influencing roadmaps, and building at the intersection of AdTech and developer experience, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor and solutions architect for strategic partners (or direct advertisers), guiding them through the integration and adoption of Reddit’s advertising APIs and tools.
  • Design and prototype proof-of-concept solutions that accelerate technical enablement and create tangible value for partners (or direct advertisers). These builds may occur in Reddit’s systems or directly within the client’s or partner’s codebase.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering teams at partner (or direct advertiser)

description: Ben jij diegene die snapt dat een festival pas écht slaagt als de techniek achter de schermen vlekkeloos draait? Ken jij de festivalwereld van haver tot gort en wil je de brug slaan tussen organisatoren en de nieuwste event-tech? Bij Fastlane zijn we op zoek naar een Customer Success Manager die onze klanten naar het hoogste niveau tilt.     Over Fastlane  Fastlane is de drijvende kracht achter de schermen bij de grootste en vetste events. Wij leveren de complete tech-stack voor de festivalindustrie: van geavanceerde ticketing en vloeiende cashless betaalsystemen tot op maat gemaakte event-apps. Wij zorgen voor kortere wachtrijen, meer omzet en een ultieme bezoekerservaring. En dat doen we met een team dat net zoveel van events houdt als onze klanten.     Wat ga je doen?  Als Customer Success Manager ben jij het gezicht en het brein achter de relatie met onze key-accounts. Je bent van begin tot eind, van de eerste kick-off tot de evaluatie na het festival het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de organisatie.    Strategisch partner:  Je denkt proactief mee met festivalorganisatoren. Je adviseert hen over hoe ze onze ticketing, cashless systemen en apps optimaal kunnen inzetten voor hun specifieke event.   Accountmanagement:  Je beheert de relaties, bewaakt de deadlines en zorgt ervoor dat de klant exact krijgt wat er beloofd is (en liefst nog een beetje meer).   Met de voeten in de modder:  Je bent geen 'office-only' manager. Als de operatie erom vraagt, ben je incidenteel op de productie zelf te vinden om live support te bieden en te zorgen dat alles op rolletjes loopt.   Je bent niet zomaar een accountmanager; je bent de onmisbare schakel die ervoor zorgt dat de festivalorganisatie stressvrij kan knallen.   Wie zoeken wij?  De festivalwereld kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je spreekt de taal van organisatoren, snapt de dynamiek van een productieweek en raakt niet in de stress van een naderende deadline.    De festival-insider:  Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met en ervaring in de festival- en eventindustrie. Je kent de wetten van het terrein.   Tech-savvy & adviserend:  Je begrijpt hoe software en hardware (ticketing, apps, payment) de backend van een event versterken en kunt dit helder overbrengen op de klant.   Communicatief ijzersterk:  Je bent een natuurlijke relatiebouwer, kunt snel schakelen en bent organisatorisch een talent.   Flexibel:  Festivals houden zich niet aan kantoortijden. Jij vindt het geen probleem om flexibel te werken als het seizoen daarom vraagt.      Wat bieden wij jou?   Een sleutelrol binnen een snelgroeiend en innovatief techbedrijf in de vetste branche van Nederland.  Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.  Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden (inclusief laptop, reiskostenregeling en kantoorlunch).  Een dynamische werkomgeving met een gezellig, ambitieus team.  Uiteraard: toegang tot de events waar we met trots voor werken.      Solliciteren?   Heb jij de energie van een festival en de scherpte van een top-acco

Assist the Client Support Team with difficult and client-specific problem resolution.

We currently power over 100,000 rewards programs, reaching more than 500 million customers, and serving 1 million API requests per hour.   Smile is a remote-first company built on trust, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, challenged, and empowered to do their best work. We’re hiring a Key Accounts Manager to own those relationships end to end.   You’ll be the accountable owner of net retention and top-account health across our key accounts book. You’ll carry the relationships personally, shape the motion behind them, and put a clear owner on every renewal, save, and expansion conversation. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager @ Aivory       Remote (Nederland) · veel op locatie bij praktijken · zo snel mogelijk    Aivory bouwt de modernste AI-software voor tandartspraktijken. Geen extra laagje op oude systemen, maar één platform dat agenda, dossier, behandelplan en administratie overneemt — zodat de tandarts tijd overhoudt voor de patiënt.    We groeien hard. Tientallen praktijken draaien al op Aivory. De pijplijn is vol. En er moeten er nog honderden bij. Dat lukt alleen als onboarding schaalbaar, strak én menselijk is. Daarvoor zoeken we een Customer Success Manager die ownership pakt.    Dit is geen helpdeskrol.       Je bent de persoon die een praktijk van “we stappen over” naar “we draaien” brengt. Vaak op locatie. Vaak in één dag. En daarna denk je mee hoe we dat proces nóg beter en sneller maken.  Wat je gaat doen  Praktijken onboarden: je bent veel onderweg door Nederland, staat naast het team in de praktijk en zorgt dat ze confident live gaan.  Eigenaarschap nemen over de hele onboardingreis: voorbereiding, livegang, eerste weken, nazorg.  Relaties bouwen met praktijkhouders, praktijkmanagers en assistenten. Jij bent hun vaste aanspreekpunt.  Het onboardingproces zelf beter maken. Waar het wringt, los je het op. Playbooks, checklists, training, tooling, volgorde — jij denkt en bouwt mee.  Signalen uit de praktijk terugbrengen naar product, support en de rest van het team.  High agency: je wacht niet op een ticket of een overleg. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren en je doet het.  Wie we zoeken  Je hebt ervaring in snel groeiende startups. Tempo, onduidelijkheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid energize je, in plaats van dat het je afremt.  Je hebt eerder klanten geonboard. Liefst hands-on, in volume, en het liefst ook op locatie.  Ervaring in de mondzorg is een sterke pré. Geen must — wel een plus als je de taal van de praktijk al spreekt.  Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Dat is een harde eis.  Je hebt geen probleem met veel reizen naar praktijken. Remote is de basis, de praktijk is waar het werk gebeurt.  Je bent high agency. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, je communiceert direct, en je laat geen ballen vallen.  Wat we bieden  Salaris: €5.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van wat je meeneemt.  Bonus per onboarding.  Aandelen: je wordt deels eigenaar van Aivory. We zoeken iemand die dit voor de lange termijn bouwt.  MacBook Pro.  Reiskostenvergoeding. In overleg een leaseauto.  Remote werken, met veel dagen op locatie bij praktijken.  Klein team, korte lijnen, directe impact. Geen lagen, geen theater.  Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk.  Solliciteren Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie naar  ties@aivory.nl  of stuur Ties Verberne een bericht via LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tiesverberne.  Geen lange brief nodig. Vertel kort waarom jij dit wilt doen en waar je eerder klanten live hebt gezet.      Geen recruitmentbureaus, alstublieft.

title: Information Technology service delivery manager
description: Information Technology service delivery manager (level III) | 36 uur      Jij hebt de regie over onze IT-keten. Wij geven je de verantwoordelijkheid om continuïteit te garanderen.    Als  IT service delivery manager  bij Geldmaat ben jij de professional die zorgt dat onze IT-omgeving voorspelbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je hebt een brede rol: je stuurt leveranciers aan, bewaakt de keten, pakt verstoringen op met inhoudelijk inzicht en zorgt dat wijzigingen, releases en integraties onder controle en volgens governance verlopen.  Je hebt het overzicht, begrijpt de samenhang tussen systemen én durft eigenaarschap te nemen. Je brengt rust in escalaties, duidelijkheid in keuzes en richting in verbeteringen.   Dit ga je doen   In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het draaiend houden én verbeteren van onze totale IT-operatie. Je werkt intensief samen met leveranciers, architectuur, security, operations en de business. Je stuurt op stabiliteit, stuurt op kwaliteit en stuurt op voorspelbaarheid.  In jouw rol:    Bewaak je de end-to-end continuïteit van onze IT-diensten en breng je structuur en prioriteit aan in een complexe ketenomgeving.  Coördineer je incident-, change- en releaseprocessen in ServiceNow op een manier die stabiliteit en kwaliteit borgt, inclusief CAB-voorbereiding en regressierisico’s.  Voer je inhoudelijke rootcause analyses uit, koppel je bevindingen terug naar leveranciers en stuur je op structurele oplossingen en blijvende verbeteringen.  Stuur je leveranciers dagelijks aan, challenge je performance en zorg je dat zij leveren wat is afgesproken, ook bij druk of escalaties.  Beheer je kritieke integraties en ketenkoppelingen en overleg je met architectuur en leveranciers over wijzigingen, afhankelijkheden en risico’s.  Voer je IAM-processen uit en borg je de juiste autorisaties, inclusief afwijkingssignalen richting security.  Pas je securitykaders, IT-controls en compliance-eisen toe en ben je gesprekspartner in audits en risico-reviews.  Signaleer je risico’s in keten, platform of processes en initieer je acties om continuïteit en beheersbaarheid te versterken.  Lever je inhoudelijke input bij ontwerpen, implementaties en acceptaties van nieuwe IT-oplossingen, waarbij je let op beheerbaarheid, stabiliteit en life cycle.  Professionaliseer je ITIL-processen, ServiceNow-flows en operationele werkwijzen door actief verbeteringen te ontwerpen en door te voeren.      Waarom Geldmaat?    Geldmaat heeft een cruciale maatschappelijke taak: wij zorgen dat contant geld voor iedereen bereikbaar en veilig blijft. Onze IT-keten is daarbij essentieel, 24/7, foutloos en veilig.  Dat betekent dat jouw rol direct impact heeft op:    Systeemstabiliteit en ketenbetrouwbaarheid.  Beschikbaarheid van onze dienstverlening.  Security en compliance.   Klanttevredenheid en operationele performance.  Je werkt in een professionele IT-omgeving met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid, betrokken collega’s en kritieke technologie.

title: Account Manager
description: Job Description    Who we are and what we do   Biology is the most powerful technology on the planet. It cures disease, feeds civilizations, and decarbonizes entire industries. And yet the scientists and labs producing the breakthroughs that will define the next century still run on pen and paper, pipettes, and spreadsheets.  We're fixing that. Reshape is building the operating system for biological research – robotics and AI that automate data capture and turn raw experiments into decisions. Our customers are the largest R&D and FMCG organizations on Earth. The work they do with us shows up as faster cures, better food, and cleaner industry.  We're hiring a Strategic Account Manager in Copenhagen to own our most important customer relationships and turn them into our biggest ones.   The role   Landing a global biotech or FMCG giant is hard. Turning one lab into forty, and into an enterprise wide implementation is harder, and that's where the real revenue is for us.  You'll own a portfolio of our largest accounts, and you'll be measured on what happens after the first contract is signed. Net revenue retention, expansion ARR, renewals, multi-year commitments. This is not a farming role where you check in once a quarter and hope. These accounts have hundreds of sites, competing budget holders, and internal politics you have to navigate before you can grow anything.  One day you're on site watching a lab actually use the system, spotting the workflow next door that nobody has automated yet. The next you're building the business case that takes a single-team pilot to a global rollout, then defending it against a procurement manager who's decided renewal season is a good moment to grind you down on terms. You're equally at home in all of it.  You run the expansion cycle end to end. Map the account, find the decision makers, build the case for the org, negotiate it, close it. You own the renewal too, so you're protecting the base while you grow it. There is no inherited corporate playbook. You build the account strategy and you own the number.   What We're Looking For   A track record of growing complex enterprise accounts in SaaS, biotech, deeptech, hardware, or life sciences. You've taken a beachhead deal and multiplied it, and you can explain exactly how you did it. A scientific background isn't a must, but you need to soak up knowledge like a sponge and carry yourself with confidence. You can hold your own with a Principal Scientist, then translate operational value into strategic value a CFO will sign.  You generate expansion pipeline rather than wait for it. New sites, new teams, new use cases, exec relationships built. Whatever it takes. You spot churn risk a quarter before it shows up in a dashboard, and you deal with it then. You move fast, decide with incomplete information, and don't need a manager to tell you what matters this week.  What you getThe chance to put real points on the board at a company building something genuinely hard

Identify customer pain points, friction areas, emotional drop-offs and service-level gaps.  Govern CX standards across eCommerce Sales and Customer Service teams.  Facilitate cross-functional workshops with Sales, Service and Operations to improve customer-facing processes and hand-offs.  Ensure journey phases are aligned with SLA expectations and business outcomes.  Partner with UX Research & Design to align customer and user journey insights.   2. Voice of Customer (VoC) Program Leadership   Lead the implementation and ongoing management of NPS, CSAT, CES and transactional surveys across relevant journey stages.  Monitor customer sentiment, recurring pain points and areas of customer delight.  Translate VoC findings into actionable priorities for UX, Product, Operations and other relevant teams.  Establish and manage feedback-loop closure processes, including root-cause analysis, ownership and resolution tracking.  Present CX insights and recurring customer feedback themes to senior stakeholders.   3. CX Measurement & Performance Reporting   Define CX success criteria and KPIs for each stage of the customer journey.  Track metrics such as conversion, drop-off, satisfaction and complaint rates.  Work with Digital Performance, Analytics and UX teams to combine behavioral and customer sentiment data.  Maintain CX dashboards and provide regular performance reporting to leadership.  Identify performance risks and recommend data-backed improvement priorities.  Support prioritization of CX initiatives based on measurable customer and business impact.   4. Sales & Service CX Governance   Define and embed CX SOPs and performance expectations for Sales and Customer Service teams.  Monitor the quality, tone, timing and consistency of customer interactions.  Conduct regular CX alignment reviews with team leads and Operations.  Develop CX guide

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Job Title   Customer Success Manager   About Skyhigh Security   Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.  Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy-to-use, cloud-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.  Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. We embrace a hybrid work model, creating the flexibility and freedom you need from your work environment to reach your potential. From our employee recognition program, to our ‘Blast Talks' learning series, and team celebrations (we love to have fun!), we strive to be an interactive and engaging place where you can be your authentic self.  We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.   Role Overview   Skyhigh製品をご利用いただいている主要なエンタープライズクライアントに対し、ガイダンスとサポートを提供するカスタマーサクセスマネージャーを募集しています。信頼できるアドバイザーとして、お客様が当社のセキュリティポートフォリオを最大限に活用し、その価値を引き出して保護目標を達成できるよう支援するポジションです。セールス、サポート、製品部門と連携し、スムーズな移行を促進し、完全なカスタマーライフサイクルを管理することで、高い満足度を育み、更新を確実にし、拡張の機会を特定します。  ソリューション主導の打ち合わせや顧客訪問に積極的に参加し、顧客の要件を明確にし、市場差別化を図るソリューションを作成・提示します。エンゲージメントで必要とされる顧客のPOC、ベータ活動、および早期導入プログラムをサポートします。既存のフットプリントを拡大し、競合からの置き換えを推進するために、パートナーおよび顧客との信頼関係を構築頂きます。   主な職責    Skyhighセールスチームとの連携     セールスチームと共にエンドユーザー（顧客）およびパートナーの会議に出席し、Skyhighに対するエンドユーザーの要件を紹介し、理解を深める  Skyhighソリューションスイート全体におけるDLP、SSE、DSPMのベストプラクティスと重要な機能をエンドユーザーおよびパートナーと共有する  エンドユーザーの要件をSkyhighソリューションに結びつけ、実現可能性を検証し、Skyhighの機能をデモンストレーションするのを支援する  競合環境を理解し、Skyhighの競争上の差別化要因を提示する  社内テレメトリーおよびアカウントチームとの議論を通じて、エンドユーザー環境における導入および拡張の機会を理解するためのギャップ分析を実施する  セールスチームとの毎週の社内レビューおよび事業計画会議に参加し、密接に連携するための機会を積極的に見つける     エンドユーザー（戦略的顧客）との連携     担当アカウントの主要な連絡窓口として、強力で信頼できる長期的な関係を構築する。顧客全体の健全性と満足度に責任を負う。  社内テレメトリーツールやパートナーおよびSIとの議論を通じて、エンドユーザーの現在のエンタイトルメントと、エンドユーザー環境で積極的に使用されているSkyhighソリューションを理解する。  パートナーおよびエンドユーザーとの議論を通じて、Skyhighからの目標、ユースケース、望ましい結果を理解するための相互成功計画を作成する  Skyhighのテクニカルコンサルタントと連携し、Skyhighのソリューションスイートを使用したエンドユーザーの要件を満たす導入計画を作成し、ベストプラクティスを推奨する。  エンドユーザーまたはSIパートナーと協力し、エンドユーザー環境へのSkyhighのタイムリーかつ高品質な展開を確実にする。  サポートの品質、製品に関する問い合わせ、製品の利用状況、導入、および顧客向けの新しい機能/推奨されるユースケースに焦点を当てたビジネスレビューと定期的な運用サービスレビューを実施する  Skyhigh製品に関するフィードバックをSIおよびエンドユーザーチームから収集する     Skyhighディストリビューターおよびリセラー（パートナー）との連携     Skyhighディストリビューターおよびリセラーとの議論に参加し、Skyhighの展開、機能、ユースケース、および競争上の差別化について話し合う  担当する顧客に関連する問題や懸念がある場合、Skyhighディストリビューターおよびリセラーのエスカレーションポイントとして機能する。  パートナーから製品フィードバックを収集し、レビューのために社内のSkyhigh製品チームと共有する     Skyhighサポ

title: Enhetschef Användarstöd till avdelning Nätteknologi
description: Vill du kombinera ett nära ledarskap med att driva hur användarstödet arbetar, prioriterar och levererar? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som Enhetschef Användarstöd till Teracom.    Teracom bidrar till demokrati och ett tryggare samhälle genom att säkerställa att information och kommunikation fungerar för de mest samhällskritiska funktionerna, även i kris och krig. Kort sagt – vi hjälper dem som hjälper andra.    Om tjänsten   Som Enhetschef är ditt huvudsakliga uppdrag att leda och inspirera medarbetarna inom enheten, där du arbetar verksamhetsnära och operativt. I ansvaret ingår att säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö som främjar öppenhet och ger medarbetare förutsättningar att prestera och utvecklas, där tydliga mål och arbetsglädje går hand i hand. Enheten består av flera olika roller, från servicedesk och kundstöd till tekniska specialister.  Rollen innebär att leda, styra och utveckla användarstödets samlade leverans inom Teracom och säkerställa att den är behovsanpassad, effektiv och tydligt prioriterad. Du driver förbättrings- och förändringsarbete i nära samverkan med IT, verksamhet och uppdragsorganisation, och har arbetsmiljö-, budget- och personalansvar för ca 15 tillsvidareanställda medarbetare samt några visstidsanställda.  Som Enhetschef rapporterar du till Avdelningschef för Nätteknologi och sitter på huvudkontoret på Lindhagen i Stockholm.   Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med     Etablera, förtydliga och vidareutveckla roller, ansvar och arbetssätt inom enheten.  Säkerställa effektiv samverkan mellan servicedesk, kundstöd, IT och uppdragsstöd.  Leda utvecklingen och implementeringen av systemlösningar som stöttar verksamhetens mål.  Leda och facilitera möten, workshoppar och avstämningar inom enheten och med angränsande funktioner.  Ansvara för resursplanering, prioritering och uppföljning av kapacitet och leveransförmåga.  Leda och motivera enligt Teracoms värderingar: Ansvar, Innovation och Mod.  Ingå i avdelningens ledningsgrupp och bidra till avdelningens övergripande utveckling.     Mer om dig   För att trivas i rollen är du en närvarande ledare som skapar struktur och riktning utan att tappa det operativa greppet. Mod att utmana, komma med nya idéer och driva dem även när du möter motstånd är något vi värdesätter högt.  Kommunikationen är tydlig, du skapar samsyn och trivs i en roll där du rör dig mellan helhetsperspektiv och vardagliga prioriteringar. Du samarbetar naturligt med många olika funktioner och intressenter, och har ett resultatorienterad fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.   Vi tror att du har:     Flera års erfarenhet av chefs- eller ledaruppdrag inom IT-nära eller verksamhetskritisk verksamhet.  God förståelse för IT-stöd, servicedesk, kundstöd och användarnära tjänster.  Erfarenhet av att driva operativ verksamhet med fokus på prioritering, uppföljning och resursstyrning.  Erfarenhet av förändringsledning och utveckling av arbetssätt och organisation.  Mycket goda kunskaper i sv

description: BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste en matériaux de construction pour le gros oeuvre et le second oeuvre. Notre groupe d’entreprises comprend les spécialistes de renom que sont   Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco  . Nos spécialistes expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent avec beaucoup d’engagement les clients du secteur de la construction et les clients privés sur 110 sites dans toute la Suisse. Proches du quotidien de la construction, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapides, simples et compétents.  Nous recherchons, à partir du 1er octobre ou à convenir, une personnalité à l’esprit entrepreneurial, capable de diriger notre service de vente interne dans le domaine de la technique du bâtiment et de faire progresser activement l’activité sur le marché. Dans ce rôle clé, tu es l’interface entre le service interne, le service externe, les achats, les shops et le Category Management, et tu veilles à ce que la Technique du bâtiment poursuive sa croissance en Suisse romande.   Sales Manager Customer Care Technique du bâtiment 100% (f/h/d)    Missions     Tu diriges et développes l’équipe du service interne Customer Care Technique du bâtiment, tant sur le plan fonctionnel que managérial, sur plusieurs sites (9 EPT).  Tu es responsable de la gestion des offres, y compris leur suivi, et tu maintiens un taux de conclusion élevé.  Tu définis les prix et les conditions pour les objets et les grands projets, tout en gardant la marge à l’esprit.  Tu accompagnes activement le service externe sur le terrain, suis les projets clients et augmentes le chiffre d’affaires dans la technique du bâtiment.  Tu négocies avec les clients et les fournisseurs et entretiens des partenariats durables et fondés sur la confiance.  Tu collabores étroitement avec les achats et le Category Management, des conditions liées aux projets jusqu’au lancement de nouveaux produits.  Tu veilles à une gamme harmonisée et cohérente dans nos shops.  Tu traites les réclamations et les escalades et trouves des solutions rapides et orientées client.  Tu établis le reporting comme base de pilotage et fais évoluer en continu les processus et la documentation.  Tu fais le lien linguistique et régional entre la Suisse alémanique et la Suisse romande.     Votre Profil     Plusieurs années d’expérience dans le service interne ou le customer care, idéalement dans le commerce des matériaux de construction, du sanitaire, du chauffage ou de la technique du bâtiment.  De solides connaissances en technique du bâtiment (chauffage et sanitaire), ou la volonté de t’y familiariser rapidement.  De l’expérience dans la gestion d’équipe et le plaisir de faire grandir les collaboratrices et collaborateurs.  Un fort esprit commercial : tu organises le service interne tout en étant activement présent sur le marché. Nous recherchons une personne combative, proactive et présente là où il faut.  Une forte capacité de négociatio

title: Engagement & Audience Manager F/H
description: REEMIND est un cabinet spécialisé dans le recrutement de managers experts Tech / Digital / Innovation, engagé dans la promotion du leadership féminin.      Notre client   Acteur de référence du divertissement, notre client a construit une plateforme de streaming utilisée quotidiennement par un large volume d’abonnés. Dans un contexte de structuration et d’accélération de son activité payante, il développe un modèle hybride gratuit/payant, avec des enjeux d’abonnement vs produits à la carte, de gamification et d’innovation en termes d’offre, au service de la croissance.      Le poste   Basé en région parisienne, vous intervenez en tant que   Engagement & Audience Manager.  Vous rejoignez l’équipe en charge du Revenue Management et de la monétisation des contenus. Vous portez la stratégie de valorisation des offres payantes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance et les segments de clients à potentiel, en construisant les stratégies de pricing, de promotion, d’upsell et de cross-sell, avec pour objectif ultime de maximiser l’ARPU.  Vous travaillez en lien avec les équipes Produit, Data, CRM, Marketing, Édito et Finance.      Les questions qui vous animeront au quotidien :    Comment générer davantage de valeur sur une base existante sans simplement augmenter les prix ?  Comment proposer la bonne offre à quel segment, et à quel moment ?  Comment faire évoluer un modèle économique pour accompagner la croissance d’une plateforme de streaming ?       Si ces questions vous stimulent, la suite devrait vous plaire 😉       Les missions (version complète sur le site Reemind)    Porter la stratégie de valorisation des offres payantes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance et les segments à fort potentiel  Construire les stratégies commerciales, de pricing et de promotion adaptées aux différentes cohortes d’abonnés  Développer les stratégies d’upsell, de cross-sell et identifier les leviers Growth permettant d’augmenter durablement l’ARPU  Piloter une démarche continue de test & learn et mesurer la performance des expérimentations tarifaires  Définir les KPI de votre périmètre, suivre la performance business et diffuser une culture Revenue Management auprès des équipes  Structurer la dimension Business Analyse et Business Intelligence du périmètre  Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Data, CRM, Marketing, Édito et Finance       Profil recherché    Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement digital ROIste, sur des modèles d’abonnement hybrides gratuit/payant (freemium)  Expérience de l’animation d’une base d’abonnés et de la construction de stratégies commerciales fondées sur la segmentation  Maîtrise des stratégies tarifaires, des plans promotionnels, de l’upsell et du cross-sell ; une expérience de l’adaptive pricing constitue un plus  Vous êtes à l’aise avec la donnée, construisez vos propres modélisations et les défendez avec des arguments business  Vous aimez autant concevoir une stratégie qu’en mesurer l’impact

title: Customer Sales and Experience Manager
description: Who We Are      Building Consent Approvals Ltd (BCAL) are a growing, forward-thinking organisation and New Zealand’s first truly independent nationwide Building Consent Authority (BCA). We provide an alternative to Council BCAs, delivering professional, commercially focused consenting services to residential developers and building companies.     Our independence is what sets us apart, allowing us to provide a more efficient, effective and customer-focused consenting experience for the building industry.     We work with established, reputable developers and building companies, building strong partnerships based on trust, transparency and shared accountability. Our focus is on adding genuine value through responsive, consistent consenting services aligned with our clients’ wider development and construction objectives.     By working collaboratively with our clients and establishing clear KPIs and service expectations, we aim to improve the efficiency of the consenting process, reduce compliance and construction costs, and deliver better outcomes for our clients and the communities they serve.      About The Role      As a newly established role, you will play a key part in shaping how BCAL attracts, supports and retains customers, while directly contributing to the growth of building consent volumes across New Zealand.     You will lead BCAL’s customer sales and experience activities across the full customer journey — from identifying and winning new business through to onboarding, relationship management, retention and account growth. This is a high-impact opportunity for a commercially driven and relationship-focused leader to build a strong sales function, develop lasting customer relationships and contribute to BCAL’s continued growth and development.     Key responsibilities will include:      Developing and implementing BCAL’s sales and business development strategy and plan.  Identifying, pursuing and converting new customer opportunities.  Building and maintaining a strong, measurable sales pipeline.  Developing trusted relationships with decision-makers across the building, construction, property development, architectural and related sectors.  Managing the end-to-end onboarding of new customers, ensuring a smooth and positive transition into BCAL’s services.  Maintaining regular and proactive engagement with existing customers.  Understanding customers’ future building consent requirements, anticipated projects and expected lodgement dates.  Identifying opportunities to increase consent volumes, customer loyalty, retention and repeat business.  Leading BCAL’s customer sales and customer experience team, providing clear direction, support and accountability.  Monitoring customer feedback and using insights to drive continuous improvements in customer experience and service delivery.  Working closely with BCAL’s technical, processing and operational teams to ensure a seamless customer experience from initial engagement through to con

title: Customer Lifecycle CoE Sales Manager
description: Why choose TD SYNNEX   As a Fortune 500 global company operating in over 100 countries, TD SYNNEX values its diverse workforce of 24,000 employees. As the world's largest IT distributor, our mission is to deliver top-class technology solutions that enable businesses and individuals to navigate the digital world in a safe and efficient way.   Job Purpose   To lead and develop a team of Renewal Sales Specialists focused on customer retention, renewal readiness, customer engagement, and lifecycle management activities. The role is responsible for driving team performance, supporting partners throughout the customer lifecycle, and ensuring successful renewal outcomes while identifying opportunities for customer growth and expansion.   Responsibilities     Lead, coach, and develop a team of Renewal Sales Specialists to achieve retention and renewal targets.  Set clear objectives, KPIs, and development plans, supported by regular coaching and performance reviews.  Create a positive and high-performing team culture through training, recognition, and continuous development.  Drive customer engagement strategies that improve adoption, retention, and renewal outcomes.  Ensure timely and proactive management of upcoming renewal opportunities.  Support the team in identifying risks, retention opportunities, and customer growth potential.  Collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Vendor, and Partner teams to maximize customer lifetime value.  Monitor renewal pipelines and provide accurate forecasting and performance reporting.  Promote the adoption of Customer Lifecycle Services and lifecycle best practices.  Identify opportunities for expansion and increased customer value within existing accounts.  Attend customer, partner, and internal meetings to strengthen relationships and drive successful outcomes.     Knowledge Skills And Experience     Experience leading customer success, renewals, account management, or retention teams.  Knowledge of customer adoption, engagement, expansion, and renewal best practices.  Proven ability to drive team performance and deliver measurable business results.  Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.  Experience managing pipelines, forecasting, and performance metrics.  Ability to motivate, develop, and lead teams in a fast-paced environment.  Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.  Understanding of partner-led customer engagement models and customer lifecycle methodologies.  IT industry experience, ideally within cloud, software, subscriptions, or technology solutions.  2-3 years of experience in a Team Leader, Supervisor, or Management role preferred.  Professional proficiency in English is required.  Experience working in international or multicultural environments is an advantage.     Why You'll Love Working With Us     Hybrid work model: partial remote work per week to combine flexibility with in-person collaboration.  ️ Life insurance: coverage with Generali for greater pe

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
description: TL;DR -  Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.  You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.   Why Lovable?   Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.  We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.  Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.   Who You Are     A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.   Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.   Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.   Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.   Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.   Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.      What We’re Looking For     6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.   Experience at a high tech company.   Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to pa

title: Technical Success Manager- Nordics
description: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.  Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.  At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.  We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.  Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast   Job Description:   The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.  In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.  You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness.  This is remote position from Copenhagen or Stockholm.   What will I be doing:     Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes.   Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value.   Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations.   Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early.   Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction.   Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks.   Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy.   Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive.   Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally.     What Success Looks Like    Customers are healthier, mor

Working across the organisation and alongside senior leaders, you'll develop and deliver engagement strategies, coordinate meaningful stakeholder interactions, and provide trusted advice that helps strengthen relationships with industry, government partners, and other key stakeholders. Build strong relationships across the organisation to ensure coordinated and effective stakeholder engagement. Plan and deliver conference, events and forums attendance, and other stakeholder engagement activities.       The salary band for this role is  $115,536 - $141,751 . description: Responsibilities  About the team We provide support and protection services for TikTok's global community. This includes account access, platform integrity, minor safety, and evolving product support areas. We support platform feedback channels, including in-app and webform, emails, appeals, and internal form requests via a dual support model with BPO and Inhouse specialists. This role sits at the center of frontline delivery and line-of-business ownership. The successful candidate will directly lead a team of full-time frontline User Support agents in Kuala Lumpur while also serving as the LOB Leader for a defined Customer Support line of business. In that LOB Leader capacity, this person will act as the primary operational owner for workflow health, customer experience outcomes, and continuous improvement, coordinating closely with cross-functional partners and support functions to drive end-to-end performance. Lead team operations to deliver against core service goals, including CSAT, SLA, backlog health, productivity, and quality outcomes. - Conduct regular coaching, 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations, building a high-accountability and high-support team environment. - Partner with BPO and in-house stakeholders to ensure alignment on queue handling, escalation management, and readiness plans where the LOB spans multiple delivery models. - Support headcount and capacity planning discussions for the assigned team and LOB, highlighting trade-offs, readiness risks, and operational dependencies. - description: À propos de M&J Trusted Partners  M&J Trusted Partners est un cabinet de recrutement et d'audit français spécialisé dans les fonctions commerciales et managériales, tous secteurs confondus.  Forts d'années d'expériences terrain, nous mettons notre expertise et notre pragmatisme au service de votre réussite — avec une conviction : trouver le bon candidat, au bon poste, avec le bon manager.  M&J Trusted Partners est signataire de la Charte de la Diversité et s'engage pour l'inclusion de tous, sans distinction.   	Notre client :  Notre client est une marketplace reconnu destinée au particuliers et entreprises.  Afin d'accompagner sa croissance, il recherche un Responsable Call Center H/F pour son centre d'appel basé sur le secteur Aubagne / Est de Marseille  Le poste :  Dans le cadre de vos fonctions en tant que Responsable Service Client, vous serez amené à encadrer et animer une équipe dédiée d'environ 10 personnes.  Vos responsabilités incluront les éléments suivants :  - Gérer les équipes et le recrutement (sélection des profils et mise en place d'un parcours d'intégration), - Motiver et animer l'équipe, en s'assurant que le sens du service et la démarche qualité soient partagés par tous et en veillant à ce que chaque conseiller participe à la dynamique générale de l'entreprise, - Assurer le suivi des performances. - Faire respecter les règles et procédures en vigueur et mettre en oeuvre les mesures correctrices nécessaires, - Mise en place de processus efficaces pour améliorer le service client, - Assister les conseillers en cas de difficulté, être leur premier relai en termes de formation et d'information, - Suivi des indicateurs de performance, avec un objectif d'atteindre les résultats escomptés, - Effectuer des reporting mensuels sur le suivi des résultats des téléconseillers (Utilisation des outils informatiques tels qu'Excel et Word pour le reporting et l'analyse) -  Conditions et avantages :  - Statut Cadre en 35h / semaine - Fixe de 40KEUR a 50KEUR annuel brut (selon profil) + variable annuel a 6KEUR. - Pour le reste on en discute lors de nos échanges.    	Profil recherché :  Vous avez acquis une expérience significative d'au moins 3 ans dans le management d'équipe au sein d'un service client.  Une expérience en centre d'appel est indispensable.  Les compétences attendues pour ce poste incluent :  - Solides compétences en management et en leadership, - Etre orienté résultats, - Avoir des capacités d'adaptation et être parfaitement autonome, - Gérer les attentes collectives et individuelles d'une équipe, - Aisance avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel et Word, - Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des échéances, - Appliquer et faire appliquer les consignes et procédures - Savoir prendre du recul dans les situations difficiles, - Savoir gérer les priorités,  Avantages salariaux : Bureaux exceptionnels, Prévoyance santé, Ordinateur professionnel, Primes et intéressements, Restaurant d'entrepr
