description: Technical Support Specialist – CloudCharge / DEFA eMobility      Etsitkö tilaisuutta käyttää osaamistasi teknisen asiakaspalvelun parissa? Kiinnostaako sähköautojen lataussovellusten ja -laitteiden asiantuntijuus? DEFA hakee asiakaspalvelun ammattilaista rakentamaan kestävämpää tulevaisuutta yhdessä osaavien kollegoiden kanssa!      DEFA  on norjalainen teknologiayritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 1946. Meillä on yli 400 työntekijää kolmella mantereella, ja tuotteitamme ja palveluitamme on saatavilla yli 30 maassa. Suomessa DEFA Oy on toiminut vuodesta 2014, ja tiimissämme työskentelee 13 alan ammattilaista. Tarjoamme ratkaisuja ajoneuvojen lataukseen, esilämmitykseen ja turvaamiseen, sekä kiinteistöjen ja teiden valaistukseen. DEFA on yksi merkittävimmistä Pohjoismaisista latausasemien toimittajista. Tutustu lisää: www.defa.com/fi      CloudCharge  on DEFA:n edustama sähköautojen latauslaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä CloudCharge tehostaa latausasemien hallintaa ja tarjoaa käyttäjäystävällisen kokemuksen niin kiinteistöjen omistajille, taloyhtiöille kuin loppukäyttäjille. Lue lisää: CloudCharge.      Mitä tulet tekemään   Vastaat CloudCharge-järjestelmän ja muiden eMobility-ratkaisujemme teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta. Työpäiväsi koostuu monipuolisista tehtävistä. Palvelet sekä loppukäyttäjiä että yritysasiakkaita ammattitaitoisesti ja ystävällisesti puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse. Tehtävässä korostuu kyky ratkaista haastavat tilanteet nopeasti ja asiantuntevasti. Toimit linkkinä teknisen tiimin ja asiakkaiden välillä, vastaat tukipyyntöjen käsittelystä, reklamaatioista, vianmäärityksistä ja raportoit kehitystarpeita. Osallistut asiakaspalvelutyön ja -viestinnän lisäksi myynnin tukeen, tuotteiden testaukseen ja kumppaneiden kouluttamiseen.      Suomen tiimimme työskentelee Vantaan toimistolta käsin, mikä mahdollistaa tehokkaan tiedonjaon ja oppimisen tiimissä. Asiakaspalvelumme on auki ma-pe, klo. 8–16.      Esihenkilönäsi toimii teknisen tuen tiiminvetäjä. Tekninen tiimi koostuu yhteensä neljästä kollegasta, sisältäen teknisen päällikön. Teet yhteistyötä pohjoismaisen organisaatiomme kanssa.      Etsimme sinua, jolla on    vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta  tekninen koulutus ja/ tai työkokemuksen kautta hankittua ymmärrystä IoT:ista/ ICT:stä tai automaatiosta  kyky käsitellä vaativia asiakastilanteita rauhallisesti ja järjestelmällisesti  sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito  ajokortti on hyödyllinen, sekä valmiutta jalkautua kentällä, vaikka pääosa työstäsi tapahtuu toimistolla       Plussaa jos    puhut muita pohjoismaisia kieliä  sinulla on ymmärrys pilvipalveluista ja/tai työskentelystä sähkön parissa  sinulta löytyy asennuspuolen työkokemusta.       Ennen kaikkea arvostamme    ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja järjestelmällisyyttä  selkeätä kommunikointia  halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä alan mukana  positiivista asennetta ja paineensietokykyä  systemaattista otetta ja vastuunottoa tilanteiden hallinnasta. title: Customer Service Manager  (Japan Payments)
description: Overview   CACTUS is a remote-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. However, given the business requirements of this role, you are expected to frequently travel to our Tokyo office.  We are looking for a Customer Service Manager (Japan Payments) to join our team in Tokyo. Ensure all customer interactions and financial processes comply with company policies and applicable Japanese financial regulations.   Identify opportunities to improve customer service, payment processes, and overall operational efficiency. Understanding of accounts receivable processes, payment operations, Japanese tax regulations, and financial documentation.   Currently based in the Tokyo area.   Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.   Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with strong communication, stakeholder management, and time management skills.   Strong attention to detail and a customer-first mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.      Preferred     Bachelor's degree in Accounting.   Experience working in a multinational or multicultural environment. title: Responsable de l'équipe Customer Success Manager
description: Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de l’équipe Customer Success Manager pour contribuer à façonner l’avenir de la messagerie d’entreprise chez LINK Mobility, leader européen des solutions de messagerie mobile et des plateformes CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service).   LINK Mobility Group AS est l’un des principaux fournisseurs européens de solutions de communication mobile auprès des entreprises, spécialisé dans les plateformes CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service). Le Groupe propose une large gamme de services et de solutions évolutifs à destination de nombreux secteurs d’activité comme la banque, l’assurance ou la distribution spécialisée, répondant à la demande croissante de convergence numérique entre entreprises, clients, plateformes et utilisateurs.  Le siège social du Groupe est situé à Oslo, en Norvège, et l’entreprise est cotée à la Bourse d’Oslo. LINK Mobility poursuit une croissance organique soutenue, avec un fort niveau de revenus récurrents, les clients transférant de plus en plus leurs activités vers les solutions mobiles.  Chez LINK Mobility, nous nous appuyons sur trois valeurs fondamentales qui guident notre activité et nos collaborateurs : Unis, Engagés et Enthousiastes. Travailler chez LINK, c’est apprécier la diversité, la collaboration internationale et la résolution de défis complexes dans un environnement en forte croissance. Nos équipes sont expertes, curieuses et agiles, et s’efforcent d’offrir en permanence les meilleures solutions à nos clients.   PRESENTATION DU ROLE   Vous aurez la responsabilité globale de l’équipe, de la mise en œuvre de sa stratégie en coordination avec le directeur commercial, de la croissance et de l’atteinte des résultats.   VOS RESPONSABILITES     LINK mobility France gère un portefeuille de clients de près de 100 m d’euros de chiffre d’affaires, dont la majorité sont les grandes entreprises du CAC40  L’environnement de LINK mobility est en pleine évolution :   Technologique : le messaging mobile migre vers des applications enrichies telles que WhatsApp et RCS  D’usage : les dispositifs de communication de nos clients deviennent conversationnels et intègrent l’IA   Vous aurez la responsabilité avec votre équipe d’accompagner cette transition en aidant nos clients à identifier les cas d’usage les plus pertinents pour eux, à les mettre en œuvre et à piloter les résultats  Vous devrez travailler au quotidien avec nos responsables commerciaux des comptes stratégiques, avec notre équipe Produit pour orienter la roadmap, avec nos partenaires stratégiques que sont les opérateurs de téléphonie mobile, Meta et Google.  Vous développerez l’équipe dans sa dimension conseil en communication digitale auprès de nos clients, avec une approche 360 degrés et phasée dans le temps  Vous aurez des objectifs à atteindre avec un bonus représentant 25% de votre salaire fixe    Experience Et Qualifications     Management d’équipe (5 à 10 ans)  Accompagnement et conseil de clients en communication/mar

title: Head of Managed Deliveries
description: Haluatko rakentaa Suomen tehokkainta verkkotoimituksia tekevää asiantuntijatiimiä?  Etsimme Connect-liiketoimintayksikköömme tiiminvetäjää vastaamaan Managed Deliveries -tiimistä. Tässä roolissa toimit asiantuntijatiimin esihenkilönä ja vastaat tiimin toiminnan, yhteistyömallien sekä toimituskyvykkyyden kehittämisestä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä päämiehen, alihankintakumppaneiden sekä Loihteen oman myynnin ja palvelukehityksen kanssa.  Managed Deliveries -tiimi vastaa verkkotoimitusten toteutuksesta ja kehittämisestä. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa uudenlainen, tehokas ja laadukas toimintamalli, jonka avulla tiimistä kehittyy alan johtava verkkotoimituksia tekevä asiantuntijaryhmä.     Kyberturva, pilvi ja yhteydet -liiketoimintamme varmistaa asiakkaidemme kriittisten toimintojen jatkuvuuden. Pitkälle tuotteistetut tietoturvan kokonaispalvelumme, 24/7 operoiva kyberturvakeskuksemme sekä edistyksellinen identiteetin- ja pääsynhallinta ovat kyberturvan keskiössä. Toteutamme myös moderneja pilvi- ja verkkoratkaisuja.      Mitä tulet tekemään?    Johdat Managed Deliveries -tiimin asiantuntijoita ja vastaat tiimin päivittäisestä toiminnasta.  Kehität verkkotoimitusten toimintamalleja, tehokkuutta ja toimituslaatua.  Rakennat ja kehität yhteistyötä päämiehen sekä alihankintakumppaneiden kanssa.  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Loihteen myynnin ja palvelukehityksen kanssa liiketoiminnan tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi.  Varmistat, että tiimillä on parhaat edellytykset onnistua, kasvaa ja kehittyä.       Mitä odotamme sinulta?   Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta ihmisten johtamisesta, toimintojen kehittämisestä sekä erilaisten kumppanuuksien rakentamisesta. Menestyt roolissa, jos innostut tuloksellisesta yhteistyöstä, jatkuvasta kehittämisestä ja asioiden viemisestä käytäntöön.      Tarvitset tässä roolissa:    Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai asiantuntijatiimien johtamisesta.  Näyttöjä operatiivisen toiminnan, palveluiden tai prosessien kehittämisestä.  Kykyä johtaa yhteistyötä useiden sidosryhmien, kumppaneiden ja asiakkaiden välillä.  Ymmärrystä verkkoratkaisuista, verkkotoimituksista tai teknisestä palveluliiketoiminnasta.  Hyviä viestintä-, yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.  Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.       Plussaa, mutta ei pakollista:    Kokemus teleoperaattori-, verkko- tai infrastruktuuriliiketoiminnasta  Kokemus alihankkijaverkoston johtamisesta  Kaupallinen osaaminen ja ymmärrys palveluliiketoiminnan kehittämisestä  Markkinointi- tai liiketoiminnan kehitystausta  Kokemus jatkuvien palveluiden tai toimitusorganisaatioiden johtamisesta       Käytännön asiat    Sijainti   Loihteella on toimipisteitä ympäri Suomen. Toivomme, että voit työskennellä hybridimallilla esimerkiksi Helsingin, Oulun, Tampereen tai muun Loihteen toimiston kautta. Käyt toimistolla säännöllisesti ja työ sisältää ajoittaista matkustamista Suomessa yhteistyökumppaneiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaan.      Palkka   Palkkahaitari tässä roolissa on 4000 - 7000 € / k

title: Founding Customer Success Manager - APAC

As we continue to grow in APAC, we are excited to hire our first  Customer Success Manager  in region to support the implementation and full lifecycle of our Strategic and High Touch customers in the region.  In this role, you will serve as both the Implementation Specialist and CSM for a defined book of upmarket APAC customers. You will partner with Ashby’s customers, helping them get up and running quickly while also building deep, ongoing strategic relationships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complexity, enjoys hands-on execution, and is excited to help shape how we support customers in a new region.   Role Requirements    Customer Success & Account Ownership     You have a strong background in Customer Success in B2B SaaS (5+ years preferred), supporting Enterprise or Strategic customers on complex, configurable products and driving adoption, engagement, and long-term outcomes.  You are excited to own a strategic book of customers in APAC, balancing both implementation work and ongoing Customer Success for our upmarket customers.  You build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders and act as a proactive owner of customer health, risk, and value realization.  You partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Operations to deliver cohesive, high-quality customer outcomes across the full lifecycle.     Implementation & Project Management     You have experience managing end-to-end implementations and onboarding projects, including defining scope, aligning stakeholders, communicating project plans, and delivering against milestones and expectations.  You act as the customer’s guide throughout implementation, ensuring expedited time to value and a smooth transition into steady-state customer success.  You are comfortable working in a remote-first environment and can travel up to 10 percent as needed for strategic customer engagements in APAC.     Product, Technical, and Domain Expertise     You love becoming a product and industry expert. You create “aha” moments by tailoring configuration, workflows, and training to each customer’s specific hiring challenges.  You have worked with technically complex products and are deeply curious about how things work, enabling you to anticipate risks, troubleshoot issues, and support evolving customer requirements.  You take pride in advising customers on best practices to ensure they get maximum va

title: Chargé(e) de compte – SaaS Travel
description: Viaxoft développe un  logiciel métier SaaS  utilisé par des  agences de voyages et tour-opérateurs  pour piloter leur activité au quotidien.  Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons  un(e) chargé(e) de compte spécialisé Tour-Opérateurs.   Au sein des Opérations (20 personnes) et rattachée directement à Jean, notre COO, tu es le  point de contact principal  de tes clients 🤝  Tu comprends leur métier, les accompagnes dans l’utilisation du logiciel et t’assures que la solution réponde concrètement à leurs besoins, dans la durée.  C’est un poste  au cœur de la relation client , avec une vraie proximité terrain. Tes missions   Comprendre le fonctionnement et les enjeux métiers de tes clients 🔍    Les conseiller sur les usages et paramétrages les plus adaptés    Piloter les déploiements fonctionnels et accompagner les démarrages 🚀    Former les utilisateurs (à distance ou sur site)    Suivre ton portefeuille clients : satisfaction, fidélisation, évolutions 📊    Faire le lien entre les clients et les équipes internes (support, produit, développement)    Participer à des projets fonctionnels et à l’amélioration continue du produit      Ce poste s’adresse à quelqu’un qui aime  comprendre un métier, structurer des solutions et construire une relation client dans la durée , tout en étant à l’aise avec des environnements techniques.  Tu te reconnais si :    Tu as  2 à 5 ans d'expérience  dans le secteur du travel.      Tu maitrises les enjeux liés à la production au sein de Tour-opérateurs.     Tu as une  appétence pour les sujets techniques et la gestion de projet  : tu aimes comprendre comment les outils fonctionnent et échanger avec des équipes tech (sans être développeur·se)    Tu es  structuré(e) , fiable et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle    Tu sais écouter, reformuler et prioriser, même face à des demandes floues    Tu apprécies les environnements où l’on te fait confiance et où tu prends des responsabilités    Tu aimes travailler en équipe et être en interaction régulière avec les clients    Les déplacements clients font partie du poste 🚗      🎓 Formation en gestion, comptabilité, tourisme ou parcours équivalent  📌 L’expérience terrain, la posture et la curiosité technique comptent autant que le diplôme  Une seule session d'entretien est prévue, au cours de laquelle tu rencontreras nos dirigeants ainsi que tes futurs collègues. title: Industrial Customer Care Manager
description: Krones FBL    (France, Belgium, Luxembourg) is a subsidiary of the Krones Group (   www.krones.com   ), which was founded in Germany and is now a leading international player in the production, sale and servicing of machines and even complete plants for the beverage and liquid food industries worldwide.    The group employs more than 20,000 people worldwide. Krones FBL currently employs around 160 people who manage Krones' activities in France, Belgium and Luxembourg.    The Krones group is the world market leader in its industrial sector and continues to grow, focusing on sustainable and ecological solutions. At Krones, we are working towards a better future and helping to preserve our planet for future generations.      To reinforce the Krones FBL Customer Care team and to take over an existing client portfolio on the French market, Krones FBL is looking for a (f/m/x)  CUSTOMER CARE MANAGER        Your role      The Customer Care Manager (CCM) is responsible for the after-sales service for a pre-defined customer portfolio in France. The CCM is the key contact between the client and Krones' internal organisation for all service activities.  As the central service contact point for the client base, the CCM’s mission is to anticipate, accompany and support our clients in their interactions with Krones, be it Krones FBL, Krones AG or other subsidiaries.  Autonomous and entrepreneurial, the Customer Care Manager is responsible for the Krones’ business within the portfolio of clients. The CCM visits them, identifies problems, anticipates needs, communicates proactively and reports accurately and timely.  As responsible for the after-sales, the CCM coordinates the actions of the specialized departments in order to achieve optimal customer satisfaction. As the main point of contact and always striving to propose the best possible solution, the CCM must be fully focused on continuous improvement and the customer experience.  As a service expert with deep roots in the organisation, the CCM develops and implements strategies that meet the specific needs of the customer base, always remaining aligned with the directives and needs of Krones.     As Customer Care Manager, you are responsible for:      Meeting customer needs by promoting Krones' products and services.  Advocating for customers internally, related to technical / organisational problems.  Ensuring to stay proactively in contact with clients.  Escalating and ensuring resolution of customer complaints by engaging the right internal and external stakeholders.  Collecting and processing customer complaints related to the services delivered.  Collecting and analysing customer feedback to continuously measure and improve customer satisfaction.  Responding to customer expectations and comments.  Developing and documenting all interactions with the customers and reporting accordingly to management.  Identifying, defining and monitoring key performance indicators and customer service measures.

Drivs du av att bygga förtroende hos beslutsfattare, utveckla strategiska kundrelationer och vinna affärer som skapar verkligt värde för kunden? Då kan detta vara nästa steg för dig.     PODAB befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas och söker nu en affärsdriven Key Account Manager som vill vara med och stärka vår position inom våra affärsområden Fastighet, BRF samt OPL (Tvätt i egen regi).        Om PODAB   PODAB är ett familjeägt svenskt företag med över 80 års erfarenhet av professionella tvättstugelösningar. Sedan 1945 har vi hjälpt kunder att skapa hållbara, driftsäkra och kostnadseffektiva tvättmiljöer genom högkvalitativa produkter och ett starkt fokus på service, kompetens och långsiktiga relationer.     Vårt erbjudande omfattar kompletta lösningar inom tvätt, tork och efterbehandling, från tvättmaskiner, torktumlare och torkskåp till torkrumsutrustning, manglar och tillhörande tjänster.     Vi verkar inom fyra affärsområden där Fastighet är vårt största affärsområde och en viktig del av vår framtida tillväxtstrategi. Våra lösningar finns idag hos fastighetsägare, bostadsrättsföreningar, industriföretag, hotell, tvätterier, räddningstjänster och andra verksamheter med höga krav på funktion, kvalitet och driftsäkerhet. Vi är självklart certifierade enligt ISO 9001 och ISO 14001.     Genom lång erfarenhet, hög kompetens och ett tydligt kundfokus har PODAB etablerat sig som en uppskattad partner på den svenska marknaden.        Om rollen   Som Key Account Manager hos PODAB ansvarar du för att utveckla affären inom ditt geografiska område. Du arbetar strategiskt med både privata och offentliga kunder och har ett helhetsansvar för dina affärer, från prospektering och marknadsbearbetning till presentation, förhandling, avtal och den fortsatta utvecklingen av kundrelationen.     Du bygger långsiktiga relationer med beslutsfattare, företagsledningar, fastighetsägare och offentliga beställare. Genom att förstå kundens verksamhet och utmaningar skapar du lösningar som bidrar till ökad effektivitet, bättre ekonomi och långsiktigt värde.  För dig handlar försäljning inte om att konkurrera med pris. Du driver affärer genom att tydliggöra kundnyttan och skapa förtroende kring våra lösningar med fokus på ekonomi, besparingar, finansiering, ROI och TCO.      Ditt uppdrag    Ansvara för utvecklingsplan och genomförande av affärsstrategier för dina kundkonton och ditt geografiska område.  Identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och agera vid rätt tidpunkt.  Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med beslutsfattare, företagsledningar, fastighetsägare och offentliga beställare.  Driva hela affärsprocessen, från prospektering och behovsanalys till presentation, förhandling, avtal och kontinuerlig kundutveckling.  Identifiera kun

title: CRM Manager
description: Our Company      Elha Laser Center and Láserum have been the pioneers in the laser hair removal industry for more than 10 years. With our two brands, we are currently leading the market in Southern Europe with more than 430 stores across Spain, Italy, France and Portugal. Our value proposition is to offer an excellent service at a competitive price, delivered by trained specialists using the latest-generation laser technology. That focus on quality shows in our results: more than 300.000 reviews on Google with a 4.9/5 rating.     With more than one million clients across both brands, we have a powerful asset, and we are now looking for someone to lead our CRM strategy across the whole organisation, making the most of that base in a deliberate, coordinated way: combining the right touchpoints at the right moment across email marketing, WhatsApp, in-app notifications, and call centre outreach, among other channels.     Our marketing team works in outcome-based squads, organised around three goals: acquisition, retention, and brand building. The CRM Manager is the owner of the Retention squad and a key contributor across the other two.      Your Role      As CRM Manager, you will own the customer lifecycle and CRM strategy across both brands, Elha and Láserum, and across all our markets: Spain, Portugal, Italy and France. You will design and optimise the journeys that drive recurrence, repurchase and long-term value; keep our client database clean and actionable; and lead the rollout of our proprietary segmentation model alongside our data partners.        Your Impact      CRM & Customer Lifecycle      Define, build and maintain customer journeys (welcome, activation, recurrence, repurchase, reactivation) for Elha and Láserum.  Identify and prioritise CRM opportunities: new flows, segments and value moments across the lifecycle.  Analyse journey and campaign performance: open rates, CTR, conversion, recurrence and LTV contribution.  Design and run improvement tests (A/B and experiments) on subject lines, content, timing and segmentation; iterate from results.  Own the health of the client database: data quality, deduplication, consents and segmentation — the foundation that makes everything else work.      Proprietary Segmentation Model (Implementation and Governance)     We have designed a custom client segmentation model built around four dimensions specific to our business: recency, engagement, value, and treatment adherence. You will own making it happen.      Lead the full implementation of the segmentation model across markets, on a clean, well-structured client base.  Coordinate technical rollout with our data partners and ensure the scoring engine and journey triggers are production-ready.  Translate segmentation outputs into CRM actions: define which segments get which journeys, triggers and content and keep it evolving.       About You       Solid experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing and marketing automation — Klaviyo or equivale

title: Customer Experience Advocate - English-speaking and Spanish markets
description: Looking for your next career challenge? Or just poking around? 👀 Whether curiosity or ambition brought you here, Avantio could be exactly what you’re looking for!   Who are we?   We don’t want to bore you with another endless company biography. Here’s a quick snapshot of what we do! 🔎 We build cloud-based software to help vacation rental agencies manage and distribute their properties in our all-in-one tool 🌐. Moreover, we create custom websites for our clients.   👉 Want to know more?  Here you can get to know us better https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n4aeLa2MUnA  But technology and innovation are just a part of it. The real engine behind Avantio is  our people 👥.  We’re a Valencian Saas company with a  global mindset  and +200 professionals from +28 different nationalities 🌎. Our HQ is located in sunny Valencia 🍊, we recently opened an office in Mexico, and we have a sales team working remotely from Florida (USA) 🙌.  What brings us together? Our experience, professionalism, and passion for what we do.  Ready to join the team? 🚀   What You’ll Be Doing (and Who With)     Respond to customer requests via email, chat and video call.  Manage these requests and resolve them as soon as possible or pass the report on to the technical team for resolution.  Follow up on incidents and ensure customer satisfaction.  Once your knowledge of the product is more advanced: upgrade plans, post sales, module activation.  Support the team in other markets as needed.  Translation of online support for new launches (on demand).  Support at customer events in the market.  Support in market development and system adaptation.     What are we looking for?     Proven experience in Customer Experience, or Customer Support roles (ideally within SaaS, or Tech)  Native or bilingual in Spanish and English  Proactive root-cause analysis skills to resolve escalated customer issues  Proficiency with CRM, ticketing, and CX platforms (ideally with hands-on Intercom experience)  Proactive and positive attitude, and service oriented  You are a technology geek. If you know our products is a plus!     Useful:     Knowledge of other additional languages: Portuguese, Italian, French...  A restless, creative person with the ability to generate ideas.  You like to work in a team: if anything is characteristic of the Customer Experience team, it is how much they help each other. WFM 매니저는 고객센터의 인입을 예측하고, 인력을 계획하며, 비용을 최적화하는 Workforce Operation을 담당해 안정적이고 효율적인 상담 운영의 기반을 만듭니다.     담당하시게 될 업무를 소개합니다     인입 예측 (Forecasting)  채널별 문의 인입량 예측 — 시즌·프로모션·이벤트·서비스 변화 등 변수를 반영  예측 정확도 모니터링 및 예측 모델·기준의 지속적 개선  인력 계획 및 운영 (Capacity & Scheduling)  예측 기반 필요 상담 인력 산정 및 스케줄·시프트 편성  실시간 인입 대비 인력 배치 조정 및 서비스 레벨 관리(리얼타임 관제)  비용 관리 (Cost Management)  상담 인력 및 아웃소싱(BPO) 비용 계획·관리  생산성·효율 지표를 근거로 한 인력 운영 비용 최적화  성과 지표 관리 & 데이터 기반 개선  서비스 레벨(SLA)  응대율 등 WFM 핵심 지표 모니터링 및 개선  SQL(BigQuery) 등을 활용한 인입·인력 데이터 분석, 대시보드 구축 및 Pain Point 개선  협력사(BPO) 인력 운영 조율 및 사업·유관부서와 예측·인력·비용 정책 반영     이런 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다     고객센터/콜센터 WFM 또는 Workforce Operation(인입 예측·인력 계획·비용 관리) 실무 경력 5년 이상  인입 예측, 인력 산정·스케줄링, 서비스 레벨(SLA) 관리를 직접 수행해본 경험이 있으신 분  SQL을 활용한 데이터 추출·분석이 가능하신 분  Excel·스프레드시트를 활용한 데이터 모델링·관리 능력이 우수하신 분  인입·인력 데이터를 근거로 운영 효율과 비용을 개선해본 경험이 있으신 분     이런 분이면 더욱 좋습니다     CX 전문 솔루션(예 : Genesys, Cisco, Sendbird, Zendesk 등) 활용 경험이 있으신 분  아웃소싱(BPO) 콜센터의 인력 운영·비용 관리·협상 경험이 있으신 분  예측·스케줄 업무를 자동화하거나 AI 도구(Claude 등)  RPA로 효율화해본 경험이 있으신 분  일 수천 건 이상 대규모 인입을 다루는 환경에서 근무한 경험이 있으신 분  빠른 속도로 일하는 플랫폼 비즈니스 회사에서 근무한 경험이 있으신 분    ﻿   미래의 쏘팸이 되기 위한 과정    서류 전형 → 1차(직무) 인터뷰 → 2차(컬처 핏) 인터  뷰 → 입사 조건 협의(처우, 입사일) → 최종 합격 확정 → 입사     처우 협의가 완료된 후보자 분들께 최종 합격 안내를 드리고 있습니다.  후보자 혹은 회사의 상황에 따라 전형이 추가될 수 있습니다.  입사 후 3개월의 수습 평가 기간이 있습니다.      지원하시기 전에 꼭 읽어 주세요!     각 전형 결과는 지원 시 기재해주신 이메일 주소로 안내 드릴 예정입니다.  채용 관련 문의는 talent@socar.kr으로 보내주시기 바랍니다.  제출해주신 지원서 내용 중 허위 사실이 있는 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  해당 공고는 수시 채용으로, 채용 완료 시 조기 마감 될 수 있습니다.  국가유공자 및 장애인 등 취업 보호 대상자는 관계 법령에 따라 우대합니다.     👀   채용 중인 쏘카의 포지션 한눈에 보기    ﻿

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description: Chi siamo   Nel mondo ci sono 2,7 miliardi di lavoratori “di prima linea”, l’80% della forza lavoro globale.  Sono le persone che mandano avanti il mondo ogni giorno: servono clienti, producono beni, assistono pazienti, trasportano merci, insegnano, puliscono, accolgono.  Le aziende che li gestiscono affrontano sfide enormi: turnover elevato, difficoltà nel trovare candidati qualificati, comunicazione frammentata e processi di gestione lenti e disconnessi.  Klaaryo nasce per risolvere proprio questo!  Attraverso la potenza della AI generativa conversazionale nativa su WhatsApp, Klaaryo trasforma ogni interazione tra azienda e lavoratore in una conversazione intelligente, personalizzata e continua - dal recruiting all’onboarding, dalla formazione al feedback continuo.  La nostra tecnologia comprende, adatta e risponde in modo naturale, creando esperienze fluide ed umane anche su larga scala.  Così riduciamo le inefficienze, acceleriamo le assunzioni ed aumentiamo la produttività di chi lavora davvero sul campo - le persone che fanno funzionare il mondo.      Cosa cerchiamo   Entrerai in un team internazionale, giovane e collaborativo, dove il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto immediato sulla soddisfazione e sul successo dei clienti enterprise e mid-market.  Cerchiamo una persona che presidi il momento più delicato del ciclo di vita del cliente:  il passaggio dalla firma al primo valore generato.   L'onboarding in Klaaryo non è una configurazione tecnica da eseguire: è un progetto da coordinare. Significa tradurre il processo di recruiting di un cliente — spesso distribuito su decine di punti vendita, con ruoli, stagionalità e vincoli diversi — in una configurazione del nostro agente conversazionale che funzioni davvero sul campo, e portarla al go-live nei tempi promessi.  Entrerai nel team Customer Success, lavorando in affiancamento alla CS Lead e a stretto contatto con Product, Tech e Sales. Avrai la responsabilità diretta di un portafoglio di nuovi clienti in fase di setup, dal kick-off alla stabilizzazione post go-live (adoption).      Cosa farai    Coordinamento del progetto di onboarding    Guiderai il kickoff con il cliente: analisi del processo di selezione esistente, raccolta dei requisiti, definizione di KPI e KSI di progetto  Costruirai e manterrai il piano di setup — fasi, milestone, owner, dipendenze — prioritizzando le attività in funzione della data di go-live concordata, delle dipendenze tecniche e delle loro tempistiche  Presidierai i blocker: li identificherai in anticipo, facendo escalation al team giusto e ritornando dal cliente con una proposta, non solo con una segnalazione    Relazione con il cliente in fase di setup e onboarding    Sarai il punto di riferimento operativo del cliente per tutta la fase di implementazione: aggiornamenti di avanzamento, follow-up post-call, gestione delle aspettative  Coordinerai la fase di test e validazione dei flussi conversazionali con il team del cliente, raccogliendo e strutturando il feedba

The business has grown rapidly, securing more than $6 billion in mortgages each year.     We’re not a conventional company with layers of rules and hierarchy, and we don’t intend to become one. Revenue Operations Manager

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000


Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.


Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.


You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.


This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.


There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective

title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

title: Financial Accountant
description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

This is not a traditional accounting role focused on maintaining legacy systems.

At Volta, you will help build the finance function from first principles, contributing to the design of processes, controls, and reporting in a business deploying capital at global scale.

Working closely with the Senior Financial Accountant and the wider Financial Accounting and Transactional Function, you will play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting while supporting the build-out of a scalable, best-in-class accounting environment across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the execution of the monthly financial close

  • Prepare and post accrual, prepayment, payroll, capex, revenue, and FX entries, among others

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations for review

    • Cash, AR, AP, fixed assets, other payables and receivables, equity

title: Data Scientist - Audiobooks Analytics
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. You will work with the Audiobooks Analytics Lead to help shape our global audiobooks strategy and improve the experience for listeners, creators, publishers, and authors.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to evaluate some of the most important opportunities facing our audiobooks business. Your work will span content and catalog strategy, discovery and recommendations, subscriber growth, and new product and commercial initiatives. You will turn complex questions into clear recommendations and help senior leaders make confident decisions.

You will collaborate with a distributed team of analysts, data scientists, business leaders, product managers, editorial partners, and engineers. At Spotify, you will have access to rich datasets and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will help shape how the world listens to and discovers audiobooks.


What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies for audiobook catalog, content discovery, listener engagement, and subscriber growth.
  • Evaluate new product, content, licensing, and commercial opportunities through forecasting, scenario modeling, and impact measurement.
  • Partner with Editorial, Personalization, Product, Finance, and Business teams to improve title selection, recommendation quality, and the listener experience.
  • Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments, to measure the impact of product and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Monitor the health of the audiobooks business, identify emerging opportunities or risks, and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Develop reliable analytical datasets, tools, and reporting that make important insights accessible and repeatable.<

title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud
description:
About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys

Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. Hi , I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a great (former) engineer who built impressive products and now builds teams of great engineers. Ashby’s success and ambition mean we’re doubling the Engineering team in the next year, and we need your experience and leadership to do it thoughtfully.

Our product and growth are exceptional. Ashby All-in-One is powerful, easy to use, and replaces several venture-backed companies' worth of products (often with a better experience). We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway.

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, figure out how to hire them, and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to actually be exceptional. In other words, if engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets excites you, you’ve found the right place.

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll work closely with me, Ben, Colin, and your peers to build out the team and continue scaling this unique culture.

You’ll first do that through grassroots leadership. You’ll manage three to five Engineers and hire three to five more. They’ll cover multiple teams and a variety of specializations, from Product Engineers to Site Reliability Engineers to Design Engineers. Your day-to-day will include:

  • Providing feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects and deliver them with little intervention.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

You’ll also propose and lead department and company-wide initiatives. Some examples:

  • Rethink how we (and the industry) do pull request reviews by aligning on goals with the team, sampling a set of PRs to understand how effective they are, and writing a proposal to the team about what we could change to speed up reviews while giving reviewers the time and space to give useful feedback.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - East (New York)
description:
Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.

Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source. Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.

With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.

title: Engineering Manager - UK
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-dat

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

RevenueCat prices based on how much money a customer makes. That creates an unusually clear alignment of incentives: when our customers grow, we grow.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

And often, it means doing the unglamorous but critical work of keeping everyone aligned on context, priorities, next steps, owners, and follow-through.

That’s this role.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of managed RevenueCat customers and help them get more value from RevenueCat. You’ll become the person who understands where each customer is trying to go, what is getting in their way, how RevenueCat can plausibly help, and what needs to happen next.

You are not expected to be the best technical expert, paywall expert, lifecycle expert, paid acquisition expert, or pricing expert in the company.

You are expected to be a strong growth generalist: curious, commercially aware, product-fluent, organized, and credible enough to diagnose the right problem, bring in the right person, and own the follow-through.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat has grown quickly, and our customer base now spans everything from tiny indie apps to some of the largest mobile businesses in the world.

title: Principal, Value Realization
description:
About League

League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

Position Summary:

As a Principal, Value Realization, you will own the moment of truth in League's customer relationships: turning the ROI commitments made during the sale into measured, defensible proof of impact. You will drive the end-to-end post-sales value lifecycle — picking up pre-sales business cases at contract go-live, building the measurement frameworks that track delivery against committed KPIs, and producing the executive-ready ROI narratives that anchor renewals and unlock expansion.

This role sits at the intersection of business value and business development. You will work in lockstep with Account Management, Customer Delivery, Solution Engineering, and Product — translating platform outcomes into customer-validated ROI evidence that closes the loop on what was promised, defends renewals, and creates the commercial foundation for expansion.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the post-sales Value Realization workstream across League's full customer portfolio — picking up pre-sales business cases at contract go-live and driving measurement of committed outcomes through the full contract term
  • Translate pre-sales value commitments (business cases, ROI models) into post-sales measurement frameworks, defining the KPIs, leading indicators, and lagging indicators that track League's impact.
  • Lead regular value review sessions with customer executive stakeholders, co-presenting performance data with the account manager and narrating the business outcomes League has enabled.
  • Partner with account teams to identify value gaps, at-risk accounts, and expansion signals based on value attainment data.
  • Build and maintain a library of value stories, benchmarks, and proof points that can be leveraged across the sales cycle and customer lifecycle.
  • Develop scalable frameworks, templates, and playbooks that enable the broader post-sales organization to run value realization programs consistently.
  • Collaborate with Product and Solution Engineering to feed customer outcome data back into the pro

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Du schneidest Videos nicht einfach nur schön, sondern so, dass Menschen stoppen, weiterschauen und klicken? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.

Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Video Editor, der vorhandenen UGC-Content, B-Roll, Produktaufnahmen, Voice-over und Skripte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke Werbeanzeigen für Meta und TikTok verwandelt.

Du solltest nicht nur dein Schnittprogramm beherrschen, sondern verstehen, wie erfolgreiche Paid-Social-Creatives aufgebaut sind: von einer starken Hook über gutes Storytelling bis hin zu einem klaren Call-to-Action.

Aufgaben

  • Du schneidest performanceorientierte Video-Ads für Meta, Instagram Reels und TikTok.
  • Du verwandelst UGC-Content, B-Roll, Produktaufnahmen, Voice-over und vorhandene Skripte in dynamische, überzeugende Werbeanzeigen.
  • Du entwickelst und schneidest unterschiedliche Hooks, Einstiege, Storylines und Varianten, damit wir verschiedene Creative Angles gezielt testen können.
  • Du arbeitest mit schnellen Schnitten, Untertiteln, Text-Overlays, Sounddesign, Animationen, Zooms, Pattern Interrupts und passenden Effekten – immer mit dem Ziel, Aufmerksamkeit und Watchtime zu erhöhen.
  • Du wählst eigenständig passende Szenen und B-Rolls aus und setzt Produkt, Anwendung, Ergebnis und Vorteile von AYLASHES wirkungsvoll in Szene.
  • Du adaptierst Creatives für verschiedene Plattformen und Formate, insbesondere 9:16 sowie bei Bedarf 4:5 und 1:1. Dabei achtest du auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit und eine saubere mobile Darstellung.
  • Du erstellst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Szenen, Captions, Längen oder CTAs.
  • Du setzt Feedback schnell

description:
Du willst nicht einfach technische Dokumente verwalten, sondern aktiv daran mitwirken, dass unsere Gyroplanes sicher zugelassen werden und weltweit abheben können?

Bei AutoGyro arbeitest du nicht an standardisierten Industrieprodukten. Stattdessen bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Technik, Zertifizierung und internationalen Luftfahrtbehörden und sorgst dafür, dass technische Nachweise, regulatorische Anforderungen und wichtige Dokumente zuverlässig zusammenpassen.

Von Zertifizierungsunterlagen und Compliance-Nachweisen bis hin zu Pilotenhandbüchern, Airworthiness Limitations und anderen technischen Publikationen: Du trägst dazu bei, dass unsere technischen Informationen vollständig, nachvollziehbar und aktuell sind. Dabei bekommst du einen direkten Einblick in die Entstehung und Weiterentwicklung eines echten Luftfahrtprodukts.

Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und trage aktiv dazu bei, dass unsere Gyroplanes sicher und regelkonform in die Luft kommen. Dich erwarten eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem internationalen Luftfahrtunternehmen, attraktive Konditionen sowie täglich kostenloses Mittagessen.

Aufgaben

  • Mitarbeit bei der Vorbereitung, Pflege und Nachverfolgung von Unterlagen für Musterzulassung und Zertifizierung, insbesondere Compliance-Checklisten, Nachweise und Zulassungsdokumente

title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer (OS and Bare-Metal)
description:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.   • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and first relevant experience (internships, projects) is desired.
  • Relocation required. Currently 4 days on-site, 1 day remote. Policy may change.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus stock options
  • 30+ days of paid vacation
  • Relocation support

Your Role:

title: Content & Brand Intern (m/w/d)
description:
Was machen wir bei Sunpeak Capital?

Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke, steueroptimierte Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: Ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du prägst, wie Sunpeak Capital nach außen auftritt. Du verantwortest unseren Content von der Idee über den Dreh mit unserem Gründer bis zur Veröffentlichung und ziehst unsere Brand durch alle internen und externen Materialien. Dabei hast du viel kreativen Freiraum und bekommst die Tools, die du dafür brauchst.

title: Customer Services Manager
description: Join the Cold Chain That Feeds the World.  For over 120 years, Americold has connected producers, processors, distributors, and retailers to ensure food stays safe, fresh, and accessible. With 240+ facilities across four continents and 14,000+ team members, we’re a global leader in temperature-controlled logistics. Our mission is to help our customers feed the world – and we’re looking for people who share that purpose. We value customer service, innovation, and inclusion, and we invest in our people’s growth and well-being. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a company that puts people first, Americold is the place for you.   What You'll Do   You will oversee a small team responsible for managing daily relationships and customer engagement with QSR clients, ensuring efficient operations and effective issue resolution. The role includes maintaining strong connections with customer head office teams, coordinating with operations and rebuying teams, and ensuring all customer concerns are addressed promptly. Frequent travel is required to meet business needs.   Essential Functions     Manage daily communication and engagement with QSR store management and franchisee owners to address service and performance issues.  Oversee problem resolution for customer issues by collaborating with local teams and escalating as needed to ensure satisfactory outcomes.  Attend customer business reviews and franchisee meetings to maintain close working relationships with key customer leaders and decision makers.  Monitor and report on customer service and operational KPIs, including handling credit holds, stock adjustments, and cost allocations.  Coordinate order processes, transport planning, and roster management to ensure accurate and timely delivery of services.  Guide and performance manage the QSR customer service team, including planning for leave and ensuring cross-training to meet business needs.  Support continuous improvement initiatives and collaborate with operations and rebuying teams to optimize service delivery and stock management.  Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.     What Experience And Education You Need     Minimum 3 years of customer service management experience required.  Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.  Experience using WMS, RF, TMS, and IT systems.  Demonstrated ability to resolve customer issues efficiently and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders.  Proven experience in a food service or fast-paced environment.     What Could Set You Apart     Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.  Effective verbal and written communication.  Consistently met or exceeded performance targets in previous roles.  Skilled in negotiation and conflict resolution.  Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including store team members, head office contacts, and internal teams.  Reliable and punctual with flexibility for varying work hour

title: Senior Community & Customer Support Manager (m/w/d)
description: Hi, wir sind SafeNow!    Ein Startup, das es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht hat, jedem Menschen auf der Welt Sicherheit zu bieten – und zwar kostenlos. Dazu entwickeln wir eine App, die dir sofortigen Zugang zu lokal relevanten Helfer:innen verschafft, egal ob es sich dabei um deine Freunde, Familie oder professionelle Helfer:innen handelt.   Wir sind ein kleines Team mit einem großen Herzen, mit Sitz in München, bestehend ca. 50 Personen mit 9 verschiedenen Nationalitäten. Wir suchen ein leidenschaftliches neues Teammitglied, das es liebt, neue Herausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen Startup-Umgebung anzugehen. Wir sind ein bunt gemischter Haufen ehrlicher und aufgeschlossener Menschen, die eine gemeinsame Vision haben, die Welt für uns und die Menschen und Orte, die wir lieben, sicherer zu machen.   Für diese Vision suchen wir eine erfahrene Person als  Senior Community & Customer Support Manager (m/w/d) , die unsere Stimme auf Social Media prägt und unsere Nutzer:innen rund um App und Button vertrauensvoll begleitet  Aufgaben     Strategie & Insights:  Du erarbeitest und entwickelst die gesamte Strategie für Community Management und Customer Support bei SafeNow, analysierst dafür Kennzahlen (Follower, Views, Likes u. v. m.) sowie Insights zu spezifischen Events oder Kundengruppen und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab    Automatisierung:  Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Prozesse im Community- und Support-Bereich und automatisierst sie KI-gestützt – skalierbar und übertragbar auf weitere Sprachen    AI-Einsatz:  Du nutzt KI-Tools sinnvoll, um Antworten und Analysen effizienter zu gestalten    Wissensdatenbank:  Du bist verantwortlich für unsere interne Wissensdatenbank und hältst sie laufend aktuell    Messages & Kommentare:  Du beantwortest Nachrichten und moderierst Kommentare auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen – TikTok, Instagram, Facebook und YouTube    Customer Support:  Du bearbeitest individuelle Support-Anfragen unserer B2B- und B2C-Kundschaft rund um App und Button über Chat und E-Mail (kein Telefon-Support) sowie App-Store-Bewertungen, und teilst die daraus gewonnenen Insights mit unserem Produktteam    Qualifikation    Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Community Management und/oder Customer Support   Erfahrung darin, eine Community- und/oder Support-Strategie eigenständig zu entwickeln und weiterzudenken   Exzellente Rechtschreibung und einen authentischen Schreibstil in Deutsch und Englisch   Erfahrung mit oder großes Interesse an Automatisierung und KI-Tools im Community- und Support-Kontext   Eine eigenverantwortliche, strategische Arbeitsweise und Lust, die Community-Strategie von SafeNow aktiv mitzugestalten   Gelassenheit und Humor – du behältst die Fassung, auch wenn die Community sie mal verliert    Benefits     Purpose-Work:  Starte jeden Morgen mit dem Wissen, dass Dein Beitrag die Welt sicherer macht.    Erfolgsgeschichte mitschreiben:  Erhalte Anteile an unserem rasant wachsenden Startup (VSOP) und profitiere direk

title: Teammanager klantenservice
description: Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen.  Samen met een betrokken team lever je dagelijks een zichtbare bijdrage aan de excellente dienstverlening voor miljoenen klanten van de RDW.  Het aanspreekpunt zijn voor je team op de werkvloer en medewerkers bijstaan in hun ontwikkeling, maar ook samen resultaten behalen en die verantwoorden. Je coacht, motiveert en stimuleert jouw medewerkers om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Dat is het uitdagende speelveld waarin jij je als teammanager binnen de frontoffice bij de divisie Registratie en Informatie (R&I) in Veendam bevindt.   Interessant aan deze baan volgens teammanager klantenservice Paulien   Als teammanager binnen het KCC ben je de spin in het web. Je houdt je enerzijds bezig met de ontwikkeling van je medewerkers en anderzijds ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor alle ontwikkelingen op de unit. Dit alles om een optimale dienstverlening te creëren voor onze klanten. Kortom: een enorm dynamische en afwisselende functie!  Lees de verhalen van andere RDW’ers >   Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen   Binnen Divisie Registratie & Informatie, afdeling Frontoffice, is de unit KCC (Klant Contact Center) op zoek naar een gedreven Teammanager. Bij vragen over de registratie en informatie in en uit het kentekenregister is de unit Klant Contact Center het eerste aanspreekpunt. Dat kunnen heel uiteenlopende vragen zijn op het werkterrein van de RDW. Een team van 40 interne RDW collega's en 75 externe collega's staan garant voor een juiste en efficiënte beantwoording van vragen. Die komen per telefoon, brief, email, chat en aan de balie binnen. Met duizenden verzoeken om informatie per week is het de RDW er veel aan gelegen om de dienstverlening permanent te verbeteren. Op de locatie in Veendam werkt het interne KCC samen met een externe partner.  Als Teammanager draag je de verantwoordelijkheid om ervoor te zorgen dat jouw team optimaal is toegerust om het werk succesvol uit te voeren. Samen met een collega-teammanager geef je leiding aan een team van circa 40 medewerkers, waarbij je rechtstreeks verantwoordelijk bent voor de aansturing van ongeveer 20 collega's. Je zorgt ervoor dat de doelstellingen van het KCC worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken kaders van tijd, kwaliteit en budget.  Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het coachen, begeleiden en motiveren van je teamleden, zodat zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen en optimaal kunnen presteren. De resultaten van jouw team maak je inzichtelijk via managementrapportages. Door deze informatie te combineren met een continue monitoring en analyse van prestaties, krijg je scherp inzicht in kansen om productiviteit, efficiëntie, kwaliteit en effectiviteit verder te verbeteren.  Om goed aangesloten te blijven bij zowel bestaande als nieuwe projecten binnen de RDW, onderhoud je actief een breed netwerk van contacten binnen de organisatie en werk je nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders. title: Customer Service Manager - Galway
description: About EZ Living Furniture    EZ Living Furniture is one of Ireland's leading furniture retailers, dedicated to helping customers create beautiful homes through quality furniture, exceptional service, and a seamless shopping experience. We are the largest independent Furniture Retailer in Ireland employing over 370 people.     We are committed to delivering outstanding customer satisfaction at every stage of the customer journey, from purchase through to delivery and aftercare.    Role Overview    We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused   Customer Service Manager  to lead our Customer Service team and drive excellence across all customer interactions. This role will be responsible for managing a team of Customer Service Representatives while also providing data-driven insights and analytics on customer issues, complaints, and service failures that impact the wider business.  The successful candidate will play a key role in improving customer satisfaction, identifying root causes of recurring issues, and partnering with departments including Retail Stores, Distribution, Logistics, E-commerce, Buying, and Operations to implement continuous improvement initiatives.   Key Responsibilities     Lead, coach, motivate, and develop a team of Customer Service Representatives.   Oversee the resolution of customer queries, complaints, and escalations.   Monitor compliance with company policies and consumer regulations.   Act as an escalation point for complex customer issues.   Analyse customer contacts, complaints, returns, delivery issues, and service failures.   Identify key trends, root causes, and recurring issues impacting customers.   Produce regular management reports and KPI dashboards.   Present findings and recommendations to senior management.   Use customer feedback and operational data to influence business decisions.   Partner with internal stakeholders to reduce customer pain points.   Drive corrective actions arising from customer feedback and trend analysis.   Support process improvement initiatives across customer service and operational functions.   Monitor service performance and customer satisfaction metrics.   Drive initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience.      Skills And Experience     Minimum 3-5 years' experience in a Customer Service leadership role.   Proven experience managing and developing customer service teams.   Strong analytical and reporting skills with experience interpreting customer data.   Experience producing management reports and presenting findings.   Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.   Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.   Customer-focused mindset with a passion for service excellence.   Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.   Experience using CRM and customer service management platforms.      WHY JOIN US: Look us up on Glassdoor- rated 4.6/5     Benefits     Up to 23 days holiday per year  Fun, fast paced & high energy work environ

title: Team Lead til Fastholdelse i OK
description: Kan du lede et team med ét klart mål: at fastholde flere kunder? Som Team Lead for Fastholdelse får du ansvaret for at udvikle medarbejderne, løfte performance og skabe stærke kundeoplevelser.    Om rollen og afdelingen   I OK er vi i gang med at etablere et nyt Fastholdelsesteam, som skal rådgive privatkunder, der overvejer deres muligheder, og hjælpe dem med at finde den rette løsning.  Som Team Lead får du det operationelle ansvar for teamet og bliver en synlig og nærværende leder, der er tæt på både medarbejdere og den daglige drift. Du udvikler teamet, følger performance og bruger data, KPI’er og kundeindsigter til at skabe stærke resultater.  Teamets indsigter skal samtidig bidrage til at styrke kundeoplevelsen og OK’s samlede fastholdelsesindsats. Du bliver en del af ledergruppen i Salg og Kundeservice Privat og refererer til afdelingens Manager. Samtidig bliver du en del af et tæt og engageret samarbejde med de øvrige Team Leads, hvor I sammen sikrer retning, sparring og fælles fokus på tværs af området.   Dine opgaver      Lede, coache og udvikle medarbejderne gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.  Skabe en stærk performancekultur med tydelige mål og løbende feedback.  Følge op på KPI’er, kvalitet og fastholdelsesresultater.  Sikre gode og værdiskabende kundedialoger.  Bruge data og kundeindsigter til at identificere forbedringsmuligheder.  Planlægge bemandingen i samarbejde med Workforce Management.  Bidrage til udviklingen af OK’s churn- og fastholdelsesindsats.  Rekruttere og onboarde nye medarbejdere efter behov.      Om dig   Du har minimum to års erfaring med at lede et Fastholdelsesteam og kan dokumentere stærke resultater inden for fastholdelse og performance.  Som leder er du tydelig, nærværende og god til at skabe følgeskab. Du sætter retning, følger op og udvikler dine medarbejdere med blik for både resultater og trivsel.  Du arbejder struktureret og datadrevet og bruger KPI’er og kundeindsigter aktivt til at prioritere og forbedre teamets performance.   Det praktiske   Kundecentret har åbent alle ugens dage. Din primære arbejdstid vil typisk være fem hverdage kl. 08.00-16.00, men du skal regne med at være på kontoret kl. 12.00-20.00 én til to gange om måneden. Weekendarbejde kan forekomme i takt med, at funktionen udvikles.  Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt og senest den 30. august 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.  Tiltrædelse er snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat frem for at fremskynde opstarten.  Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutterende leder Marianne Jensen på tlf. 40 14 22 86-  Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Store Lead - Copenhagen (m/f/d)

Our Leads grow through hands-on learning, steady coaching and opportunities across stores, regions and teams.  As a key member of the store leadership team, you will be working alongside the Assistant and Store Manager, leading a talented group of Product Guides. You bring energy and purpose to every part of the store - guest experience, product, people, and operations. Passionate about the outdoors, you live the lifestyle and share it authentically. Eller kanskje du har fikset en overraskelse til barna som bor på hotellet for aller første gang?  Vi søker en Front Office Manager som kan spre glede og sørge for at våre gjester føler seg velkommen! Som en del av vårt Service Crew kommer du til å møte våre gjester med et varmt smil og håndtere oppgaver fortløpende i resepsjonen. Det er en jobb som krever en sterk sans for service og effektivitet, men det er også en jobb som gir deg mulighet til å utgjøre forskjellen for våre gjester. Som “Front Office Manager” sørger du for at du og teamet får våre gjester til å forlate hotellet med et stort smil! Stillingen innebærer varierende arbeidstider, inkludert kvelder og helger.      Nysgjerrig på hva stillingen innebærer?    Daglige Front Office-oppgaver fra innsjekk til utsjekk. Du er en lagspiller og dine kollegaer ser på deg som tilgjengelig og støttende.
